v.t: n. 奖金, 红利
n. 城堡, 象棋中的车 / vt. 置于城堡中, 盘踞于
v.s: The site of the castle is now a park.
v.sz: 城堡的遗迹现在变成了公园。
sx: There is an old castle at the foot of the mountain.
山脚下有一座古老的城堡。
This castle is more beautiful than that.
这座城堡比那座漂亮。

v.t: n. 慈悲, 博爱, 慈善团体, 施舍
v.s: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.
v.sz: 我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。
sx: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
世界需要的是公正，不是施舍。
Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
当地企业正在联手举办一项慈善活动。

v.t: vt. 比较, 比喻, 对照 / vi. 相比 / n. 比较
v.s: Compared to a computer, a word processor has a single purpose.
v.sz: 文字处理软件和电脑不同的是，它只有一个用途。
sx: The service plan you choose will affect your user experience. Please be sure to compare the details carefully.
您选择的服务方案将影响您的使用体验，请务必仔细比较细节。
The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
下面的解释是通过比较和对比各种不同的理论。

v.t: a. 好奇的, 求知的, 古怪的
v.s: She is curious to find who sent the flowers.
v.sz: 她很想知道那束花是谁寄来的。
sx: Tom said that he was curious.
汤姆说他很好奇。
He is curious about everything.
他对什么都感好奇。

v.t: n. 发现, 被发现的事物
v.s: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
v.sz: 多数科学突破只不过是发现了显而易见的事。
sx: The discovery that electric currents can be produced by magnetism is extremely important in the field of electricity.
磁能生产电流的发明，在电力领域非常重要。
Scientific discoveries don't always make the world a better place.
科学发明并不总是使世界变得更美好。

v.t: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励
v.s: I wrote a post to my blog encouraging men to report experiences with domestic abuse.
v.sz: 我在部落格上发表了一篇文章，鼓励男性举报自己遭受家庭虐待的经历。
sx: Tom encouraged Mary to learn how to speak French.
汤姆鼓励玛丽学着说法语。
Learning should not be forced, but rather encouraged.
学习不该被强迫，而是该被鼓励。

v.t: n. 闪光, 闪现, 一瞬间 / vi. 闪光, 闪现, 反射 / vt. 使闪光, 反射
v.s: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
v.sz: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。
sx: I use flash cards to study my German vocabulary.
我用字卡来学德文生字。
Thanks God, Apple is dumping that Flash crap!
谢天谢地，苹果抛弃了 Flash 这个垃圾！

v.t: a. 正式的, 形式的, 礼仪的, 拘于礼节的, 拘谨的 / n. 正式的社交活动
v.s: There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
v.sz: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
sx: You don't have to be so formal.
你没必要那么正式。
How formal is this ceremony?
这个典礼有多正式?

v.t: n. 客套语, 公式, 准则
v.s: The chemical formula for water is H-O-H.
v.sz: 水的化学式为H-O-H。
sx: This formula is valid for all complex numbers z with a real part greater than zero.
此公式对所有实部大于零的复数 z 均成立。
Heron's Formula shows how the area of a triangle can be expressed as a function of its side lengths.
海龙公式说明了三角形的面积如何表示为其边长的函数。

v.t: n. 总数, 总量 / a. 总共的, 未打折扣的, 恶劣的, 粗野的 / vt. 总共收入
v.s: He is gross, man!
v.sz: 他是个粗鲁的人。

v.t: a. 饥饿的, 荒年的, 渴望的, 不毛的
v.s: If I had eaten breakfast this morning, I would not be hungry now.
v.sz: 如果我今早吃了早餐，现在肚子就不会这么饿了。
sx: Do you know what it is like to be really hungry?
你尝过真正饥饿的滋味吗？
Please give me something to eat. I am so hungry.
可以给我一点吃的吗？我快饿疯了啦。

v.t: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的 / n. 天真的人, 笨蛋
v.s: All of your accusations are baseless. She is innocent, and we will prove that.
v.sz: 你所有的指控都是毫无根据的。她是无辜的，并且我们将证明这一点。
sx: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
I keep saying that I'm innocent, but no one will listen.
我再三申明无罪，但是没人听我讲。

v.t: n. 数学
v.s: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
v.sz: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。
sx: In IT companies, people who are good at maths are well respected.
在 IT 公司里，数学好的人容易得到尊敬。
She is inferior to him in math.
她在数学上不如他。

v.t: n. 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘
v.s: Psycho-horror films dealing with the mysteries of human psychology are popular these days.
v.sz: 这几年有关心理之谜的心理恐怖片很热门。
sx: Who is able to reveal the mysteries of the sea?
谁能揭开海洋的奥秘？
One of the great mysteries of life is how a cat decides what to do next.
生活的伟大奥秘其中之一是猫如何决定下一步要做什么。

v.t: n. 宫, 宫殿, 华丽大厦
v.s: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
v.sz: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。
sx: Farther from the palace and to its north and south were the commoners, merchants, artisans, and laborers.
远离宫殿的北方及南方是平民、商人、工艺师傅和工人。
To hide the fact that she's a princess, she disguised herself as a boy and escaped the palace.
她为了掩饰自己公主的身份，女扮男装，逃出了皇宫。

v.t: n. 处罚, 刑罚, 罚款, 罚球, 报应, 不利结果, 妨碍
v.s: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
v.sz: 球迷们安静下来，绷紧神经，观看两支球队的点球大战。
sx: Is the incurrence of this penalty correct?
这个点球的判罚正确吗？
We should abolish the death penalty.
我们应该废除死刑。

v.t: n. 抗议, 反对, 抗议书, 断言 / v. 反对, 抗议, 断言
v.s: The residents protested outside the sex shop that opened in their neighborhood recently.
v.sz: 居民们在一家开在邻近的性用品商店前抗议。
sx: Their small protest triggered a mass demonstration.
他们小型的示威引发了一场大规模的游行。
People are protesting in Hong Kong.
人们在香港抗议。

v.t: n. 出版物, 出版, 公布
v.s: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
v.sz: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

v.t: vt. 提交, 归诸于, 把...提交, 使求助于 / vi. 提到, 涉及, 查阅, 查询, 咨询
v.s: Refer to the dictionary as often as possible.
v.sz: 尽可能多点查字典。
sx: Please refer to page ten.
请参看第十页。

v.t: adv. 各自地, 独自地, 个别地, 分别地
a. 挑选出来的, 极好的 / v. 选择, 挑选 / n. 被挑选者, 精萃
v.s: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
v.sz: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。
sx: He selected a Christmas gift for her.
他给她选了件圣诞礼物。
I was not selected.
我落选了。

v.t: a. 沉默的, 安静的, 无声的, 静止的
v.s: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
v.sz: 球迷们安静下来，绷紧神经，观看两支球队的点球大战。
sx: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.
自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。
First of all, power off your cellphones and remain silent.
首先，关闭手机，保持安静。

v.t: adv. 成功, 结果良好, 有成就
v.s: He was extremely happy at having successfully solved the problem.
v.sz: 成功地解决了这个问题，对此他感到十分高兴。
sx: By switching your lover from 3D to 2D, you may successfully reduce all social-interaction-related costs.
把恋人从3D换成2D可以有效地降低交际所需的费用。
Viking 1 and 2 became the first spacecraft to successfully land on the surface of Mars.
维京1号和2号成为了最先在火星表面成功著陆的空间探测器。

v.t: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受 / vi. 受痛苦, 受损害
v.s: It was evident that everyone was upset when Atletico Madrid suffered defeat.
v.sz: 马德里竞技遭遇失败后，很明显大家都很生气。
sx: The woman has suffered from a collapse, because she ate meat from a water buffalo.
女人食用水牛肉导致晕厥。
All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
一旦爆发核战争，受苦的将会是全人类。

v.t: n. 叔父, 伯父, 姨丈
v.s: My uncle kept on drinking in spite of his doctor's advice.
v.sz: 我叔叔不顾医生劝阻，还是继续喝酒。
sx: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.
我的一个叔叔给我了一些有用的建议。
Now all you have to do is tighten the screw, and Bob's your uncle.
现在你只要拧紧螺丝，就大功告成了。

v.t: a. 不寻常的, 罕见的, 与众不同的
v.s: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
v.sz: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。
sx: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
He is endowed with unusual ability in mathematics.
他天生具有不寻常的数学能力。

v.t: n. 到达, 抵达, 到达者
v.s: With the arrival of winter, the leaves on the trees fall down.
v.sz: 树上的叶子随着冬天的到来而掉落。
sx: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
他们到达的确切时间还不明。
Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
女士们，先生们，由于机场的意外情况，我们的著陆将被推迟。

v.t: n. 意识, 认识
v.s: April 2nd is World Autism Awareness Day.
v.sz: 4月2日是世界提高自闭症意识日。
sx: Developing political awareness takes time.
培养政治意识要花费时间。
Language is awareness.
语言就是意识。

v.t: adv. 严重地, 恶劣地, 极度地
v.s: I am very much surprised to hear that he got badly injured in a motorcar accident.
v.sz: 他因车祸受了重伤的消息让我震惊万分。
sx: If you ever come back to me, I'll never treat you badly again.
如果你肯回到我的身边，我一定会永远好好待你。
Although he was born in England, he speaks English very badly.
他虽然是在英国出生的，但英语却说得很差。

v.t: n. 沐浴, 浴室
v.s: I like to take a hot bath every night before bed.
v.sz: 我喜欢在每晚睡觉前洗个热水澡。
sx: On the winter solstice we have a hot bath with yuzu citrus fruits in it.
冬至时，我们泡热水澡，池中会加柚子。
Last night I was dead drunk and fell asleep without having a bath.
昨夜，我烂醉了，我没洗澡就睡觉了。

v.t: n. 追求, 狩猎, 追逐 / vt. 追捕, 追逐, 雕刻, 在...上镶嵌宝石 / vi. 追赶, 奔跑
v.s: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?
v.sz: 你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？
sx: The cat chased the mouse around the house.
猫在房子里追老鼠。
The hunter chases the rabbit in the fields.
猎人在田野追兔子

v.t: adv. 深刻地, 在深处, 深沉地
v.s: The zodiac culture is deeply rooted in people's daily life and linguistic culture.
v.sz: 生肖文化深深植根于人们的日常生活和语言文化中。
sx: The culture of the Chinese zodiac is deeply rooted in people's lives, language and literature.
生肖文化深深植根于人们的日常生活和语言文化中。
I'm a deeply religious man and believe in life after death.
我是一个虔诚的教徒，我相信死后的生命。

v.t: n. 解释, 说明, 辩解, 表明
v.s: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
v.sz: 下面的解释是通过比较和对比各种不同的理论。
sx: The scientists have not found any explanation for the mysterious phenomenon.
科学家们尚未找到对这神秘现象的解释。
Of course, another explanation of this situation is that Chinese is harder to learn than English.
当然，对这个情况的另一个解释是中文比英文难学。

v.t: n. 担保, 抵押品, 保证书 / vt. 保证, 担保
v.s: Playing WHAT THE CAR? with friends is a guaranteed laugh-out-loud experience.
v.sz: 与朋友玩《WHAT THE CAR?》，保证能得到让你开怀大笑的游戏体验。
sx: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
我不能确保这一切会发生。
Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
思想自由为宪法所保障。

v.t: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的
v.s: The other day something horrible happened in a Tokyo suburb.
v.sz: 前几天，东京郊外发生了件可怕的事情。
sx: This horrible hot weather is killing me.
这鬼天气，要把人热死。
I had a horrible dream last night.
我昨晚做了一个恶梦。

v.t: n. 理想, 典范, 观念, 思想, 最后目标 / a. 理想的, 完美的, 空想的, 观念的, 唯心论的
v.s: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
v.sz: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
sx: He proved to be an ideal husband.
他被证实是个理想丈夫。

v.t: n. 心情, 气氛, 生气, 基调
v.s: Hot and humid weather puts me in a bad mood.
v.sz: 天气一闷热，我的心情就不好。
sx: Tom and Mary say they aren't in the mood to do that.
汤姆和玛丽说，他们不想做那件事。
She sometimes goes into a mood of depression.
她偶尔有忧郁的心情。

v.t: n. 肌肉, 臂力
v.s: Courage is very important. Like a muscle, it is strengthened by use.
v.sz: 勇气是非常重要的。比如肌肉，经常使用才得以加强。
sx: The muscles in his legs had atrophied during the seven months he was bedridden.
他的腿部肌肉在他卧床不起的七个月中萎缩了。
Remember, exercise helps strengthen your muscles and bones.
记住，运动有助于增强肌肉和骨骼。

v.t: n. 激情, 酷爱, 热爱, 强烈感情, 耶稣受难(故事)
v.s: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
v.sz: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。
sx: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。
The soul is made up of reason, determination, and passion.
灵魂是由理性、意志和情欲构成的。

v.t: a. 高兴的, 喜欢的, 满足的
v.s: However, some people in the audience were not pleased with the results.
v.sz: 尽管如此，观众中仍有些人不满意这个结果。
sx: They were pleased at the birth of their first child.
他们第一个孩子出生了，很高兴。
Well, Bill, I am pleased to see you here.
呃，比尔，我很高兴在这里见到你。

v.t: n. 程序, 过程, 手续
v.s: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
v.sz: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。
sx: You don't understand the procedure.
你不明白流程。
The procedure is painless.
该手术无痛。

v.t: n. 生产者, 制作者, 制作人
v.s: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
v.sz: 奥地利在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。
sx: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

v.t: n. 等级, 排, 横列, 队伍, 阶级 / a. 茂密丛生的, 恶臭的, 十足的, 粗俗的 / vt. 排列, 归类于, 把...分等 / vi. 列为, 列队 / n. 秩
v.s: My brother’s in the army. He was just promoted to the rank of major.
v.sz: 我的哥哥在军队里.他刚刚被提升为少校.
sx: Her smooth entry into the ranks of the royal family will help to dispel these fears.
证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。
He is immediately above me in rank.
他的军阶比我高一级。

v.t: n. 归还, 更换, 代替者
v.s: History develops through the replacement of the old by the new.
v.sz: 新事物取代旧事物推动历史发展。

v.t: n. 沙, 沙子, 沙滩, 光阴, 生涯 / vt. 撒沙, 以沙掩盖
v.s: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
v.sz: 老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。
sx: We found the footprints in the sand.
我们发现了沙滩上的脚印。
There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
海洋底部有沙子。

v.t: n. 阴影, 荫, 影子, 影像, 阴暗, 幽灵, 少许, 隐蔽处, 庇护 / vt. 遮蔽, 使朦胧, 预示, 尾随 / vi. 渐变, 变阴暗
v.s: When the mind is pure, joy follows like a shadow that never leaves.
v.sz: 心灵纯净时，喜悦便如影随形。
sx: If you go to bed late again, tomorrow you'll wake up with shadows under your eyes.
再不早点睡觉，明天醒来就会有黑眼圈。
The shadow of the stick is visible.
立竿见影。

v.t: n. 带子, 录音带, 磁带, 窄带, 卷尺 / vt. 以带子绑起, 测量, 录音
v.s: He erased his speech from the tape.
v.sz: 他把他的那段话从磁带里删除了。
sx: Is this your tape recorder?
这是你的录音机吗？
I buy tapes.
我买磁带。

v.t: n. 工资, 报应, 报偿 / vt. 开展, 进行 / vi. 进行
v.s: The reason we're on strike is that the company hasn't improved our wages.
v.sz: 我们罢工是因为公司没有改善我们的工资。
sx: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
冲绳的最低时薪是每小时642日元。
What is the minimum wage in Georgia?
请问乔治亚洲的最低工资是多少？

v.t: a. 烦人的, 无聊的, 无趣的
v.s: All of Steve's jobs were boring or not well-paid or both.
v.sz: 所有史蒂夫的工作不是无聊就是非高薪或是两者兼而有之。
sx: Do not talk nonsense, My job is very boring!
不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！
Yesterday I became a god, but found that a bit boring, so today I became a devil.
昨天我变成了神，但没意思，所以今天我变成了鬼。

v.t: n. 时钟, 计时器, (袜子上的)绣花边花 / vt. 绣花样, 记时, 记录 / vi. 记录时间
v.s: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
v.sz: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。
sx: We start class at 9am, but he came as early as 8 o’clock.
我们早上九点上课，可是他八点就来了。
I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。

v.t: n. 委托, 交押, 承担义务, 赞助
a. 有信心的, 有把握的
v.s: He does not, in short, write with the candor of a man who is completely confident of his thesis.
v.sz: 简单来说，他的文笔并没有流露出那种对自己的论文充满信心的人应有的直率和坦诚。
sx: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
我相当有自信我能做到这一点。
Tom is very confident, isn't he?
汤姆很有信心，不是么？

v.t: n. 习惯, 风俗, 海关, 自定义 / a. 定制的
v.s: The manners and customs of a country reflect its culture.
v.sz: 一个国家的风俗习惯反映了它的文化。
sx: The first time, I spoke pretty much no Chinese at all, and didn't understand China's conventions and customs.
第一次，我差不多完全不会普通话，而且不懂中国的常规和传统。
These customs differ from those in our country.
这些习俗和我们国家不同。

v.t: n. 书桌, 办公桌, 工作台
v.s: The vase on my desk overturned when I jumped up in surprise.
v.sz: 我突然跳起来的时候把花瓶桌子上的打翻了。
sx: I noticed a note on my desk, but I do not know who wrote it.
我发现了我办公桌上有张字条, 但是我不知道是谁写的。
There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.
书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。

v.t: n. 耳朵, 倾听, 听觉, 穗 / vi. 抽穗
v.s: Then I was made aware that snakes have no ears with which to hear.
v.sz: 后来我知道了，蛇是没有用来听声音的耳朵的。
sx: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
兔子有长耳朵和短尾巴。
The ears of a rabbit are longer than those of a fox.
白兔的耳朵比狐狸长。

v.t: n. 电, 电流, 电学, 热情, 电力供应
v.s: The discovery that electric currents can be produced by magnetism is extremely important in the field of electricity.
v.sz: 磁能生产电流的发明，在电力领域非常重要。
sx: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
奥地利在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。
The machine generated large amounts of electricity.
机器发了很多电。

v.t: a. 有帮助的, 有益的, 有用的
v.s: Carlos's work as a customer service representative requires him to be friendly and helpful to customers.
v.sz: 卡洛斯的客服代表工作要求他对客户友好且乐于帮助客户。
sx: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
您那样做的话，可就帮到我了。
He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。

v.t: n. 惊骇, 恐怖, 惨状
v.s: Psycho-horror films dealing with the mysteries of human psychology are popular these days.
v.sz: 这几年有关心理之谜的心理恐怖片很热门。
sx: I'm going to see a horror film.
我要去看恐怖电影。
Does Tom like watching horror movies?
Tom喜欢看恐怖电影吗？

v.t: n. 标签, 称号, 商标, 标志 / vt. 贴标签于, 标注
v.s: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
v.sz: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。
sx: He's always putting labels on people.
他老是给别人扣帽子。
He's always slapping labels on others.
他老是给别人扣帽子。

v.t: a. 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的
v.s: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.
v.sz: 细菌微小到无法用肉眼看到。
sx: That star is visible to the naked eye.
那颗星星可以用裸眼看到。
You can see the stars with your naked eye, and even better through a telescope.
你可以用肉眼观星，用望远镜的话，还能看得更清楚。

v.t: n. 输出, 产品, 产量
n. 程度, 坡度, 顶点, 前倾, 倾斜, 投掷, 音高, 螺距, 节距, 摊位, 树脂, 沥青 / vt. 投, 掷, 向前倾跌, 扎营, 竭力推销, 为...定调, 定位于, 用沥青涂 / vi. 搭帐篷, 投掷, 向前跌, 猛然摔倒, 坠落, 倾斜
v.s: They were looking for a place at which they could pitch the tent.
v.sz: 他们在找一个可以搭帐篷的地方。
sx: Because it had been raining for a couple of days, the pitch was muddy and difficult to play on.
球队已经训练了几天，所以这个足球场有些泥泞，不太好用了。
This is a good place to pitch a tent.
这是搭帐篷的好地方。

v.t: n. 比萨饼
v.s: Pizza is the kind of food that fits into today's life style.
v.sz: 比萨是种适合现在的生活方式的食物。
sx: How many different kinds of pizzas are on the menu?
菜单上有多少种比萨？
I don't understand why pepperoni pizza is so popular.
我不懂为何义式辣肠披萨如此受欢迎。

v.t: n. 平原, 草原, 朴实无华的东西, 无格式 / a. 简单的, 明白的, 平常的, 不好看的, 朴素的, 清晰的, 普通的, 平坦的, 十足的 / adv. 清楚地, 显然地
v.s: I use Yan garments as my plain robe, and turn Liqiu into ruins.
v.sz: 以兖衣为褋兮，以黎邱为墟。
sx: Stracciatella ice-cream is nothing but a plain ice-cream with chocolate chips.
斯特拉恰泰拉冰淇淋只不过是一种添加了巧克力碎的普通冰淇淋。
Mary is fairly plain, but Tom thinks she's the bee's knees.
玛丽是个平淡无奇的人，但是汤姆却认为她出类拔萃。

v.t: vt. 露出, 显示, 透露, 揭露, 泄露, (神)启示 / n. 窗侧, 门侧
v.s: It reveals local executives' ambitions of bringing the region back to the top.
v.sz: 这表明了地方领导恢复地区卓越水平的雄心。
sx: Who is able to reveal the mysteries of the sea?
谁能揭开海洋的奥秘？
At last, the truth was revealed to us.
真相总算在我们面前揭晓了。

v.t: a. 战略的, 战略上的
v.s: This project offers strategic advantages for Algeria.
v.sz: 这项专案给阿尔及利亚带来策略性优势。

v.t: n. 游泳, 眩晕
v.s: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
v.sz: 这间游泳学校每个月的学费是多少？
sx: If you stay at a big hotel, you can use their swimming pool.
若你住到的是大的旅馆，就能使用他们的游泳池。
I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.
童年时我会去海里游泳。

v.t: n. 福利, 安宁, 幸福, 福利事业 / a. 福利的
v.s: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
v.sz: 法国是一个福利国家，但它却不再能够负担得起了。
sx: He works at the welfare office.
他在福利办事处上班。

v.t: n. 电线, 电报, 电信, 铁丝网, 金属丝 / vt. 用金属丝捆扎, 拍电报 / vi. 打电报
v.s: Is the wire live? I can tell just by touching it.
v.sz: 电线有没有电？我一摸就知道。
sx: Wires are used to convey electricity.
电线被用来运送电力。
Having forgotten his key, he was able to open the door by inserting a wire in the keyhole.
他没带钥匙，用铁丝拨动了两下，门居然开了。

v.t: n. 工人, 劳动者
v.s: He is not so much a genius as a hard worker.
v.sz: 他很勤奋但不是很有天赋。
sx: He had gone there to help garbage workers strike peacefully for better pay and working conditions.
他去了那里帮助清洁工人和平地争取更高的薪金和更好的工作环境。
Thousands of workers and artisans toiled for 22 years to create this breathtaking white marble structure.
数千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出这座令人惊叹的白色大理石建筑。

v.t: adv. 然后, 后来
v.s: In addition, we will issue the 'employee of the month' award afterwards.
v.sz: 另外，之后我们会颁发“每月最佳员工”奖。
sx: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。
Afterwards, he set off for Villain Valley.
然后他出发去了恶人谷。

v.t: n. 忿怒 / vt. 激怒, 使发怒 / vi. 发怒
v.s: I am really extremely angry, so I plan to smash things to vent my anger.
v.sz: 我实在气得不得了，所以打算砸东西发泄。
sx: You're really the best when, and only when, it comes to angering people.
你只有惹事最能。
Jim was able to hold back his anger and avoid a fight.
Jim抑制住了怒火，避免了一场斗争。

v.t: n. 建筑学, 建筑式样
v.s: Sixty-four-bit software will not run on 32-bit architecture.
v.sz: 64位的软件在32位架构的系统上跑不起来。
sx: I call architecture frozen music.
我将建筑称作被冻结的音乐。

v.t: n. 帮助, 协助 / vt. 帮助, 促进 / vi. 协助, 参加
v.s: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
v.sz: 我想请你帮我整理花园。
sx: I'll be able to assist you.
我能协助你。
I'm here to assist you.
我来协助你。

v.t: n. 利益, 方面
v.s: On behalf of the company, I would like to express our hearty thanks to you all.
v.sz: 在此仅代表本公司向各位致上衷心的谢意。
sx: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
请代我向你的家人问好。
On behalf of the company, I welcome you.
我代表公司欢迎你的来临。

v.t: n. 带子, 地带
v.s: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
v.sz: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。
sx: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。
Fasten your seat belt at all times.
无论何时都要扣好安全带。

v.t: n. 抓取, 战利品, 捕获之物 / vt. 抓取, 获得, 迷住
v.s: To be honest, we came to capture you.
v.sz: 老实说，我们是来抓你的。
sx: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。
He said Davis must be captured.
他说戴维斯必须被抓住。

v.t: n. 设计者, 谋划者, 制图者
v.s: In the hands of a skilled designer, any two colors can go well together.
v.sz: 无论是多么不协和的两种颜色，在技术高超的设计师手里，也能化成悦目的配搭。
sx: These dresses were designed by the same designer.
这几套衣服是同一位服装师设计的.
She hopes to become a designer.
她希望成为一名设计师。

v.t: n. 钻石, 菱形
v.s: What is the difference between imitation and real diamonds?
v.sz: 假的钻石和真的钻石有甚么分别？
sx: This may not be a real diamond.
这可能不是一颗真的钻石。
Her diamond is sparkling under the light.
她的钻石在亮光下闪闪发光。

v.t: a. 失望的
v.s: I was really disappointed when I found out that I hadn't passed the exam.
v.sz: 当我发现我没通过测验时我实在是太沮丧了。
sx: We were more or less disappointed about the election.
我们或多或少对这次的选举感到失望。
Jack was really disappointed, and left his job.
杰克很失望，并辞了职。

v.t: n. 经济学
v.s: Excuse me, do you know where the economics department library is?
v.sz: 不好意思，请问你知道经济学部图书馆在哪里吗？
sx: He is a great authority on economics.
他是权威的经济学家。
I'm studying economics at university.
我正在大学里读经济。

v.t: a. 有效率的, 能干的
v.s: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
v.sz: 无可否认她非常有能力。

v.t: a. 电的, 有关电的
v.s: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
v.sz: 这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。
sx: Keep away from the electrical equipment.
远离电器设备。
Did you know that if you plug a pickle into an electrical outlet, it glows and makes buzzing noises?
你知道如果你把泡菜插入电源插座，它会发光并且发出嗡嗡的声音吗？

v.t: adv. 本质上, 本来
v.s: It is essentially a question of time.
v.sz: 它本质上是一个时间的问题。

v.t: n. 确立, 制定, 设施
n. 花, 开花植物, 精华, 盛时 / vi. 开花, 发育, 旺盛, 成熟 / vt. 用花装饰, 使开花
v.s: In all the gardens in my city, stepping on the flower beds is illegal.
v.sz: 在我的城市的所有花园里，践踏花坛是违法的。
sx: North China is cold in spring, so flowers don't bloom outdoors.
春季的时候，中国北边很冷，所以在外边的花不开花。
I'm going to exhibit my roses at the flower show.
我要把我的玫瑰拿到花展上展示。

v.t: n. 装备, 工具箱, 成套工具
v.s: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
v.sz: 别忘了带上急救箱。

v.t: n. 实验室, 研究室
v.s: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
v.sz: 实验室里的空调坏了。
sx: The natural world is always much more complex than formulations in the lab or blueprints in the design office.
自然界从来都比试验室的配方或设计院的图纸里所反映的要复杂得多。

v.t: a. 神经紧张的, 不安的, 神经的
v.s: Tomorrow is the first time I will accompany the Chinese delegation, and I'm extremely nervous.
v.sz: 明天第一次陪中国代表团， 我紧张得不得了。
sx: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.
他被很多人围着，自然变得有点紧张。
The student became very nervous with the teacher watching him.
那个学生被老师盯著看，觉得浑身不自在。

v.t: adv. 重新, 最近
v.s: It only takes 20 minutes to get to school by the newly opened subway.
v.sz: 坐新开的地铁上学只需要 20 分钟。
sx: Going to the newly built Greenland in Shanghai is really fun!
去上海新建的绿地玩也特有劲！
Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？

v.t: a. 奇数的, 古怪的, 剩余的, 零散的, 各种各样的, 少量的 / n. 奇特的事物, 怪人
v.s: Don't you think it odd that she was in such a hurry?
v.sz: 她那么匆匆忙忙的，你不觉得很奇怪吗？
sx: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.
那两个部门有时候意见相左。
He is the odd one of the family.
他是家族中的异类。

v.t: a. 平常的, 普通的, 平凡的 / n. 平常的人(或事)
v.s: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.
v.sz: 生活真正的艺术是在平凡中看到不平凡。
sx: In hard times like this, no ordinary effort can get our company out of the red.
在这种困难的时候，任何寻常的努力都无法使我们的公司摆脱赤字。
This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
这里是普通中学的化学实验室。

v.t: vi. 参加, 分享, 参与, 带有 / vt. 分享, 分担
v.s: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
v.sz: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。
sx: Did you say you wanted to participate in the meeting?
你们说了要参加会议了吗？
My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。

v.t: n. 祈祷, 恳求, 祷辞, 祈祷者
v.s: It's Friday, and so we have to perform our prayers.
v.sz: 今天是星期五，所以我们需要祷告。
sx: Thoughts and prayers.
思念和祈祷。

v.t: adv. 很少地, 罕有地
v.s: He promised to bring new industries to the region, but politicians rarely keep their word.
v.sz: 他承诺给这个地区带来新的工业，但是政治家很少完成他们的承诺。
sx: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。
I like garlic but, because of the smell, I rarely eat it.
虽然我喜欢大蒜，但因为很臭，所以很少吃。

v.t: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人
v.s: As usual the Spanish team are showing off their skills at one-touch football.
v.sz: 西班牙队像往常一样炫耀他们一脚传球的球技。
sx: Skilled soldiers know how to use their environment as a weapon.
熟练的士兵知道怎么以他们的环境为武器。
You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
你要学的是实实在在的技能，而不单是表面的知识。

v.t: n. 土壤, 土地, 国家, 国土, 温床, 污物, 粪便, 水池 / vt. 弄脏, 污辱 / vi. 变脏
v.s: It is still raining a lot today, and the soil is being broken up.
v.sz: 今天下这么大的雨，土松着呢。
sx: She renewed the soil in the flower pot.
她更新了花盆里的土。
Nothing seems to grow in this soil.
这个土壤似乎长不出任何东西来。

v.t: vt. 解决, 付给, 溶解 / vt. 求解 / vi. 求解
v.s: Science is still not capable of solving all of life's problems.
v.sz: 科学还无法解决所有生活上的问题。
sx: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.
这个问题不能以常规方法解决。
This is the best method to solve that problem.
这是解决那个问题的最佳办法。

v.t: n. 胃, 食欲, 欲望, 肚子 / vt. 吃下, 忍受
v.s: I developed a tumor in my stomach, which required surgery.
v.sz: 我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。
sx: I got a stomach tumor and had to have it operated on.
我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。
All of a sudden, I felt a sharp pain in my stomach.
我突然肚痛得要命。

v.t: vt. 吸, 吮, 吸入, 吮吸, 吸收 / vi. 吸, 吸奶 / n. 吸, 吸入, 吮吸
v.s: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
v.sz: 我用吸尘机把地上的灰尘吸掉了。
sx: You suck dude! I have to tell you everything!
你好烂哦！ 我什么事都需要跟你讲！
It must suck to be you.
你真可怜。

v.t: n. 垃圾, 废物 / vt. 丢弃
v.s: By 2025, Indonesia is expected to generate 150 thousand tons of trash per day.
v.sz: 到 2025 年，印尼预计每天将产生 15 万公吨垃圾。
sx: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
这个垃圾袋不含任何有害化学物质。
There's a lot of trash on the far bank of the river.
河对岸有很多的垃圾。

v.t: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的 / n. 丑陋的人(或物)
v.s: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.
v.sz: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
sx: Compared to the others, doesn't the French passport look ugly?
跟其它的比，法国护照有多难看啊。
It's not the person that's ugly, but the clothes.
难看的不是人的外貌，而是人的衣服。

v.t: n. 病毒, 滤过性病毒, 毒害
v.s: Tom got a computer virus while he was watching videos on dubious Internet sites.
v.sz: 汤姆在可疑的网站上看视频的时候中了电脑病毒。
sx: My computer has already been infected with the BraveSentry virus.
我的电脑已经中了BraveSentry病毒。
Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
埃博拉是人类已知的最致命的病毒之一。

v.t: pron. 任何人, 无论谁
v.s: Whoever said money can't buy happiness simply didn't know where to go shopping.
v.sz: 那些说钱不能买来幸福的人，只是不知道上哪里去买而已。
sx: You may give this picture to whoever wants it.
你可以随意把相片送给想要它的人。
She will give her picture to whoever wants it.
她会把她的照片给想要的人。

v.t: n. 外观, 方面, 面貌, 方向
v.s: Do you think that you are qualified for that aspect of the work?
v.sz: 你认为可以胜任那些方面的工作？
sx: Are there any aspects of Shanghai that are not as good as those of Beijing?
上海有什么不如北京的方面吗？
Which aspects of Chinese medicine do you specialise in?
您专攻于中医的什么领域？

v.t: n. 舒适, 安慰, 安慰者 / vt. 安慰
v.s: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
v.sz: 他的薪金很高，所以生活也过得很舒适。
sx: He worked hard in order that his family might live in comfort.
他努力工作为了让他的家人可以过舒适的生活。
You're just comforting yourself with a fantasy!
你这样就是画饼充饥！

v.t: n. 堂兄弟姊妹, 表兄弟姊妹
v.s: My cousin is so steeped in schoolwork that his friends call him bookworm.
v.sz: 我的表兄弟太过沉浸于学业，以致于他的朋友们唤他作书虫。
sx: My cousin, who is a lawyer, is in France at present.
我的律师表哥现在在法国。
Even if your friend is a doctor and your cousin is a pharmacist, you will still have to die.
就算你朋友是医生、堂表亲是药剂师，该死的时候还是得死。

v.t: n. 裂缝, 爆裂声 / v. (使)爆裂, (使)裂开, (使)发出爆裂声 / a. 第一流的 / adv. 啪地一声
v.s: Mary took an egg and cracked it open on the rim of the bowl.
v.sz: 玛丽娅拿了一个鸡蛋，并将它在碗沿上敲开。
sx: There was a crack in my tennis racket, so I sent it out to be repaired.
我的网球拍裂了，所以我把它拿去修了。
Tom tried to crack a walnut without damaging its kernel.
汤姆试图敲碎一颗核桃而不损坏果仁。

v.t: a. 戏剧性的, 生动的
n. 灰尘, 尘埃, 粉末, 花粉, 土, 骚乱 / vt. 拂去灰尘, 撒, 弄成粉末 / vi. 拂去灰尘, 化为粉末
v.s: Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.
v.sz: 宇航服保护宇航员们不会因和微小宇宙尘埃碰撞而受伤。
sx: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
我用吸尘机把地上的灰尘吸掉了。
All the furniture was covered with dust.
所有的家具都布满了灰尘。

v.t: n. 疾病, 恶意
v.s: Almost two weeks went by before John recovered from his illness.
v.sz: 差不多两周John的病才好了。
sx: I don't feel well today. That well water is the cause of many illnesses.
我今天有点不舒服。那户井水是许多疾病的源头。
If I had known about your illness, I could have visited you in the hospital.
如果我知道你病了，怎么也会赶来看你的。

v.t: n. 机构, 惯例, 制度
n. 小刀, 匕首 / vt. 切割, 伤害, 切, 戳 / vi. 劈开, 穿过
v.s: A knife covered in blood was recovered at the crime scene.
v.sz: 犯罪现场发现了一把沾满鲜血的刀。
sx: If it's okay for him to buy a knife, then why on earth can't I?
他买一把刀行，我买就不行了吗？
He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.
他用哥哥送给他的刀子切开了。

v.t: n. 少数, 未成年, 少数民族 / a. 少数的, 属于少数派的
v.s: April is the national minority health month.
v.sz: 四月是全国弱势团体医疗月。

v.t: n. 菊花, 沉默 / a. 沉默的 / vi. 演哑剧 / interj. 别说话
v.s: My mum helps me remove the core of the plum.
v.sz: 妈妈帮我把李子去了核。
sx: Mum, why doesn't Dad clean his own study?
妈妈，为什么爸爸不把他的书房打扫干净？
When you speak Shanghainese with your mum, I only understand a few words, so I can't join in the conversation.
你和你妈用上海话聊天的时候，我只听得懂几个词，所以我插不上话。

v.t: n. 优先权, 优先
v.s: Camera quality is a top priority for me.
v.sz: 相机品质是我的优先考量。

v.t: n. 晋级, 创建, 增进
v.s: Recently T Mall has had a sales promotion on cell phones.
v.sz: 最近天猫上有手机促销活动。
sx: The promotion of a piece to a king is indicated by setting on it another piece of the same color.
在一颗棋子上放置另一颗相同颜色的棋子，可以表示这颗棋子晋升为王。
James Cameron personally did the official promotion!
卡神亲自官宣！

v.t: n. 横杆, 围栏, 栏杆, 铁轨, 扶手, 秧鸡 / vt. 以横木围栏, 给...铺铁轨 / vi. 责骂, 抱怨
v.s: Is it convenient to transfer between the subway and the light rail here?
v.sz: 这儿要换地铁和轻轨方便吗？
sx: The UK must improve the problems with its rail network.
英国必须改善它在铁路网的问题。
A lot of people climb the railing, and even litter.
很多人跳过栏杆，还丢垃圾。

v.t: a. 遥远的, 偏僻的, 疏远的, 微少的
v.s: She was born in a remote village in Nepal.
v.sz: 她出生于尼泊尔的一个偏远小山村。
sx: We sat talking about the remote past.
我们坐着谈很久以前的事。
How do the TV remote controls work?
电视遥控器是怎么运作的？

v.t: n. 修理, 补救, 修复 / vt. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 补偿 / vi. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 去, 常去, 集合
v.s: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
v.sz: 有人发现一个老工人在车间修机器。
sx: Isn't this just tearing down the east wall to repair the west wall?
这不就是拆了东墙补西墙吗？
It cost me ten thousand yen to have my television set repaired.
把我的电视机修好花了我一万日元。

v.t: n. 根, 根本, 根源, 基础, 底部 / vt. 使扎根, 使固定, 根除, 肃清, 搜出, 用鼻拱 / vi. 生根, 固定, 源于, 用鼻拱土, 寻找, 捧场, 支持
v.s: We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.
v.sz: 我们上课时学了九的根是三。
sx: The lack of money is the root of all evil.
所有的罪恶源于金钱的不足
The culture of the Chinese zodiac is deeply rooted in people's lives, language and literature.
生肖文化深深植根于人们的日常生活和语言文化中。

v.t: vt. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；vi. 窃取；偷偷地行动；[棒球]偷垒；n. [口]偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；[篮球]断球
v.s: He was detected in the very act of stealing.
v.sz: 他在行窃的时后被发现。
sx: Sleep is the greatest thief, for it steals half one's life.
睡眠是最大的小偷，它偷了我们一半的生命。
I'll let you off this time, but I don't ever want to catch you stealing again.
今次就原谅你吧，但我不希望再看见你偷东西。

v.t: n. 电话, 电话机 / v. 打电话
v.s: It cannot be denied that we cannot do without the telephone in our modern life.
v.sz: 不可否认的，在现代生活中我们不能没有电话。
sx: I was getting ready to go out. At that time, the telephone rang.
我正准备出门呢，就在那时，电话铃响了。
I was just about to leave the house when the telephone rang.
我正要离开家的时候电话响了。

v.t: conj. 然而, 鉴于
v.s: Mary is a very promising student, whereas Tom promises much but achieves little.
v.sz: 玛丽是个很有前途的学生，而汤姆则是光说不练。

v.t: n. 出价 / v. 命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标
v.s: I bid you greetings and may there be peace through fellowship between us.
v.sz: 我向你们致以问候，愿我们之间的友谊带来和平。
sx: How much did you bid?
你出价多少？

v.t: n. 好朋友, 伙伴
v.s: I'm meeting a buddy tomorrow who's arriving from France.
v.sz: 我明天要和一位从法国来的朋友见面。
sx: We've always been very good fuck buddies.
我们一直是很好的炮友。
Why is my buddy an idiot?
为什么我的兄弟是笨蛋？

v.t: n. 奶油, 黄油 / vt. 涂黄油于
v.s: I watched as my grandmother pulled a golden butter pie from the oven.
v.sz: 我看著奶奶从烤箱里拿出一个金黄色的奶油派。
sx: The store sells foodstuffs, such as butter, cheese, and sugar.
这家店卖的是牛油、奶酪、砂糖之类的食品。
To make a cake, you need egg, butter and sugar.
要做蛋糕，你要用到鸡蛋，黄油和糖。

v.t: n. 结论, 结尾, 推论
v.s: I would still like to hear Tom's opinion before coming to a conclusion.
v.sz: 在得出结论之前，还是想先听听汤姆的意见。
sx: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true story.
我们的结论就是，那个传言是真的。
Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
汤姆得出无论他做什么，玛丽都不会喜欢的结论。

v.t: vt. 证实, 确定, 批准, 使巩固
v.s: They confirmed to me that there weren't any goods left.
v.sz: 他们向我保证没有任何物品剩下。
sx: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.
我想要再确认一下我的航班。
We will confirm your order as follows.
您的订单确认如下。

v.t: a. 有分寸的, 得体的, 大方的
v.s: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.
v.sz: 我父母在的时候，请你言语注意分寸。
sx: Tom is a decent sort of guy.
汤姆是个诚实的孩子。

v.t: n. 衰退, 跌落, 下降 / vt. 使降低, 婉谢 / vi. 下降, 衰落, 偏斜
v.s: We can't just look on dejectedly while this city continues to go into decline.
v.sz: 我们不能愁闷地看着这个城市就这样衰退下去。
sx: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。
The activity of foreign trade has been declining of late.
最近对外贸易活动减少了。

v.t: n. 耽搁, 迟滞 / v. 耽搁, 延迟
v.s: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
v.sz: 一些航班由于地震被延误了。
sx: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。
Although the accident has delayed progress by one month, we have managed to catch up with the schedule.
尽管事故使进度延迟了一个月，我们还是设法赶上了日程表。

v.t: n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳 / a. 沙漠的, 不毛的 / vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离 / vi. 逃掉
v.s: A goatherd drove his goats, all white with snow, into a deserted cave for shelter.
v.sz: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。
sx: A camel is to the desert what a ship is to the sea.
骆驼是沙漠之舟。
The golf course is completely deserted. There is not a single person!
高尔夫球场门可罗雀，一个人都没有！

v.t: n. 市中心区 / a. 市中心的 / adv. 往闹市区
v.s: The downtown area is the heart of the city.
v.sz: 市中心是城市之心。
sx: For example, if I want to get downtown what bus should I take?
比如说，我要到市中心，有什么车子可以坐吗？
Traffic downtown is all backed up.
市中心的交通都堵塞了。

v.t: adv. 往前, 以后, 向外
v.s: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
v.sz: 他在门前走来走去，不知道该不该进去。
sx: From that day forth he merely tasted his food, and only just moistened his lips with drink.
从那时开始他就只是尝一尝他的食物，也仅仅只是用饮料润湿了嘴唇而已。
Sami and Layla kept texting back and forth.
萨米和莱拉不停地来回发短信。

v.t: n. 租金, 租用, 雇用 / vt. 雇请, 出租 / vi. 受雇
v.s: We're going to hire the most famous makeup artist for our cast's makeup.
v.sz: 我们将邀请最有名的化妆师为我们的演员化妆。
sx: I'm glad we hired you for this job.
我很高兴我们录用了你来担任这份工作。
That company hires people without regard to race, religion, or nationality.
这家公司不分种族、宗教或国籍雇用人。

v.t: n. 层, 产卵鸡, 放置者 / vt. 分层堆积, 压植
v.s: As this is a cascade with multiple layers, it shouldn't be surprising that it's slow.
v.sz: 因为这是一个有好几层的瀑布，所以速度慢也不会让人惊讶。
sx: The deep layers of the ocean are still almost unexplored.
海洋的深层仍然几乎未被探索。
I have a dull pain in my temples and my mind feels like its covered with a thin layer of fog.
太阳穴钝钝地痛，意识似乎被笼罩上了一层薄薄的雾霭。

v.t: vt. 与...结婚, 娶, 嫁 / vi. 结婚
v.s: Her life goal is to marry a rich man.
v.sz: 她的人生目标就是找个有钱的老公。
sx: I told him, once and for all, that I would not marry him.
我告诉他，我永远不会嫁给他。
I'd like to marry a girl who likes to play video games.
我想和一个喜欢打电动的女孩结婚。

v.t: adv. 无处, 到处都无
v.s: There is nowhere in the whole world without poverty.
v.sz: 全世界没有一个地方没有贫穷。
sx: At my house, I have nowhere to study - it's too noisy there.
我在自己家中哪里都不能读书，那里太吵了。
Prolonging the discussion will bring us nowhere.
继续讨论下去，也不会有甚么结果。

v.t: n. 护士, 保姆, 奶妈 / vt. 看护, 照顾, 培养 / vi. 喂奶, 看护病人
v.s: My father and I nursed my sister back to health after her accident.
v.sz: 我妹妹出事之后，我爸爸和我照顾她直到康复。
sx: Most letters from his wife were read to him by the nurse in the hospital.
他住院时，大部分太太给他写的信由护士读给他听。
Tom's mother is a nurse at the hospital that's across the street from where Mary lives.
汤姆的妈妈是一名护士，她所在的医院就在玛丽住的那条街的对面。

v.t: vt. 获得, 达到 / vi. 流行, 得到公认
v.s: He obtained a picture which Picasso had painted in his later years.
v.sz: 他获得了一幅毕卡索晚年的画作。
sx: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
必须获得有关当局的批准才能进入这座建筑物。
There is nothing wrong with knowledge obtained by asking.
问人而知，并非过错。

v.t: a. 器官的, 有机的, 组织的, 根本的
v.s: Organic kale is hand picked, washed and packed on site at Sprouting Farms, West Virginia, for retail and wholesale.
v.sz: 有机羽衣甘蓝在西维吉尼亚州的 Sprouting Farms 现场手工采摘、清洗和包装，提供零售和批发。
sx: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
汤姆和玛丽拥有一个小型的有机农场。

v.t: n. 所有权, 物主身份
v.s: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
v.sz: 管理一间公司和拥有一间公司是不能相提并论的两回事。

v.t: n. 诗, 韵文, 诗歌艺术
v.s: Enjambment is when a sentence from one line of poetry spills over into the next line.
v.sz: 跨行是指一句话在诗歌中从一行跨到下一行的情况。
sx: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
他们视乔叟为英诗之父。
Li Bai's work is the most famous of Chinese poetry.
中国诗歌以李白的诗最为有名。

v.t: n. 盆, 罐, 壶, 坩埚, 奖杯 / vt. 装入盆中, 在锅中煮, 随手射击 / vi. 随手射击
v.s: I found a pot in which there were several old coins.
v.sz: 我找到一个装有几枚古钱币的锅子。
sx: The food at this hot pot restaurant tastes really good. Let's come here again next time.
这家火锅店的味道真不错，下次我们再来吃吧。
While camping, Tom gave Mary dysentery by not thoroughly cleaning the pots and pans.
露营时，汤姆没有彻底清洗锅碗瓢盆，导致玛莉得了痢疾。

v.t: v. 祈祷, 恳求, 请
v.s: They knelt down and prayed that the war would end soon.
v.sz: 他们跪了下来祈祷，希望战争快点结束。
sx: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
现在我们什么也做不了，救不了汤姆。我们唯一能做的就是祈祷。
In Tbilisi, you can find the only mosque in the world where shia and sunni Muslims pray together.
在第比利斯，你可以看到世界上唯一一座什叶派和逊尼派穆斯林一起祈祷的清真寺。

v.t: n. 回忆, 召回, 撤消 / vt. 回想, 回忆, 召回, 撤消, 使恢复
v.s: I can't recall her name at the moment.
v.sz: 我突然想不起她的名字。
sx: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.
大使被从华沙召回。

v.t: n. 目的, 缘故, 理由
v.s: For the sake of living things, please do not play around with the water.
v.sz: 关爱生命，请勿嬉水。
sx: I gave up smoking for the sake of my health.
为健康戒了烟。
It is ridiculous to change what the majority are accustomed to just for the sake of a small number of people.
为了少数人而改变多数人习以为常的事物是一种愚蠢的做法。

v.t: n. 床单, 张, 纸张, 印刷品, 裹尸布, 薄片 / vt. 盖上被单, 遍布 / vi. 大片落下 / a. 片状的, 成薄片的
v.s: You put away the sheets, and I'll make the bed.
v.sz: 你把床单收起来，我整理一下床。
sx: The sea is deep blue, and from afar it looks like a vast sheet of silk spread out.
海水蓝蓝的，远远看去像一大片丝绸铺开。
Sami was writing on that sheet of paper.
莎米在那张纸上写字。

v.t: a. 平滑的, 平稳的, 流畅的, 和蔼的, 安祥的, 圆滑的, 调匀的, 无毛的 / vt. 使光滑, 烫平, 使平和, 消除 / vi. 变平滑, 变平静 / n. 一块平地, 平滑部分
v.s: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
v.sz: 将混合物搅拌均匀。
sx: Her smooth entry into the ranks of the royal family will help to dispel these fears.
证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。
This scarf feels soft and smooth.
这条围巾摸起来又软又滑。

v.t: a. 精神上的, 神圣的, 崇高的, 高尚的, 鬼的, 招魂术的 / n. 有关教会的事
v.s: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
v.sz: 我们的生活不是由物质，而是由精神来决定的。

v.t: n. 线, 细绳, 一串, 字符串 / vt. 串起, 成串, 收紧, 缚, 扎 / vi. 成一串
v.s: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
v.sz: 专家就好像一台只有一根弦的小提琴一样。
sx: The different colored strings indicate different fillings.
不同颜色的绳子表示不同的馅料。
Tom attached the string to the kite.
汤姆把绳子加在了这个风筝上。

v.t: n. 突然, 忽然 / a. 突然的, 意外的, 快速的
v.s: As I returned from school yesterday, I was caught in a sudden shower.
v.sz: 昨天我在放学回家的路上突然遇上了一阵大雨。
sx: All of a sudden, three dogs appeared in front of us.
突然之间，三只狗出现在我们面前。
All of a sudden I'm filled with great admiration for you!
我瞬间对你肃然起敬！

v.t: n. 假期, 休假
v.s: I went to Hawaii on vacation for a couple of weeks.
v.sz: 我去夏威夷休假了两周。
sx: In any case, just tell me if you want to come to Tianjin for a vacation.
反正你想来天津玩跟我说。
I went to the Hsinchu Science Park during summer vacation and saw many high-tech companies.
我暑假去了新竹科技园区，见识了许多高科技公司。

v.t: adv. 往国外, 到室外, 到处 / a. 往国外的, 在室外的, 广泛四散的
v.s: Canada is a good place to go if it's your first experience living abroad.
v.sz: 如果你是第一次到外国生活的话，加拿大会很适合你。
sx: The President is usually accompanied by his wife when he goes abroad.
总统出国通常有妻子陪伴。
He has written lots of books about his experience abroad.
他写了很多书讲述他在外国的经历。

v.t: n. 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物 / vt. 使联合, 使发生联系 / vi. 交往
v.s: We associate the name of Einstein with the theory of relativity.
v.sz: 一提到爱因斯坦，我们就会想起相对论。
sx: Hutongs are a type of narrow street, most commonly associated with Beijing, China.
胡同是一种跟中国北京有关的窄街路。
We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
一提到进化论，我们就会想起达尔文。

v.t: n. 长椅子
v.s: I'm going to sit on the bench over there next to the street lamp.
v.sz: 我会在那盏街灯旁边的长凳上坐下来。
sx: The old man sat on the bench with his eyes closed.
老人闭上双眼，在长凳上坐著。
I saw a young man lying on the bench under the cherry tree in the park.
在公园里，我看到一个年轻人躺在一棵樱桃树下的长椅上。

v.t: vt. 烦扰, 迷惑 / vi. 烦恼, 操心 / n. 麻烦, 纠纷, 讨厌的人
v.s: He does things for himself. He doesn't like to bother other people.
v.sz: 自己可以做的事情，他不喜欢去麻烦别人。
sx: He didn't pass the exam, but it doesn't bother him.
他考试没过，但他不是特别在意。
Don't bother your parents with such a pointless thing.
别为了这样的小事麻烦你父母。

v.t: interj. 再会, 回头见
v.s: He left the room without so much as saying good-bye to me.
v.sz: 他连再见也没说就离开了房间。
sx: She said good-bye with a smile, but there was a good deal of bitterness in her heart.
她说再见的时候，脸上挂著笑容，但其实心中是十分难受的。
I must say good-bye to you.
我要和你说再见了。

v.t: n. 市民, 公民
v.s: Citizens of higher social status were permitted to live closer to the center.
v.sz: 社会地位较高的公民被允许住在较靠近市中心的地方。
sx: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
每个阿尔及尼亚的男性市民都需要服兵役。
She is a British citizen, but she was born in France.
她是一个英国公民，但她是在法国出生的。

v.t: vi. 竞争, 对抗
v.s: Ten teams competed for the prize.
v.sz: 十支队伍竞逐奖项。

v.t: n. 灾祸, 不幸, 彻底失败
v.s: Optimists see opportunities in disasters while pessimists find disasters in every opportunity.
v.sz: 乐观者在灾祸中看到机会，悲观者在机会中看到灾祸。
sx: The Red Cross constantly supplies food to the disaster areas.
红十字会不断地给灾区提供食物援助。
That was so dangerous! Fortunately, I narrowly escaped a disaster.
好险啊，还好侥幸逃过一劫。

v.t: vt. 发现, 找到, 暴露 / vi. 发现
v.s: I hope that some scientist will soon discover a cure for AIDS.
v.sz: 真希望科学家们能早点找到艾滋病的治疗方法。
sx: If you discover any problems on Tatoeba, you should go ahead and blame Sysko.
你要是在Tatoeba上发现什么问题，你应该责备Sysko才对。
The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。

v.t: n. 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任 / vt. 使出神, 使入迷
v.s: I don't have an umbrella. Drive the car to the hospital inpatient entrance.
v.sz: 我没带伞。你把车开到住院部门口来。
sx: His son has talent, but cannot pass the college entrance exam.
他的儿子有才能，但是考不上大学。
Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
请在建筑的入口处等我。

v.t: adv. 相等地, 同样地, 平等地
v.s: By the 1940s, the qipao came in a wide variety of designs and fabrics, with an equally wide variety of accessories.
v.sz: 到了四十年代，旗袍有了种类繁多的图案和面料，也有了同样种类繁多的饰品。

v.t: n. 友谊, 友爱, 友善
v.s: When real life friends desert us, books are always ready to offer friendship, sympathy and motivation.
v.sz: 生活中的朋友弃我们不顾之时，书随时给我们送来友谊、同情和鼓励。
sx: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
友谊紧紧联系着我们。
The more precise the calculations, the stronger the friendship.
算帐愈是精确, 友谊愈是坚定。

v.t: n. 白痴, 极蠢之人
v.s: Thank you for finally explaining to me why people take me for an idiot.
v.sz: 感谢您终于为我说明了为甚么人们通通把我当傻瓜。
sx: One idiot can ask more questions than ten wise men can answer.
一个傻瓜问出的问题，能多到连十个智者都顾不及回答。
Do I sound like an idiot if I talk like this?
我这么说的话是不是像个傻瓜？

v.t: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的
v.s: How are you keeping off this intense heat?
v.sz: 你是怎么避开这酷暑的？

v.t: n. 液体, 流体, 流音 / a. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的
v.s: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
v.sz: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
sx: You should drink a lot of liquid.
你应该喝大量的液体。
Water and oil are both liquids.
水和油都是液体。

v.t: n. 抵押, 约束性义务, 抵押借款 / vt. 抵押, 以...作担保, 把...许给
n. 狭窄部分, 隘路 / a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的 / vi. 变窄 / vt. 使变狭窄
v.s: Don't let narrow-minded people convince you that your dreams are too big.
v.sz: 别让狭隘的人让你相信你的梦想过于宏大。
sx: An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.
专家就是一个能够把所有的错误控制在最小范围内的人。
This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
这条路太窄，过不了车。

v.t: adv. 有时候, 偶而
v.s: He occasionally reads detective novels.
v.sz: 他偶尔会阅读一些侦探小说。
sx: The mother occasionally reread her son's letter.
这位母亲偶尔会重温她的儿子的信件。
He likes going to the beach occasionally.
他喜欢偶尔去海滩。

v.t: n. 平锅, 浅盘, 盆地, 硬土层, 拍摄全景 / v. 上下左右移动, 摇镜头, 淘洗, 淘金
v.s: You scorned both the Nymphs, who beheld your deeds, and me the mighty Pan.
v.sz: 你蔑视了目睹你罪行的仙女们，也蔑视了我を这位强大的潘神。
sx: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.
将它们放在烤盘上并且涂抹蛋白。
I am going to fry an egg in a pan.
我去用锅煎一个蛋。

v.t: n. 物理学, 物理过程, 物理现象
v.s: A guy I met in my physics class made a didgeridoo out of PVC pipe.
v.sz: 我在物理课遇到一个家伙用PVC管做了迪吉里杜管。
sx: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
原子弹是二十世纪物理学的产物。
Even our brains are subject to the laws of physics.
就连我们的头脑也遵守物理法则。

v.t: n. 减少, 缩影, 变化
v.s: They demand a reduction in working hours.
v.sz: 他们要求减少工作时长。
sx: Rima wants a breast reduction.
利马想要缩胸。
It isn't about cost reduction.
这与减少开支无关。

v.t: vt. 反射, 反映, 招致, 深思 / vi. 被反射, 映出, 深思, 考虑, 指责
v.s: The relationships of socialisers are often reflected in the distance between them.
v.sz: 交际者的关系往往会反映在他们之间的距离上。
sx: The manners and customs of a country reflect its culture.
一个国家的风俗习惯反映了它的文化。
Reflect and respond.
反思并回应。

v.t: vt. 拒绝, 谢绝 / vi. 拒绝 / n. 废物 / a. 扔掉的, 无用的
v.s: They refused to talk to me in spite of my earnest request.
v.sz: 尽管我恳切地要求，他们还是拒绝跟我说话。
sx: The president refused to respond to that question.
总统拒绝回答那个问题。
He had refused to compromise on the issue.
他拒绝在这件事上作出妥协。

v.t: n. 资源, 财力, 办法, 策略, 急智, 消遣
v.s: The only thing that is more precious than any resource is land.
v.sz: 唯一比什么资源都珍贵的是土地。
sx: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
唯一比无论什么资源都珍贵的是土地。
Though it is poor in natural resources, Japan has become an economic superpower thanks to international trade.
日本即便是自然资源匮乏，却仍得益于国际贸易，成为了一个强大的经济体。

v.t: n. 贝壳, 壳, 外形, 炮弹 / vt. 去壳, 脱落, 炮轰 / vi. 剥落, 脱壳
v.s: This farm's free-range eggs have a deeper shell color, and the yolks are especially rich and delicious.
v.sz: 这家农场的草鸡蛋颜色偏深，蛋黄特别鲜美。
sx: The eggs from this farm have darker shells, and the yolks are exceptionally rich.
这家农场的草鸡蛋颜色偏深，蛋黄特别鲜美。
I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

v.t: a. 愚蠢的, 糊涂的
v.s: If you do silly things, you must accept the consequences without complaining.
v.sz: 如果你做了愚蠢的事，你就必须无怨尤接受痛苦惩罚。
sx: This may be a silly question, but which is stronger - a tiger or a lion?
这可能是个蠢问题，但是一头老虎和一头狮子哪个更厉害？
My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
我爸被我的愚蠢问题彻底吓到了。

v.t: a. 后来的, 接下去的
a. 看得见的, 明显的, 显然的 / n. 可见物
v.s: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
v.sz: 汤姆卷起裤管，露出鲜红的袜子。
sx: That star is visible to the naked eye.
那颗星星可以用裸眼看到。
The shadow of the stick is visible.
立竿见影。

v.t: adv. 是（美国俚语=yes）
n. 角, 角度, 角落 / vi. 钓鱼, 谋取, 博取, 斜向移动, 转变角度 / vt. 使转动角度, 在...钓鱼, 获取
v.s: We should approach this problem from different angles.
v.sz: 我们应该用各种不同的角度看待此问题
sx: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
这两条线成直角相交。
An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
90度的角叫直角。

v.t: vi. 到达, 抵达
v.s: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.
v.sz: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。
sx: I didn't arrive in Harbin until very late, and the queue for taxis was already extremely long.
我很晚才到了哈尔滨，等出租汽车的队伍已经长极了。
This is the second time I have arrived in China on my own.
这是我第二次独自到中国。

v.t: vi. 属于, 合适
v.s: Zhejiang Province is located on the southeastern coast of China and belongs to the East China region.
v.sz: 浙江省地处中国东南沿海，隶属于华东地区。
sx: Who does the car belong to when the owner dies?
主人死后车子归谁呢？
No one may be compelled to belong to an association.
不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。

v.t: v. 连接, 联合, 联系
v.s: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?
v.sz: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？
sx: I often use SSH to remotely connect to my computer.
我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。
These two portals are connected via a wormhole.
这两个传送门通过虫洞连接。

v.t: n. 效率, 效能, 功效
v.s: The challenge we are going to face is how to increase work efficiency.
v.sz: 如何提高工作效率是我们现在要面临的难题。

v.t: n. 企业, 事业心, 进取心, 干事业
v.s: The school-enterprise networking event will be held as scheduled on December 26th.
v.sz: 学校与企业见面会于12月26日按期举行。

v.t: n. 实验, 试验, 实验仪器 / vi. 实验, 尝试
v.s: As far as I could make out, he was experimenting with new methods.
v.sz: 就我所了解的，他正在实验新的方法。
sx: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
要完成实验，三个月太短了。
The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.
这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。

v.t: n. 草, 草原, 牧场
v.s: The blackbird found a little red worm in the green grass.
v.sz: 乌鸫在绿草中发现了一条小红虫。
sx: I found them lying on the artificial grass.
我发现他们正躺在人工草皮上。
You want the horse to run fast, but you don't want to feed it grass.
又要马儿好，又要马儿不吃草。

v.t: adv. 因此, 从此
v.s: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
v.sz: 他为了活下去竭尽全力，所以他从来不想谈起这件事。
sx: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.
因此，我们必须自己照顾自己。

v.t: adv. 逐渐地, 渐增地
v.s: In England, parks taking rare breeds of animals as their theme are becoming increasingly popular with people.
v.sz: 在英国，以珍稀物种为主题的公园变得越来越受人们的欢迎。

v.t: adv. 不能相信地
v.s: George has an incredibly large Adam's apple.
v.sz: 乔治有一个令人难以置信的大喉结。
sx: I felt incredibly nervous.
我感到万分焦虑。
Dinner was incredibly boring.
晚餐难吃得离谱。

v.t: n. 新闻记者, 从事新闻杂志业的人
v.s: The journalist wanted to write an article that would draw public attention to the issue.
v.sz: 记者想写一篇文章，以便引起公众对那件事情的注意。
sx: Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
Tani 先生与其说是学者，倒不如说是新闻工作者。
I think of the woman as a journalist.
我想到那位当记者的女人。

v.t: n. 场合, 时机, 机会, 诱因, 理由 / vt. 惹起, 引起
v.s: On gift-giving occasions, people generally avoid giving money, but there are exceptions.
v.sz: 人们送礼通常都不会送钱，但是也会有例外的情况。
sx: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
汤姆只在特殊场合穿西装。
What's the happy occasion?
什么事这么开心？

v.t: n. 速度, 步调, 步法 / vi. 踱步, 缓慢走 / vt. 用步测, 踱步于
v.s: Wow, she’s got a lot of pace, I’m impressed!
v.sz: 哇，她真是神速啊，真让我印象深刻！
sx: Please don't walk so fast. I can't keep pace with you.
请别走得那么快，我跟不上你。
They stepped a few paces forward.
他们前进了几步。

v.t: n. 乘客, 旅客
v.s: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
v.sz: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。
sx: Tom put the large picnic basket on the passenger seat next to him.
汤姆把那个大野餐篮子放在他旁边的乘客座位上。
Some brave passengers caught the pickpocket and turned him over to the police.
几位见义勇为的乘客把小偷抓住了，还把他送到了警方的手中。

v.t: n. 钢笔, 笔, 笔调, 笔杆子, 作家, 围栏, 栅栏, 禽畜 / vt. 写, 关入栏中, 囚禁 / vi. 动笔, 写作
v.s: This is the pen that he signed the document with.
v.sz: 这就是他用来签署那份文件的笔了。
sx: What have you done with my pen? It was here a minute ago.
你把我的钢笔怎么了? 一分钟前它还在这里。
The baby caught sight of my ballpoint pen and reached out for it.
这个婴儿盯著我的原子笔看, 并且伸手要拿它。

v.t: n. 拥有, 占有, 所有, 财产, 领土, 领地, 自制, 着迷
v.s: The Spanish team is great at keeping possession of the ball.
v.sz: 西班牙队很擅长控球。
sx: The ball is that boy's prized possession.
这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。

v.t: a. 迅速的, 飞快的, 急促的, 陡的 / n. 急流
v.s: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
v.sz: 电脑产业的发展一日千里。
sx: My wishes for your father's rapid recovery.
祝令尊早日康复。
I'm amazed at his rapid progress in English.
我被他英语的快速进步惊呆了。

v.t: n. 规则, 管理, 调整
v.s: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
v.sz: 首先，我想宣布几条新制度。
sx: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
一些海滩没能遵守环保规定。
We want to modify the regulations of our school.
我们想修改学校的规章制度。

v.t: n. 居民, 常驻程序, 居住者, 留鸟 / a. 居留的, 定居的
v.s: The residents protested outside the sex shop that opened in their neighborhood recently.
v.sz: 居民们在一家开在邻近的性用品商店前抗议。
sx: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.
学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。
More than half of the residents are opposed to the plan.
有过半数的居民反对这个计划。

v.t: n. 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰, 情绪低落 / vt. 纺织, 纺, 使旋转, 编造 / vi. 纺纱, 吐丝, 作茧, 结网, 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰
v.s: Why does the Earth spin?
v.sz: 地球为什么会自转呀？

v.t: a. 适当的, 相配的
v.s: Does the applicant have suitable abilities to carry out the job?
v.sz: 那位求职者能胜任工作吗？
sx: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。
Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
选择合适的卫星图做为底图。

v.t: a. 生命的, 重要的, 充满活力的, 生死攸关的, 致命的
v.s: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
v.sz: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。

v.t: n. 农业
v.s: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
v.sz: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
sx: My major is agriculture.
我主修农业。

v.t: v. 收集, 聚集, 集中, 搜集 / a. 由收到者付款的 / adv. 由收到者付款地
v.s: I have not yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
v.sz: 我还没有收集到足够的材料来写一本书。
sx: Tatoeba is created for adding and collecting example sentences.
Tatoeba是为了添加和收集例句而被创建。
This is a collect call from Mr Nakamura in Osaka. Will you accept the charge?
这是来自大阪中村先生的付费电话。你愿意付费吗?

v.t: n. 货币, 通货, 流通, 通用
v.s: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
v.sz: 外币的汇率天天都变。
sx: What is the currency of Taiwan?
台湾的货币是什么 ?

v.t: n. 表现, 展览会, 展览品
v.s: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
v.sz: 展览大大地吸引了公众的注意。
sx: Did you go to the art exhibition?
你去看艺术展览了吗？
The exhibition is now open.
展览现在已经开放。

v.t: n. 葬礼, 出殡
v.s: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
v.sz: 今天午餐时间，我们常去的饭馆关门了，因为他们家在办丧事。
sx: I feel bad about not having gone to his funeral.
我因为没有参加他的葬礼而感到很糟糕。
I will definitely attend your funeral.
我一定会去参加你的葬礼的。

v.t: a. 真正的, 真实的, 诚恳的
v.s: I believe it is a genuine Picasso.
v.sz: 我认为是一幅毕加索的原画。

v.t: n. 蜂蜜, 甜蜜, 爱人 / a. 蜂蜜似的, 甜蜜的, 甘美的 / vt. 加蜜使甜, 对...说甜言蜜语 / vi. 说甜言蜜语, 奉承
v.s: Christmas gingerbread, also called honey cake, is a traditional German dessert.
v.sz: 圣诞姜饼是一种传统的德国点心。
sx: Honey in the mouth and poison in the heart.
口中有蜜，心中有毒。
Bees pollinate flowers and trees, and collect nectar to make honey, bee glue and bee venom.
蜜蜂为花卉和树木授粉，并采集花蜜来制造蜂蜜、蜂胶和蜂毒。

v.t: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章 / vt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践
n. 钩, 钩状, 镰刀, 陷阱 / vt. 挂...于钩上, 钩住, 引上钩, 偷窃 / vi. 弯成钩状, 钩紧
v.s: He asked me to do what I can to hook them up.
v.sz: 他求我尽力去帮他搭桥拉线。
sx: Ziri put up hooks for gardening tools in the garage.
齐里在车库里装上了用来挂园艺工具的挂钩。
Tom hung his shirt on a coat hook.
汤姆将他的衬衣挂在了挂钩上。

v.t: vt. 介绍, 引入, 采用, 输入
v.s: The interviewer introduces the topic of the interview.
v.sz: 采访者介绍了采访的主题。
sx: Of these, Taoism is a native religion, the others having been introduced from foreign lands.
其中，道教是本国的，其他是从国外引进的。
I wonder if it would be possible for you to introduce me to Mr. Harrison of PC Interactive Co. Ltd.
我想知道您能否把我介绍给 PC Interactive 有限公司的哈里森先生。

v.t: n. 记录, 圆木, 日志, 计程仪 / vt. 伐木, 切, 航行 / vi. 伐木
v.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
v.sz: 在加拿大有很多区域砍伐树木是非法的。
sx: You need a password to log in again after logging out.
登出后重新登入需要密码。
Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was born in a log cabin in Kentucky.
美国的第十六任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯是在肯塔基州的一间木屋中出生的。

v.t: adv. 只
v.s: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
v.sz: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。
sx: From that day forth he merely tasted his food, and only just moistened his lips with drink.
从那时开始他就只是尝一尝他的食物，也仅仅只是用饮料润湿了嘴唇而已。
I'm sorry darling, you are merely a single tree in a forest, I just can't drop everything for you.
不好意思美女，我不会为了你这一颗树，放弃一片森林。

v.t: n. 监督器, 级长, 监听员, 班长, 监视器, 告诫物 / v. 监视, 监听, 监督
v.s: The USS Monitor was designated the first National Marine Sanctuary on January 30, 1975.
v.sz: 莫尼特号战舰于 1975 年 1 月 30 日被指定为美国第一个国家海洋保护区。
sx: Whilst at university, Xiaowang held the post of class monitor.
上大学的时候，小王担任过班长。
I'll monitor your progress from my computer.
我会用我的电脑监察你的进度。

v.t: n. 比, 比率
v.s: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
v.sz: 这项应用程序能让你快速计算身高体重指数（BMI）。

v.t: n. 遗憾, 后悔, 悔恨, 抱歉, 歉意 / vt. 为...感到遗憾, 后悔, 惋惜, 懊悔, 抱歉 / vi. 感到抱歉
v.s: Russia expresses regret for those lost in the hostage incident.
v.sz: 俄罗斯对在人质事件中牺牲的人们表示哀悼。
sx: I regret that I will be unable to meet you on February 27 owing to an unexpected matter.
因为临时有事，我很抱歉在2月27日那天不能跟您碰面了。
We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

v.t: vt. 提醒, 使想起
v.s: When I heard that song, it reminded me of when I was a kid.
v.sz: 我一听到那首歌，就想起来我小的时候。
sx: Whenever I look at you, I am reminded of my younger brother.
我每次看到你，都会想起我的弟弟。
Let me remind you again that March 31st is the due date.
让我再次提醒你3月31日是到期日。

v.t: n. 度假胜地, 手段, 凭借, 常去之地 / vi. 诉诸, 常去
v.s: To win his audience, the speaker resorted to using rhetorical techniques he learned from his communication courses.
v.sz: 演说家为了征服他的听众，不惜使用他在交流课上学到的修辞技巧。
sx: When only death remains, the last resort is to beg for food.
除死无大事，讨饭到了家。
The train was crowded, so I resorted to walking.
火车里太多人了，所以我走路算了。

v.t: n. 相反, 背面, 倒退, 挫折, 失败 / a. 反面的, 相反的, 反向的, 颠倒的 / vt. 使颠倒, 使逆转, 使倒退, 使反向 / vi. 倒退, 反向, 倒转, 反转
v.s: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
v.sz: 背心反了， 要翻一个面。
sx: He did the reverse of what I asked.
他做的和我要求的相反。

v.t: n. 常规, 日常工作, 惯例, 例行公事 / a. 日常的, 常规的
v.s: Ten years after the wedding, everything is just routine.
v.sz: 婚姻走过十个年头一切只是例行公事。
sx: Such questioning is routine police business.
这样讯问只是警察例行公事。

v.t: n. 种子, 籽, 萌芽, 子孙, 精液 / vt. 在...播种, 催...发育, 脱...籽 / vi. 结实, 播种
v.s: Our team is seeded in the ping-pong competition.
v.sz: 我们队是这次乒乓球比赛得标的热门队。
sx: I ordered a sesame seed buns for the veggie burgers.
我点了一份芝麻面包，用来制作素食汉堡。
Farmers sow seeds in the spring.
农民在春天播种。

v.t: n. 有背长椅 / vt. 决定, 整理, 安放, 使定居, 使平静, 支付, 安排, 解决, 结算 / vi. 停留, 下陷, 沉淀, 澄清, 安下心来, 结清, 定居, 安家
v.s: Eventually I'd like to settle down and have a family, but not yet.
v.sz: 我会找个地方安顿下来，然后结婚生子的，但这是以后的事。
sx: This deal is mine, so you need to just settle down and agree with me.
这笔交易是我的，所以你需要去冷静并且同意我
Members of that tribe settled along the river.
部落成员沿着河岸定居了。

v.t: n. 罪, 犯罪, 过失, 失礼 / v. 犯
v.s: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?
v.sz: 说谎总是一种罪吗？
sx: Repay your sins with your life.
纳命来赎罪。

v.t: n. 符咒, 魅力, 轮值, 轮班, 工作时间, 一次发作 / vt. 拼写, 拼成, 琢磨, 理解, 招致, 轮换, 迷住 / vi. 轮换, 拼字
v.s: Everyone can help ensure that sentences sound correct, and are correctly spelled.
v.sz: 每个人都可以协助确保句子念起来正确且拼写正确。
sx: The wicked witch cast a spell on the man and turned him into a bug.
恶毒的巫婆在男人身上施了咒语，把他变成了一只虫子。
You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。

v.t: n. 生存, 残存, 幸存者 / a. 赖以生存的
v.s: This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.
v.sz: 这个药品会提高病人的存活率。
sx: I gave up all hope of survival.
我放弃了所有生存的希望。
His own survival is more important now.
他自己的生存现在更重要了。

v.t: n. 舌, 语言能力, 讲话方式, 语言 / vt. 舔, 斥责, 发...的音 / vi. 使用舌头, 吹管乐器
v.s: It's not your mother tongue, so your pronunciation will never be accurate.
v.sz: 因为它不是你的母语，你的发音会永远不准。
sx: Instead, they detect sounds through their tongues and feel vibrations through sense organs in the skull.
相反，他们通过舌头来侦测声音，并通过头骨内的感觉器官来感受震动。
A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。

v.t: n. 病房, 守卫, 保卫, 保护, 监护, 牢房, 行政区, 锁孔内的榫舌 / vt. 使入病房, 守护, 保卫
n. 完成, 成就, 功业
v.s: No matter how many faults there are, our achievements are the main thing.
v.sz: 不管缺点怎么多，成绩还是最主要的。
sx: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
登月是一项里程碑式的成就。

v.t: a. 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的 / adv. 熟睡地
v.s: He was about to fall asleep, when he heard his name called.
v.sz: 他听到有人叫他的名字的时候，正在昏昏欲睡。
sx: I was so excited that I could not fall asleep.
我兴奋得睡不著觉。
When I opened the door, I found him asleep.
当我打开门的时候，我发现他睡着了。

v.t: n. 自动手枪, 自动机械 / a. 自动的, 机械的, 必然的, 无意识的
n. 行为, 举止
v.s: I am fed up with his behaviour.
v.sz: 我厌烦了他的行为。
sx: I can't take his behaviour.
我无法容忍他的行为。
Her behaviour is very vulgar.
她的行为很粗俗。

v.t: n. 镭射碟, 镭射唱片
v.s: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
v.sz: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。
sx: I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
我没有 CD 播放机，但还是把唱片买下来了。
I've already picked out the CD I'm going to buy next.
我已经选好我要买的下一个光碟。

v.t: n. 外套 / vt. 外面覆盖, 给...穿外套
v.s: Mary asked whose coat it was and I told her it was mine.
v.sz: 玛丽问我这是谁的外套，我告诉她这是我的。
sx: I'm going to get my house a fresh coat of paint.
我要粉刷我的房子。
I bought a coat and a jacket at the department store.
我在百货公司买了大衣和夹克

v.t: a. 广泛的, 有理解力的, 综合的
n. 同意, 许可 / vi. 同意, 赞同
v.s: Do you give your consent to the operation?
v.sz: 你是否同意手术？
sx: If I'd known that it would come to this, I would have never consented.
要是我知道会发生这种事，那我死活不同意。
Silence gives consent.
沉默就意味着同意。

v.t: n. 爸爸
v.s: Daddy must be able to cook at least one egg!
v.sz: 当爸爸的必须至少会煮蛋。
sx: Daddy was in his office, under our flat.
爸爸在他的办公室里，在我们公寓楼下。
Daddy loves to say funny things.
爹地喜欢讲有趣的事。

v.t: n. 破坏, 毁灭
v.s: First Contact became humanity's salvation as it was at the brink of self-destruction.
v.sz: 在人类自我毁灭的边缘，第一次接触成了福音。
sx: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。

v.t: n. 离婚 / vt. 与...离婚
v.s: The root cause of any divorce is marriage.
v.sz: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
sx: He divorced his wife last month.
上个月他和妻子离婚了。
I wonder if they'll get divorced.
我不知道他们是否会离婚。

v.t: vi. 答应, 从事, 交战 / vt. 使忙碌, 雇佣, 预定, 使从事于, 使参加
v.s: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
v.sz: 这个应用程式每日吸引超过一万位使用者使用其功能。
sx: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。
My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
我父亲经营外贸多年。

v.t: a. 非常的, 特别的, 非凡的
v.s: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.
v.sz: 生活真正的艺术是在平凡中看到不平凡。
sx: The iPhone is an extraordinary cell phone.
苹果是非凡的手机。
Rosa Montero is an extraordinary woman.
Rosa Montero是个不同寻常的女人。

v.t: n. 基因
v.s: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
v.sz: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。

v.t: n. 总部, 司令部, 总部人员
v.s: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
v.sz: 总部里有另外一种气氛。

v.t: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权 / a. 自发的, 起始的
v.s: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
v.sz: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。
sx: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
当地企业正在联手举办一项慈善活动。

v.t: n. 汁, 活力, 体液 / vt. 挤出汁来, 加汁
v.s: Add the honey, lemon juice, chopped almonds and the chopped apples.
v.sz: 加入蜂蜜，柠檬汁，切碎的杏仁和切碎的苹果。
sx: Do you want to eat noodles or rice? Do you want to drink fruit juice or coffee?
你吃面条还是吃饭？喝橙汁还是喝咖啡？
I have coffee, tea, water, and fresh fruit juice.
我有咖啡、茶、水跟新鲜果汁。

v.t: n. 风景, 山水, 风景画 / vi. 从事景观美化 / vt. 美化...景观
v.s: The strawberry tree is a commonly used landscape plant in this area.
v.sz: 草莓树是该地区常见的景观植物。
sx: The arboretum includes more than 450 azaleas for landscaping, but also trees like maples, American elms, and hemlocks.
植物园内种植了 450 多株杜鹃花，还有枫树、美国榆树和铁杉等树木，用于景观美化。
Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。

v.t: n. 目的, 目标, 宗旨, 宾格, 实物 / a. 客观的, 如实的, 无偏见的, 宾格的
v.s: It's hard to stay objective and calm when it happens to you.
v.sz: 当事情发生在自己身上时，就无法客观冷静地处理。
sx: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.
销售部门和营销部门的目标不见得一样。
In the end he achieved his objective.
他终于完成了他的目标。

v.t: n. 关心, 注意, 尊敬, 关系, 问候 / vt. 视为, 注意, 考虑, 和...有关, 看待 / vi. 注视, 注意
v.s: We are open to all suggestions regarding the new design of the website.
v.sz: 关于网站的新设计，我们乐于接受任何建议。
sx: We have different ways of thinking with regard to this issue.
关于这一点，我的想法和你不同。
We regard him as the best player on the team.
我们认为他是队里最厉害的选手。

v.t: adv. 概略地, 粗糙地, 粗暴地
v.s: The population of the country is roughly estimated at 50,000,000.
v.sz: 这个国家的人口粗略估计是五千万左右。
sx: My Chinese is far from perfect, but I can roughly understand everything he is saying.
我的汉语并不完美，但能大致听懂他所说的。
Taiwan is an island nation in the western Pacific Ocean with a population of roughly 23 million people.
台湾是个位于太平洋西岸的岛国，人口约两千三百万。

v.t: n. 薪水 / vt. 给...加薪
v.s: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
v.sz: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。
sx: I will ensure that your salary increases after one year.
我保证你一年后加薪。
His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
他的薪金很高，所以生活也过得很舒适。

v.t: n. 手迹, 手稿, 正本, 手写体 / vt. 改编为演出本
v.s: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
v.sz: 总的来说，这部电影从剧本到银幕是成功的。
sx: The syntax of Python scripts is very simple.
Python脚本的语法很简单。

v.t: n. 长条, 条状, 带, 脱衣舞 / vt. 脱衣, 被剥去, 剥夺, 拆卸 / vi. 脱衣服
v.s: I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
v.sz: 我想试一下那条蓝色条纹裙。
sx: Cut the meat into strips.
将肉切成条状。
They played strip poker.
他们玩脱衣扑克.

v.t: n. 管, 软管, 隧道 / vt. 把...装管, 使通过管子
v.s: Does the tube train stop at the next station?
v.sz: 地铁会在下一站停吗？
sx: We still have an old tube television.
我们还有个老式电视机。
Please buy a tube of toothpaste.
请买一支牙膏。

v.t: n. 胸部, 乳房, 胸怀 / vt. 以胸对着, 面对
v.s: Tom eats rice every day either with fish or with chicken breast.
v.sz: 汤姆每天吃饭要嘛配鱼，要嘛配鸡胸肉。
sx: I'd like to have a test for breast cancer.
我想检查一下我是否患了乳癌。
He doesn't drink enough breast milk.
他母乳喝得不够。

v.t: n. 化学, 化学过程
v.s: Sami has to go to his chemistry class and he will see you in Arabic.
v.sz: 萨米得去上他的化学课，他会用阿拉伯语和你会面。
sx: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
这里是普通中学的化学实验室。
I found him a genius at chemistry.
我发现了他在化学方面的天赋。

v.t: n. 消费, 消费量, 痨病
v.s: In America, the consumption of fast-food has tripled between 1977 and 1995.
v.sz: 美国人快餐食物的消耗量在一九七七至一九九五年间大幅增长了三倍。
sx: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
酒的消费每年都在上升。

v.t: n. 棉花 / vi. 和谐, 有好感, 理解
v.s: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
v.sz: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。
sx: Someday I'll buy a cotton candy machine.
有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。
These cotton socks bear washing well.
这些绵袜很耐洗。

v.t: n. 折扣, 贴现率 / vt. 打折扣 / vi. 贴现
v.s: Tom sells T-shirts at a 30 percent discount.
v.sz: 汤姆以七折销售T恤。
sx: Can you give me a discount?
能给我打个折么？
Can't you discount it a little?
你不能打一点折吗？

v.t: n. 打, 十二个 / a. 一打的
v.s: There, pandas have been trained to perform dozens of items.
v.sz: 在那里，人们把熊猫训练得能表演许多节目。
sx: Tom has been to this park with Mary at least a dozen times.
汤姆跟玛丽来这公园至少十二次。
Several dozen young people participated in the demonstration.
几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。

v.t: n. 例外, 除外, 异议
v.s: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
v.sz: 这个月一直都很热，但今天是个例外。
sx: On gift-giving occasions, people generally avoid giving money, but there are exceptions.
人们送礼通常都不会送钱，但是也会有例外的情况。
Every team, without exception, was defeated.
每个队都无一例外地被打败了。

v.t: n. 出口, 退场, 离去, 去世 / vi. 退出, 脱离, 去世 / 恢复前一个命令处理器
v.s: If there's an emergency, you must run out of the house through this exit.
v.sz: 有紧急情况时，必须通过这个出口跑出房子。
sx: Weigongcun subway station has three exits.
魏公村地铁站有3个出口。
Where is the emergency exit?
紧急出口在哪里？

v.t: vt. 使膨胀, 详述, 扩张 / vi. 张开, 发展 / vt. 展开 / vi. 展开
v.s: The imports from Asian countries have expanded recently.
v.sz: 最近，来自亚洲各国的进口额不断扩大。
sx: That market has been rapidly expanding.
那个市场一直在急速扩展。
First of all, the level of the ocean could rise, because ocean water expands as it grows warmer.
首先，因为海水变热时膨胀，海平面可能提高。

v.t: n. 想象力, 幻想, 喜好 / a. 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高价的, 特级的 / vt. 想象, 设想, 相信, 喜爱 / vi. 想象, 幻想
v.s: We're going down the pub. Do you fancy coming?
v.sz: 我们要去酒吧。你有兴趣来吗？
sx: A dragon is a creature of fancy.
龙是人幻想出来的动物。
He fancies himself as an artist.
他自以为自己是个艺术家。

v.t: a. 华丽的, 灿烂的
v.s: She is wearing gorgeous silk clothes.
v.sz: 她穿著华丽的丝绸服饰。

v.t: a. 感谢的, 感激的, 令人快意的, 受欢迎的
v.s: If you would agree to answer some of the questions below, I would be extremely grateful.
v.sz: 如果您同意回答下面几个问题，我就非常感激您的帮助。
sx: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
如果你能教我怎么做，我会很感激。
If you can lend me some money, I would be very grateful.
如您能借我些钱，不胜感激。

v.t: n. 印象, 意念, 盖印, 印记, 印数, 底色, 效果
v.s: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
v.sz: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。
sx: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
你永远没有第二次机会去打造第一印象。
The staff in that restaurant gave us a very good impression.
那家饭馆儿的服务员给我们留下很好的印象。

v.t: vt. 显示, 象征, 指示, 指出
v.s: They express disagreement by shaking their heads, which may indicate agreement in other countries.
v.sz: 他们以摇头表示不同意，而其他国家的人可能以摇头表示同意。
sx: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.
我将他的缺席视为没有兴趣。
An increase in customer complaints may indicate that business is declining.
顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

v.t: n. 输入, 输入电路 / vt. 输入
v.s: The input method also works with this version.
v.sz: 此输入法也适用于这个版本。

v.t: n. 敲, 敲打, 敲门 / v. 敲击, 互撞, 攻击
v.s: All the wealth in the world is useless when death comes knocking on your door.
v.sz: 当死亡来敲你的门时，世界上所有的财富都是无用的。
sx: You are always to knock before you come into my room.
你进入我的房间之前都要敲门。
The thieves knocked off another bank today in a daytime robbery.
今天强盗大白天的就抢了另一家银行。

v.t: n. 皮革, 皮制品, 马镫的皮带 / vt. 覆以皮革, 鞭苔, 抽打 / a. 皮革的, 皮制的
v.s: Tom bought a pair of black leather shoes.
v.sz: 汤姆买了一双黑色皮鞋。
sx: These boots are made of leather.
这靴是用皮革做的。
My wallet is made of leather.
我的钱包是皮制的。

v.t: 应该
v.s: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
v.sz: 我认为你应该跟她道歉。

v.t: n. 结果, 出口
v.s: Regardless what you may do, the outcome will still be the same.
v.sz: 不管你怎么做，结果都一样。
sx: The outcome of the test shows that the system has already fulfilled all design requirements.
测试的结果显示，系统已经满足了所有设计要求。
No one could predict the outcome of this cooperation.
没人能够预言这次合作的结果。

v.t: n. 投票, 民意测验, 选举投票, 投票数, 一组人中的一个, 头颈和后脑部, 鹦鹉 / vt. 对...进行民意测验, 获得...票, 剪树枝, 轮询 / vi. 投票 / a. 剪过毛的, 修过枝的
v.s: It is a prevalent belief, according to a nationwide poll in the United States, that Muslims are linked with terrorism.
v.sz: 根据美国国民的一个投票，人们普遍认为穆斯林人和恐怖主义有关。

v.t: n. 记者, 报告者
v.s: The room was jam-packed with reporters waiting for the press conference to begin.
v.sz: 房间挤满了等待发布会开始的记者。
sx: The reporter elaborated on the method of his investigation.
报告者详尽地说明了他的研究方法。
Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。

v.t: v. 抢夺, 抢掠, 剥夺
v.s: Tom and his friends planned to rob a bank.
v.sz: 汤姆和好友打算抢银行。

v.t: n. 序列, 续发事件, 顺序, 连续 / vt. 按顺序排好
n. 伸展, 张开, 连绵, 一段路, 一段时间 / a. 可伸缩的, 弹性的 / vt. 伸展, 张开, 曲解, 使过度伸展 / vi. 伸展, 延伸
v.s: Stretching is an important part of exercise that should not be ignored before and after workouts.
v.sz: 拉伸是运动前后不可忽略的重要环节。
sx: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
在泳池游完泳后要拉伸肌肉。
On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
边境上有一片农业区。

v.t: n. 泪滴, 眼泪, 撕, 扯, 裂缝, 激怒, 飞奔 / vi. 流泪, 撕破, 赶快, 飞奔, 被撕破 / vt. 撕裂, 戳破, 拉掉, 撕掉, 使分裂, 使精神不安, 折磨
v.s: Isn't this just tearing down the east wall to repair the west wall?
v.sz: 这不就是拆了东墙补西墙吗？
sx: Hearing the sad news, she collapsed in tears.
听到这个悲伤的消息，她泣不成声。
Though tears may flow down your face, I won't look back.
任凭眼泪在你脸上滑过，我头也不回。

v.t: n. 网球
v.s: When I was in Salem, I would often play tennis with John.
v.sz: 当我在塞勒姆的时候, 我常常和约翰打网球。
sx: Some of my classmates like volleyball and others enjoy tennis.
我有些同学喜欢排球，也有些喜欢网球。
You are a good tennis player, as beginners go.
以初学者来说，你打网球已经算是打得不错了。

v.t: n. 恐怖分子
v.s: The USA is acting like a terrorist force in the Middle East.
v.sz: 美国在中东的行为如同恐怖主义势力。
sx: We will never give in to terrorist demands.
我们决不会屈服于恐怖份子的要求之下。
One man's terrorist is another man's freedom fighter.
一个人的恐怖分子为另人的自由战士。

v.t: n. 缺席, 缺乏, 没有
v.s: No one noticed her absence until the end of the meeting.
v.sz: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
sx: Should anyone call on me in my absence, tell him that I will be back soon.
如果我不在的时候有人来找我，麻烦你告诉他我很快回来。
His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.
他的缺席导致了各种谣言的产生。

v.t: vt. 有助于, 捐助, 投稿 / vi. 出力, 捐献, 投稿
v.s: Melting polar icecaps could also contribute to an increase in sea levels.
v.sz: 融化中的极地冰盖也可以使海平面上涨的势态更加严重。
sx: Tom has contributed a lot of money to this hospital.
汤姆捐献了很多钱给这间医院。
He contributed much to the development of the economy.
他为经济发展作了很多贡献。

v.t: n. 捐助, 捐助之物, 贡献
v.s: Thank you for all your contributions. We expect to see you again soon.
v.sz: 谢谢您的贡献。预计我们很快又会见面。

v.t: v. 否认, 拒绝
v.s: I'm not denying it happened, but one example can't be called proof.
v.sz: 我不否认这件事发生了，可是一个例子算不上证据。
sx: It cannot be denied that we cannot do without the telephone in our modern life.
不可否认的，在现代生活中我们不能没有电话。
It cannot be denied that Chinese is the most spoken language in the world.
不能忽视的是，汉语是世界上使用人数最多的母语。

v.t: n. 安乐, 安逸, 悠闲 / vt. 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松 / vi. 减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动
v.s: If symptoms do not ease after taking Suxiao Jiuxin Pills, take nitroglycerin immediately.
v.sz: 如果服用速效救心丸后症状并未缓解，请立即服用硝酸甘油。
sx: I feel quite at ease when I sit in this chair.
这张椅子坐得很舒服。
My mind is at ease believing you'll keep the secret.
我十分安心，因为我知道你会保守秘密。

v.t: v. 扩充, 延伸, 伸展, 扩大
v.s: Having their classroom time extended is a very common occurrence for students.
v.sz: 拖堂情况对于学生们而言十分常见。
sx: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
当工作时间被延长时，工人们忍不住开口抱怨起来。
Our branches extend all over the country.
我们的分店布满全国。

v.t: n. 洪水, 大量之水, 涨潮 / vt. 淹没, 使泛滥, 注满 / vi. 被淹, 溢出, 涌进
v.s: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
v.sz: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
sx: In the city, the information is flooding.
消息在城里传遍了。
The stadium was flooded with baseball fans.
体育场挤满了棒球迷。

v.t: n. 立即, 瞬间 / a. 紧急的, 立即的, 即时的
v.s: If you drink instant coffee you do not need a coffee pot.
v.sz: 如果你喝速溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壶了。
sx: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
我消夜吃了速食面。
Right at that instant, the bus stopped.
就在那时，公交车停住了。

v.t: n. 原则, 原理, 主义
v.s: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
v.sz: 诚实地回答你的问题对他来说是个原则问题。
sx: However, apart from Buddhists, hardly anyone can consistently follow this principle.
不过，除了佛教者以外，没有任何人可以一直遵循这个原则。
The referee, according to principle of advantage, raised his hand and motioned for the advance to continue.
裁判根据有利原则，举起手示意继续进攻。

v.t: n. 处罚, 刑罚, 惩罚
v.s: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
v.sz: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。
sx: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.
许多国家已经废除了死刑。
What punishment awaits him?
他将面临什么样的惩罚？

v.t: adv. 飞快地, 迅速地, 赶紧地
v.s: What was at first a natural disaster rapidly became a man-made debacle.
v.sz: 起初的天灾迅速演变为了人祸。
sx: As figures from the National Development and Reform Committee show, the Internet has developed rapidly in rural China.
来自国家发展和改革委员会的数据显示，互联网在中国农村地区发展迅猛。
That market has been rapidly expanding.
那个市场一直在急速扩展。

v.t: n. 读者, 读物, 文选, 校对人, 讲师
v.s: Just because a certain book does not interest readers does not mean that the fault lies in the book.
v.sz: 不是因为读者对某本书不感兴趣，这本书就肯定是有问题的了。
sx: These books are not fit for young readers.
这本书不是给年轻读者看的。
Let the reader be the judge.
让读者去评判。

v.t: n. 表示法, 表现, 陈述, 代表
n. 总数, 总和, 金额, 概要, 顶点 / vt. 总计, 概括 / vi. 合计
v.s: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
v.sz: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。
sx: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.
我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。
She had only a small sum of money.
她当时只有一丁点儿钱。

v.t: n. 摇摆, 振幅, 音律, 节奏, 涨落, 秋千, 旋转, 行动自由 / vi. 摇摆, 悬挂, 旋转, 大摇大摆地走, 转向 / vt. 挥舞, 使旋转, 使转向, 悬挂, 吊运 / a. 旋转的, 悬挂的, 强节奏爵士音乐的
v.s: Mennad always has those mood swings.
v.sz: 梅纳德总是情绪波动很大。

v.t: n. 尾部, 后部, 辫子, 随员, 特务, 燕尾服, 踪迹, 限定继承(权) / a. 在后面的, 从后面而来的, 限定继承的, 尾部的, 后部的 / vt. 为...装尾, 附于其后, 尾随, 使搭牢, 跟踪, 监视 / vi. 跟踪, 船尾搁浅
v.s: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
v.sz: 兔子有长耳朵和短尾巴。
sx: Better be the head of a cat than the tail of a lion.
宁为猫头不为狮尾。
Just as if it were my tail, wherever I go, it goes too.
它就像我的尾巴一样，我去哪里它就去哪里。

v.t: n. 繁荣, 隆隆声 / vi. 急速发展, 发隆隆声 / vt. 使兴旺, 发隆隆声
v.s: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
v.sz: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

v.t: a. 勇敢的, 美好的, 华丽的 / n. 勇敢者 / vt. 勇敢地面对
v.s: Some brave passengers caught the pickpocket and turned him over to the police.
v.sz: 几位见义勇为的乘客把小偷抓住了，还把他送到了警方的手中。
sx: John is brave in appearance, but is in reality a coward.
约翰看起来很勇敢，但其实是个胆小鬼。
He put up a brave and lone struggle, but up against such heavy odds he couldn't get his business plan accepted.
他提出了一个勇敢而孤独的斗争，但这些沉重的打击，他的赔率不能得到他的商业计划接受。

v.t: n. 专栏, 圆柱, 纵队, 列, 柱形物
v.s: The opinion column discusses the importance of voting.
v.sz: 意见栏讨论了投票的重要性，
sx: I found this column interesting.
我发现这个专栏很有趣。

v.t: vt. 委托(托付), 犯罪, 指派...作战, 使承担义务
v.s: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?
v.sz: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？
sx: Out of all the attributes of the gods, the one I find most pitiable is their inability to commit suicide.
在神的所有特性中，我觉得最让人同情的是他们没办法自杀这一点。
Bill did not commit the crime.
比尔没有犯罪。

v.t: n. 困难, 难点
v.s: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
v.sz: 我想你要拿到驾照根本不难。
sx: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。
Despite a lot of difficulties, he still completed the task.
虽然困难重重，他还是完成了这个任务。

v.t: a. 人种的, 种族的
v.s: Hanfu is the traditional clothing used by the ethnic Han of China, before the Qing dynasty.
v.sz: 汉服是中国汉族于清以前的传统服饰。
sx: There are 56 ethnic groups in China.
中国有56个民族。

v.t: n. 基本原理, 原则, 基波 / a. 基本的, 重要的, 原音的
v.s: On a fundamental level, the 12 forms of the Chinese zodiac are related to animal worship.
v.sz: 从根本上说，十二生肖的形成，与动物崇拜有关。
sx: To me, there aren't any fundamental differences between the cultures of these two countries.
对我而言，这两个国家的文化没有什么根本的区别。
Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
无须多言，基本人权应当被尊重。

v.t: adv. 很, 非常
v.s: The temperature in different places can vary greatly at the same time of year.
v.sz: 不同的地方可以在同一时节有十分不同的温度。
sx: The north and south differ greatly from each other.
南方和北方的差异很大。
Different variants of Shanghainese differ greatly with each other.
吴语的方言差异很大。

v.t: n. 指导, 领导
v.s: This type of exercise can be practiced alone and does not require a coach's guidance.
v.sz: 这类运动可以单人练习，不需教练指导。
sx: The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.
营辅员应负责为学生提供指引和辅导。
But CNN has learned that, due to her husband's guidance, Kate feels she has already adapted to her new life.
但是CNN获悉，由于她丈夫的指导，凯萨琳感觉已经适应了新的生活。

v.t: n. 传染, 影响, 传染病
v.s: He had an infection in his belly button.
v.sz: 他的肚脐发炎了。

v.t: n. 意图, 目的, 含义
v.s: I have no intention in arguing about your theory.
v.sz: 我无意争辩你的理论。
sx: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.
对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。
The only difference between an awful cook and a poisoner is the intention.
一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。

v.t: n. 膝, 膝盖 / vt. 膝行, 用膝盖碰
v.s: All I did was run a little and now my knees are wobbly.
v.sz: 只跑了一点点，膝盖就开始发抖。
sx: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
我不弯膝也能把手掌平放在地上。
Mary is fairly plain, but Tom thinks she's the bee's knees.
玛丽是个平淡无奇的人，但是汤姆却认为她出类拔萃。

v.t: v. 假装, 伪称, 自命, 自称
v.s: You'll never be able to revive someone who is only pretending to be dead.
v.sz: 你永远都无法救活一个装死的人。
sx: Tom told Mary that she should stop pretending to be intoxicated.
汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。
You cannot wake a person who is pretending to be asleep.
你无法叫醒一个装睡的人。

v.t: n. 祭司, 牧师, 神父, 神质人员, 僧侣, 泰斗
v.s: Sorry, I'm not used to seeing a priest with a sense of humor.
v.sz: 不好意思，有幽默感的牧师我是真的不太习惯。
sx: The main duty of a priest is to preach in church.
牧师的主要职责是在教堂里讲道。
My brother has become a priest.
我的兄弟已经成为了牧师。

v.t: n. 激进分子, 词根, 基础, 根式, 根 / a. 激进的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的
v.s: She has a very radical opinion about the problem.
v.sz: 她对于这个问题有很激进的意见。

v.t: a. 住宅的, 与居住有关的
v.s: Please write down your residential address and home number.
v.sz: 请写下住址和家庭电话。

v.t: n. 报酬, 酬谢, 赏金 / vt. 奖赏, 酬谢, 给...应有报应
v.s: A reward will be paid to anyone who brings back the money that he lost.
v.sz: 凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。
sx: Anyone who can recover the money he lost will receive a reward.
凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。
He was given a gold watch as a reward.
他被奖励了一块金表。

v.t: n. 人造卫星
v.s: The Moon is not a planet, but a satellite of the Earth.
v.sz: 月球不是一颗行星，而是地球的一颗卫星。
sx: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。
It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
让卫星环绕地球的是重力。

v.t: n. 摇动, 震动 / vt. 摇动, 动摇, 使震动, 挥舞 / vi. 震动, 发抖, 动摇
v.s: They express disagreement by shaking their heads, which may indicate agreement in other countries.
v.sz: 他们以摇头表示不同意，而其他国家的人可能以摇头表示同意。
sx: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。
I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.
我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。

v.t: n. 重要材料(或事物), 有实际价值的东西 / a. 实质上的, 物质的, 有内容的, 结实的
n. 制服 / a. 统一的, 一律的, 始终如一的
v.s: Some spaghetti fell on the badge of the uniform, dirtying it.
v.sz: 有一些意面掉到了制服上的徽章那儿，把那边弄脏了。
sx: The girl in a white uniform took my temperature.
有个穿白色制服的女孩帮我量了体温。
While some private and church schools in America have uniforms, they are not common.
虽然美国有些私立或教会学校有校服，但校服并不常见。

v.t: a. 木制的, 呆笨的, 木然的
v.s: He took his wooden spoons to a nearby village to sell them.
v.sz: 他带著木汤匙到附近的村庄去卖。
sx: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
花园被木栅栏围了起来。
Tom utilized some wooden chests as chairs.
汤姆把几个木箱子当椅子用。

v.t: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的
v.s: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
v.sz: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。
sx: Sami became more aggressive with customers.
萨米对顾客变得更加挑衅了。
Mary is very aggressive, isn't she?
玛丽有些咄咄逼人，不是吗？
