v.t: a. 清晰可见的, 显然的, 表面上的
v.s: It's in times like these that the character of a person becomes apparent.
v.sz: 路遥知马力，日久见人心。

v.t: n. 重击, 突然巨响, 刘海 / v. 发巨响, 重击 / adv. 砰然地, 突然巨响地, 直接地
v.s: Tom and Mary's little boy loves sitting on the kitchen floor banging pots and pans.
v.sz: 汤姆和玛莉的小儿子喜欢坐在厨房地板上敲打锅碗瓢盆。
sx: I'd love to be able to tell the lady who cuts my hair that I don’t like bangs.
我很想告诉给我理发的女士我不喜欢留刘海。
She banged the table with her fist.
她用拳头拍了桌子。

v.t: n. 诉苦, 抱怨, 控诉
v.s: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
v.sz: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。
sx: If I do not get the item this week, I will make a complaint to PayPal.
如果本周我收不到货，我就向paypal投诉。
I do not want to hear your complaints again.
我不想再听到你的抱怨了。

v.t: n. 元件, 组件, 成分 / a. 组成的, 构成的
v.s: Many companies have attempted to manufacture this complex component at scale, but so far only ours has succeeded.
v.sz: 许多公司都尝试过大规模生产这种复杂的零件，但目前只有我们成功了。
sx: The clan system is a key component of traditional Chinese culture.
宗族制度是中国传统文化的重要组成部分。

v.t: n. 勇气, 胆量
v.s: His courage will carry him through this difficult job.
v.sz: 他的勇气将帮助他度过这艰难的任务。
sx: I don't have the courage to ask my boss to lend me his car.
我不敢问老板借车。
She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.
她有勇气去查询考试的结果。

v.t: a. 不顾一切的, 危急的, 令人绝望的, 极渴望的
v.s: Desperate times call for desperate measures.
v.sz: 非常时期需要非常措施。
sx: These housewives are desperate.
这些家庭主妇过得很绝望。

v.t: n. 反馈, 反应
v.s: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
v.sz: 公司欢迎消费者对他们产品的反馈

v.t: n. 改革, 创新
vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予 / vi. 投资, 利用
v.s: Managing your stocks with Big Wisdom shows that you are serious about investing!
v.sz: 用大智慧做股票，说明您对投资是认真的！
sx: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
该公司在这个企划中投入了很多钱。
The government should invest more money in agriculture.
政府应该加大对农业的投资。

v.t: n. 夹克, 外套, 护套 / vt. 给...穿夹克, 给...装护套
v.s: I bought a coat and a jacket at the department store.
v.sz: 我在百货公司买了大衣和夹克
sx: Put this jacket on, and you'll be much warmer.
穿上外套吧！你会暖一些。
I want the same jacket as you are wearing.
我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。

v.t: n. 操作员, 行家, 经纪人, 算子, 运算符
v.s: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
v.sz: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
sx: Mary was a switchboard operator when she was younger.
玛丽年轻时是电话接线生。

v.t: n. 磅, 英镑, 重击, 鱼塘, 拘留所, 兽栏 / vt. 强烈打击, 捣烂, 监禁, 关入栏内 / vi. 连续重击, 苦干
v.s: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
v.sz: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。
sx: The manager reprimanded the man who was pounding on the table.
经理斥责了那个正重击桌子的男子。
An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
预防胜于治疗。

v.t: n. 准备, 预备, 预习
v.s: I bought a house on a small hill in southern France in preparation of building a retirement home.
v.sz: 我在法国南边的一座小山买了一所房子，准备在那里建设老人院。
sx: They've sold their house and car in preparation for leaving the country.
他们卖掉了房子和汽车准备出国.
He failed in the examination for lack of preparation.
他因为准备太少考试不及格了。

v.t: n. 打洞器, 钻孔机, 冲压机, 冲床, 潘趣酒 / vt. 以拳重击, 开洞, 冲压 / vi. 用拳猛击
v.s: A punch is just a punch. A kick is just a kick.
v.sz: 出拳就是出拳。出脚就是出脚。
sx: I punched Tom.
我打了汤姆。

v.t: n. 紫色, 帝位 / a. 紫色的, 帝王的, 华而不实的 / v. (使)成紫色
v.s: Purple clover is a type of plant that bees use as a source of food.
v.sz: 紫三叶草是一种被蜜蜂用来当作食物来源的植物。
sx: Honeycake is a white kitten with purple eyes and a pink nose.
蜂蜜蛋糕是一只白色的小猫，有著紫色的眼睛和粉红色的鼻子。
My boyfriend wants to dye his hair purple.
我的男朋友想把头发染紫。

v.t: n. 登记, 挂号, 注册
v.s: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.
v.sz: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
sx: Does it also work without registration?
不注册也行吗？
The registration period is already over.
报名时间已经过了。

v.t: a. 充分的, 足够的
v.s: I have not yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
v.sz: 我还没有收集到足够的材料来写一本书。
sx: Before welcoming a beautiful tomorrow, every rich man will ensure that he gets sufficient rest!
在迎接美好的明天前，每个富有的人一定会确保自己有充分地休息！
We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.
我们有充分的理由论证这个假设。

v.t: n. 追踪者, 拖车
n. 公告, 发表, 告知
v.s: The timing of the announcement hurts the public relations of the police.
v.sz: 声明的时机对警察的公众关系不利。

v.t: n. 咬, 一口 / v. 咬, 刺痛, 穿透
v.s: We suspect it's about a poisoning by snake bite.
v.sz: 我们猜这是一种被蛇咬伤的毒。
sx: Over the last hundred years, there have been twenty-seven recorded deaths from spider bites in Australia.
过去一百多年，澳大利亚共有二十七例蜘蛛咬人致死的记录。
A cornered rat will bite a cat.
穷鼠囓狸。

v.t: n. 屑片, 薄片, 碎片 / vt. 削, 切, 削成碎片, 使摔倒, 凿 / vi. 削下屑片
v.s: Mike waited outside the chippy for Dani while she ordered a large portion of chips.
v.sz: 丹妮点了一大份薯条，麦克在炸鱼薯条店外等她。
sx: Stracciatella ice-cream is nothing but a plain ice-cream with chocolate chips.
斯特拉恰泰拉冰淇淋只不过是一种添加了巧克力碎的普通冰淇淋。
I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
我不该把一整包薯片都吃完的。

v.t: prep. 关于
v.s: He is going to take charge of a project concerning the future of the company.
v.sz: 他将要负责一个关系公司前途的项目。
sx: Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.
对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。
Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。

v.t: n. 挑战, 挑动, 大胆 / v. 敢, 胆敢
v.s: Fucking hell, what idiot dare phone me in the middle of the night?
v.sz: 他妈的，哪个傻子敢在半夜打我电话?!
sx: How dare you speak like that to your elders and betters!
你竟敢这样对长辈说话？！
Because of his score of zero, he didn't dare to return.
因为考了零分，所有不敢回去。

v.t: n. 数据库
v.s: Just because it's in Tatoeba.org's database, doesn't mean it's a sentence.
v.sz: 在Tatoeba.org的数据库里并不意味着它是一个句子。

v.t: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确
v.s: Things are not clearly defined.
v.sz: 事情还没给解释清楚。

v.t: v. 探险, 探测, 探究
v.s: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.
v.sz: 我想要去探索世界。那是我的梦想。
sx: Exploring hidden treasures behind waterfalls is one of my favorite parts of WHAT THE CAR?.
《WHAT THE CAR?》中我最喜欢的部分是探索瀑布之后的隐藏宝藏。
In the documentary, CNN explores how the royal family has supported their latest member as she finds her feet.
CNN纪录片当中探究皇室最新成员在适应的时候他们是如何支持她的。

v.t: n. 好感, 偏爱, 喜爱, 相信, 庇护, 赞同, 支持, 信赖, 善行, 恩惠, 徽章, 礼物 / vt. 赞成, 帮助, 支持, 喜爱, 偏袒, 关切, 赐与, 给与, 有利于, 有助于, 像, 体恤
v.s: I'll recommend him as chairman, whether you are in favour of it or not.
v.sz: 你赞成也好，不赞成也好，我也会推荐他当主席的。
sx: You'd be doing me a favour if you'd let me help you to speed things along.
你如果让我帮忙加快进度，同样也是在帮我一个忙。
Most students agree with the proposal and have made a list of arguments in favour of it.
大多数学生同意这个建议，并列出了他们同意的理由。

v.t: v. 调查, 审查
v.s: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
v.sz: 他宣布他将立刻来调查此事。
sx: Investigate thoroughly the bushes where the enemy may be hiding.
仔细搜寻敌人可能藏身的灌木丛。
The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
警察调查事故的原因。

v.t: n. 实验室, 研究室, 化工厂
v.s: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
v.sz: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。
sx: Last night, I was almost bitten to death by mosquitoes in the laboratory.
昨天晚上，我快被实验室的蚊子咬死了。
His laboratory contains all the deadliest poisons.
他的实验室里有所有最致命的毒。

v.t: a. 文学的, 文艺的, 精通文学的
v.s: Prominent figures in the literary world gathered together last night.
v.sz: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。
sx: In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.
文学作品中常用夜来香来象征思念与柔情。
Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.
知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。

v.t: n. 午夜, 子夜, 半夜 / a. 午夜的, 半夜的
v.s: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
v.sz: 注意了！服务器半夜要停机。
sx: He gave me a ring at midnight.
他半夜打了个电话给我。
He rang me up at midnight.
他半夜打电话给我。

v.t: n. 老鼠, 胆小羞怯的人, 鼠标 / vi. 捕鼠, 窥探 / vt. 探出
v.s: A dog runs after a cat, and the cat after a mouse.
v.sz: 狗追猫，猫追鼠。
sx: That person's so stingy that he won't even let the mouse have the chaff.
那个人那么小气，连谷壳都不让老鼠吃。
If you have rat or mouse problems, you can scare them off with ultrasound.
你如果遭受老鼠困扰，可以使用超音波来吓跑牠们。

v.t: n. 钢琴
v.s: Beethoven goes to the piano, sits down at it, and begins to play.
v.sz: 贝多芬走向钢琴，坐下来并开始弹。
sx: She gives most of her spare time to playing the piano.
她把大部分的空余时间都花在弹钢琴上。
I asked him not to play the piano late at night.
我叫他不要太晚弹钢琴。

v.t: n. 赞美, 称赞, 崇拜 / vt. 称赞, 赞美 / vi. 赞扬, 表扬
v.s: It wasn't just that she didn't blame him - she actually praised the guy.
v.sz: 她不仅没责怪他，反而称赞他。
sx: His painting wasn't particularly good, so no one praised him for it.
他的画画得并不是很好，所以没有获得人们的赞赏。
People can accept praise more easily than criticism.
赞扬比批评更容易让人接受。

v.t: n. 赠与, 描述, 介绍
v.s: I'll keep the tips you shared for improving my presentation skills.
v.sz: 你对提升我演讲能力的建议，我会记下来。
sx: Mennad's presentation was perfect.
门纳德的演讲非常完美。

v.t: n. 心理学, 心理状态
v.s: Psycho-horror films dealing with the mysteries of human psychology are popular these days.
v.sz: 这几年有关心理之谜的心理恐怖片很热门。
sx: At that time, the two main schools of thought in psychology were behaviourism and psychoanalysis.
在那个年代，心理学的两个主要学派是行为主义学派与精神分析学派。
Tom teaches sport psychology.
汤姆教运动心理学。

v.t: n. 关系, 联系, 叙述, 故事, 家属, 亲戚
v.s: Cultural exchange programs can strengthen friendly relations between neighboring countries.
v.sz: 文化交流计划可以加强邻国之间的友好关系。
sx: As China develops, more and more countries want to have good relations with it.
越来越多国家随著中国的发展而希望跟中国有好的关系。
The timing of the announcement hurts the public relations of the police.
声明的时机对警察的公众关系不利。

v.t: n. 毁灭, 推翻, 废墟 / vi. 毁灭, 衰败, 破坏, 破产, 堕落 / vt. 使毁灭, 毁坏, 使破产
v.s: Actions are successfully achieved with deliberation but ruined by carelessness.
v.sz: 行成于思，毁于随。
sx: I use Yan garments as my plain robe, and turn Liqiu into ruins.
以兖衣为褋兮，以黎邱为墟。
Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

v.t: a. 稳定的, 不动摇的, 沉着的, 稳固的, 坚定的, 经常的 / vt. 使稳定, 使坚定 / vi. 变为沉着, 稳固
v.s: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
v.sz: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。
sx: There was a steady increase in population.
人口稳定地增加。
Do you have a steady boyfriend?
你有一个固定的男朋友吗？

v.t: n. 符号, 象征, 代号, 信条
v.s: This means that eating dumplings on New Year's eve is a symbol of family reunion.
v.sz: 说明年夜饭的饺子是亲人团聚的象征。
sx: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.
这条腰带对我来说成为了恐惧的象征。
I don't know what this symbol stands for.
我不知道这个符号代表什么意思。

v.t: n. 厕所, 梳妆 / vi. 梳妆, 打扮, 上厕所 / vt. 给...梳妆打扮
v.s: Tom dreams of the toilet when he has to go to the bathroom.
v.sz: 汤姆在需要上厕所的时候会梦见厕所。
sx: Do you have any rooms with a shower and toilet?
有带马桶和淋浴的房间吗？
The toilets at motorway service stations are often very dirty.
服务站的卫生间大多很脏。

v.t: n. 条约, 谈判
v.s: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
v.sz: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。
sx: The treaty was not a success.
谈判没有成功。

v.t: a. 不太可能的
v.s: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
v.sz: 我知道有人认识我的可能性微乎其微。
sx: I think it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.
我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。
It's unlikely that he did anything wrong.
他看来没有做错甚么。

v.t: n. 事件, 事务, 恋爱事件
v.s: Why did you interfere in an affair that did not concern you at all?
v.sz: 为什么你要干涉一件跟你完全不相干的事呢？
sx: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。
Tom always meddles in affairs that do not concern him.
汤姆总是多管闲事。

v.t: n. 蝙蝠, 球棒 / v. 用球棒打, 眨眼
v.s: I watched what was unfolding in front of my eyes with bated breath.
v.sz: 我屏气观看眼前光景。
sx: The bats use ultrasound to locate obstacles.
蝙蝠使用超音波来定位障碍物。
No wonder we associate bats with dark places.
难怪我们会把蝙蝠和黑暗的地方联想在一起了。

v.t: n. 日历, 日程表 / vt. 列入表中
v.s: The red circle on the calendar marking the deadline causes me to fall into anxiety.
v.sz: 日历上画着红圈的截稿日期使我陷入了焦虑。
sx: I'll keep the important dates in my calendar so I don't forget.
我会将重要日期记在行事历上，这样就不会忘。
2010 was the Year of the Tiger in the Chinese lunar calendar.
2010年是农历的虎年。

v.t: n. 合作, 协力, 配合
v.s: With their cooperation, the mission had been successfully finished.
v.sz: 在他们的默契合作下，任务完美地完成了。
sx: The city government held a large conference aimed at promoting cross-departmental cooperation.
市政府举行了一次大型公会，旨在促进跨部门合作。
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
提前感谢你们的合作。

v.t: n. 技艺, 手艺, 诡计 / vt. 精心制作
v.s: I greatly recommend reading it to anybody thinking of learning a craft.
v.sz: 我强烈推荐任何想学习一门手艺的人都去读这本书。
sx: Children often use construction paper to make crafts.
孩子们常用彩纸制作手工艺品。
Thousands of laborers and craftsmen toiled for 22 years to craft the stunning white marble edifice.
数千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出这座令人惊叹的白色大理石建筑。

v.t: n. 黑暗, 暗, 深色, 隐密, 模糊, 无知
v.s: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
v.sz: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
sx: In the darkness, she could hear him and his guests chatting and laughing.
在黑暗中，她能听到他和客人说笑。
I was shocked by the dog that sprang out of the darkness.
黑暗中突然有一只狗冒了出来，把我吓了一跳。

v.t: n. 魔鬼 / vt. 折磨, 戏弄
v.s: Yesterday I became a god, but found that a bit boring, so today I became a devil.
v.sz: 昨天我变成了神，但没意思，所以今天我变成了鬼。
sx: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
说曹操，曹操就到。
Don't shoot the devil in the back. You might miss.
别射撒旦的背部。你可能会射不中。

v.t: vt. 使能够
v.s: Modern travel enables us to go around the world in a few days.
v.sz: 现代交通使我们能在几天内环绕地球。
sx: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。
His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
他的薪金很高，所以生活也过得很舒适。

v.t: n. 财富, 运气, 兴隆, 大量财产, 好运, 命运
v.s: One must understand and cherish fortune before creating it.
v.sz: 人要知福、惜福、再造福。
sx: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。
I had my fortune read by an old lady with an eery-looking glass eye.
我让一个有着奇怪玻璃眼珠的老太太帮我算了命。

v.t: interj. 再见
v.s: Every time I leave, I'm of full the regret that I haven't fully said goodbye.
v.sz: 我很遗憾每次离开的时候，都没有好好地道别。
sx: As the train pulled out, they waved goodbye to their parents.
火车开出的时候，他们都挥手向父母道别。
He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.
他甚至没说再见就离开了家。

v.t: n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者 / a. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的
v.s: An intellectual is a person who has discovered something more interesting than sex.
v.sz: 一个知识分子是发现到一种比性行为更有意思的活动的人。
sx: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。
In my view, everyone should have intellectual hobbies as well as an interest in physical activities.
对我自己来说，每个人应该有学知识的爱好，也应该对体育活动感兴趣。

v.t: vt. 邀请, 请求, 引起, 招致 / n. 邀请
v.s: Mary invited me to stay a couple of weeks with her next summer.
v.sz: 玛莉邀请我明年夏天陪她待几个星期。
sx: We wish to invite Peter to Japan in the near future.
我们希望在不久的将来邀请彼得去日本。
Mary invited my best friend to a party, but not me.
玛丽请我最好的朋友去聚会，但没有请我。

v.t: n. 卷入, 牵连, 包含, 困窘
adv. 部分地, 在一定程度上
v.s: The wall is partly covered with ivy.
v.sz: 墙被常青藤覆盖了一部分。
sx: It is partly cloudy today.
今天的天气晴间多云。
We're partly responsible for that.
我们对此有一定的责任。

v.t: n. 惯用语, 词组, 成语, 措词, 乐句 / vt. 用短语表达, 把(乐曲)分成短句
v.s: The two scholars wrangled over the meaning of an obscure Tibetan phrase.
v.sz: 两位学者为一句意思含糊的藏文句子争论了一番。
sx: When you go abroad, it is useful to learn at least some polite phrases in the local language.
你出国的时候学一些当地的礼貌用语还是很有用的。
'can' is an auxiliary verb, so in question sentences it is brought to the start of the phrase.
因为 can 是助动词，在疑问句中被放到了句首。

v.t: adv. 按自然规律, 完全地, 实际上, 真正地, 身体上地
v.s: Generally speaking, men are physically stronger than women.
v.sz: 一般说来，男生的肌肉比女生发达。

v.t: n. 政权, 当权期间, 政体, 社会制度, 体制, 情态
v.s: His regime is bound to collapse.
v.sz: 他的政权必定会崩溃。

v.t: n. 酱油, 调味汁, 酱 / vt. 给...调味, 使增加趣味
v.s: One kilogram of tomato sauce is equivalent to two kilograms of tomatoes.
v.sz: 一公斤的番茄酱等于两公斤的西红柿。
sx: The herb used in that pasta sauce might be parsley.
用于那个义大利酱的香草可能是荷兰芹。
Two women wielding giant spatulas continuously stir a brimming wok of shredded beef simmering in curry sauce.
两名女子挥舞著巨大的锅铲，不停地翻炒著盛满咖哩酱汁的牛肉丝。

v.t: n. 印章, 封条, 海豹, 海豹皮, 火漆, 封蜡, 玺, 保证, 批准, 象征, 标志 / vt. 封闭, 盖印, 盖章 / vi. 猎海豹
v.s: This mask completely seals your face.
v.sz: 这个面具完全盖住了你的脸。

v.t: adv. 相像地, 类似于
n. 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片 / vt. 使滑动, 偷偷放入 / vi. 滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走
v.s: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
v.sz: 慧如那个简报档还没传喔？客户在催。
sx: Straight golden hair slides over her shoulder.
垂直的金发滑过她的肩膀。

v.t: n. 咽喉, 喉咙, 嗓音 / vt. 用喉音说, 开沟于
v.s: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
v.sz: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。
sx: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
我被鱼骨刺到了喉咙。
Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
你发烧和喉咙痛吗?

v.t: n. 玩具, 小玩艺儿, 小型的东西, 消遣 / a. 供玩耍的, 作为玩具的 / vi. 玩弄, 戏弄, 调情
v.s: Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
v.sz: 汤姆请求妈妈给他买新玩具。
sx: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
我想要个能装这些玩具的盒子。
He deprived my little sister of all her toys.
他把我妹妹的玩具都抢走了。

v.t: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的
v.s: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
v.sz: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尴尬到不行。
sx: By saying the wrong thing at the wrong time, I kept getting myself and my friends into awkward situations.
我在不恰当的时机说错了话, 不断的使我自己和我的朋友陷于尴尬的处境。
The girl made an awkward bow.
这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

v.t: n. 牛肉, 肌肉 / vt. 养(牛), 宰(牛) / vi. 抱怨, 告发
v.s: That's why ostrich meat costs more than twice as much as beef and pork.
v.sz: 这就是驼鸟肉比牛肉和猪肉贵两倍多的原因了。
sx: Should we order the steamed perch or the beef with oyster sauce?
叫个清蒸鲈鱼好呢，还是蚝油牛肉好？
As a rule of thumb, you should plan on one pound of beef for every two guests.
一般来说，你应该为每两个客人准备一磅牛肉。

v.t: n. 糖果, 冰糖 / vt. 用糖煮, 使结晶为砂糖 / vi. 结晶为砂糖
v.s: I prefer cakes or candies to alcohol, but I do drink.
v.sz: 比起酒来，我比较喜欢蛋糕、糖果，可是酒我也不是完全不喝的。
sx: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
我不论甚么时候都不该让汤姆吃那么多糖。
Someday I will buy a cotton candy machine.
有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。

v.t: n. 庆祝, 庆典
v.s: I feel a little guilty that I didn't invite him to join the celebration.
v.sz: 我没请他来参加庆祝会，感到有点内疚。
sx: Let's have a good birthday celebration!
生日同乐！
Customs include food, celebrations and dancing.
风俗习惯包括食物，庆祝和舞蹈。

v.t: n. 证书, 证明书 / vt. 发给证明书, 用证书批准, 用证书证明
v.s: Please attach a certificate of quality.
v.sz: 请附上质量证明书。
sx: Where's my birth certificate?
我的出生证明呢？

v.t: a. 残废的, 有缺陷的, 失效的
v.s: A sprained ankle disabled him from walking for a month.
v.sz: 他把足踝扭伤了，整整一个月不能走路。

v.t: a. 清楚的, 显著的, 不同的
v.s: Europe, with its four distinct seasons, is the most suitable environment for the human race to live in.
v.sz: 欧洲四季分明，是最适合人类居住的地区。
sx: Those two ideas are quite distinct.
这完全是两个不同的观点。
Horses are distinct from donkeys.
马跟驴可分别。

v.t: n. 拖, 拖累 / v. 拖累, 拖拉, 沉重缓慢地走, 拖动
v.s: The stage charisma of drag performers compels audiences to reconsider their own stereotypes.
v.sz: 反串秀者的舞台魅力使观众不禁重新审视自己的刻板印象。
sx: This teacher always drags his class time, taking up the students' rest time, later he got reported, it felt amazing.
这个老师总是拖堂，占用同学们课间休息的时间，后来他被举报了，真过瘾啊。

v.t: n. 估计, 判断 / vt. 估计, 评价, 判断 / vi. 估计
v.s: According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.
v.sz: 一项估计显示，今年的钢鉄产量将会达到一亿吨。
sx: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
这幅画被估价数百万元。
Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
算一算你花了多少钱买书。

v.t: n. 家具, 帆具
v.s: A few years ago, our room had little furniture in it.
v.sz: 几年前，我们的房间里没有什么家具。
sx: The writer's furniture is all shown in this museum.
那位作家用过的家具全都存放在这间博物馆里。
The wood of trees in the pine family is much prized for construction and furniture making.
松科树木的木材因其优良的品质，在建筑和家具制造领域备受推崇。

v.t: a. 聪明的, 智能的, 了解的
v.s: She is beautiful, intelligent and, what is best of all, very kind-hearted.
v.sz: 她又漂亮，又聪明，而最棒的是，她还是一个十分善良的人。
sx: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?
你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？
He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
他不像他的兄长那样聪明。

v.t: n. 交互作用, 交感
v.s: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.
v.sz: 所有的社交，自然而然地，都会掺入一些虚伪的成分，我想这是有其必要的。

v.t: n. 照明, 照明设备, 舞台灯光
v.s: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?
v.sz: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？
sx: The room lighting is sufficient.
室内的光线很充足。

v.t: n. 林荫路
v.s: Recently T Mall has had a sales promotion on cell phones.
v.sz: 最近天猫上有手机促销活动。
sx: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.
再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。
When I left the shopping mall, my car was no longer where I had parked it.
当我离开购物中心，车子不在我停的地方。

v.t: a. 海外的, 国外的 / adv. 在海外, 在国外
v.s: A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
v.sz: 海外旅行通常都要用到护照。
sx: I'd like to make an overseas call.
我想打个国际电话。
Do you plan to go overseas?
你打算出国吗？

v.t: vt. 重新获得, 恢复, 复原, 拯救 / vi. 痊愈, 复原, 胜诉
v.s: Almost two weeks went by before John recovered from his illness.
v.sz: 差不多两周John的病才好了。
sx: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？
It was not long before Mr Yamazaki recovered.
山崎先生不久就康复了。

v.t: vi. 放松, 松懈, 松弛, 变从容, 休息, 休养 / vt. 使松弛, 缓和, 使松懈, 使休息
v.s: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
v.sz: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。
sx: How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?
你那么看着我，我哪里放松得下来啊？
After saying everything that I had to, I felt relaxed.
我说完所有需要说的话后，感觉轻松多了。

v.t: vi. 信赖, 依赖, 信任
v.s: There has never been a savior nor an immortal emperor to rely on.
v.sz: 从来就没有什么救世主， 也不靠神仙皇帝！
sx: Tom and Mary have nobody else they can rely on.
汤姆和玛丽没有其他人可以依靠了。
She cannot be relied on because she often tells lies.
她不靠谱因为她经常说谎。

v.t: a. 不平常的, 值得注意的, 显著的
v.s: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
v.sz: 这家公司去年获得显著的营业额增长。
sx: He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.
他在运动会上的表现十分出色。
My sister has made remarkable progress in English.
我妹妹的英语有了明显的进步。

v.t: n. 脚掌, 鞋底, 底部 / a. 唯一的, 仅有的, 单独的, 独身的 / vt. 上鞋底, 触底
v.s: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
v.sz: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。
sx: I am the sole survivor.
我是唯一的幸存者。
That's my sole concern.
这是我唯一关心的。

v.t: vi. 成功, 继承, 继续 / vt. 继承, 接替
v.s: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
v.sz: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。
sx: I am afraid that if I take this new job, I won't succeed at it.
我很担心我作这份新工作就不会做得好。
His health has enabled him to succeed in life.
他健康的身体使他能在生活中成功。

v.t: n. 故事, 谎言, 谣言, 陈述, 叙述
v.s: The author translated the fairy tale into our mother tongue.
v.sz: 作者将童话翻译成了我们的母语。
sx: This fairy tale is easy enough for a seven-year-old child to read.
这个童话故事很浅白，七岁的小孩也看得懂。
Fairies exist only in fairy tales.
神仙只在童话里存在。

v.t: n. 吨
v.s: According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.
v.sz: 一项估计显示，今年的钢鉄产量将会达到一亿吨。
sx: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
这辆卡车最大的载重量是5吨。
The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
货车的载货量超过了三吨。

v.t: n. 惊恐, 警报, 警钟 / vt. 使惊恐, 警告
v.s: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
v.sz: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。
sx: I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。
It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。

v.t: n. 考虑, 原因
v.s: Another factor to be taken into consideration is that the present situation is favourable to us.
v.sz: 将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。
sx: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
我们本该考虑一下行程。
The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

v.t: a. 决定性的, 重要的, 严厉的
v.s: The next four to six weeks are crucial in controlling the massive Ebola outbreak.
v.sz: 接下来的四到六周将对于控制伊波拉病毒的大爆发至关重要。
sx: This is a crucial point.
这是一个关键点。

v.t: n. 依赖他人者 / a. 依赖的, 从属的
v.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
v.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
sx: This is obviously dependent on the relationship...
这明显就是靠关系...
He is very dependent on his family.
他非常依赖他的家人。

v.t: a. 实验的, 根据实验的
v.s: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?
v.sz: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？

v.t: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
v.s: At first many things seemed different, but I soon got involved in my new life.
v.sz: 一开始许多事情看上去不同了，但我很快习惯了我的新生活。
sx: My father is very much involved in the stock market now.
我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。
I don't want to be involved in this affair.
我可不想卷入这场纷争中去。

v.t: n. 裁判, 宣告, 判决书
v.s: Every transfer window is a test of judgment and patience, and every match brings its own surprises and tension.
v.sz: 每一次转会谈判都是对眼光与耐性的考验，每一个比赛日都充满未知的挑战与压力。
sx: I've always trusted your judgment.
我一直都相信你的判断。

v.t: n. 可能性, 几率, 机会, 胜算, 不平等
v.s: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.
v.sz: 那两个部门有时候意见相左。
sx: He put up a brave and lone struggle, but up against such heavy odds he couldn't get his business plan accepted.
他提出了一个勇敢而孤独的斗争，但这些沉重的打击，他的赔率不能得到他的商业计划接受。

v.t: a. 平静的, 和平的, 和平时期的, 爱好和平的, 喜爱安静的
v.s: It was once very peaceful there, but now you'll sometimes hear the sound of passing vehicles.
v.sz: 那儿曾经很宁静，只不过偶尔会有一些过往车辆的声音。
sx: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
和都市生活相比，乡村生活和谐多了。

v.t: n. 大头针, 针, 别针, 栓, 销子, 图钉, 插头, 管脚, 品(液量单位) / vt. 将...用针别住, 钉住, 压住, 牵制, 使不能动, 归罪于 / a. 针的, 销子的, 闩的
v.s: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
v.sz: 安静到连针掉在地上的声音你都会听得到。
sx: I'm pining for him.
我非常想念他。

v.t: a. 感到满意的
v.s: So far as this matter is concerned, I am completely satisfied.
v.sz: 我对这件事感到十分满意。
sx: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
总的来说，我对这个结果很满意。
Not all of us were satisfied with the system.
我们没有人满意此系统。

v.t: n. 滑, 滑行, 事故, 溜, 差错, 滑台, 下降, 插条, 后裔, 板条, 瘦长的年轻人 / vi. 滑动, 滑倒, 失足, 溜走, 滑落, 犯错, 变坏 / vt. 使滑动, 滑过, 摆脱, 闪开, 塞入, 从...取接枝 / a. 滑动的, 滑移的, 活络的, 有活结的
v.s: In the winter, many older people slip on ice and fall down.
v.sz: 冬天有很多老人在冰上滑倒。
sx: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。
This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

v.t: n. 剩余, 备用品, 备件, 备用零件, 备用轮胎 / a. 多余的, 备用的, 空闲的, 节约的, 瘦的 / vi. 节约, 省掉, 宽恕 / vt. 节约, 省用, 剩下, 饶恕, 赦免
v.s: Father would often read detective stories in his spare time.
v.sz: 父亲常常在空闲时间读侦探小说。
sx: She devoted all her spare time to fishing.
她把所有的业余时间都用在钓鱼上了。
Can you spare me a few minutes? I'd like to have a word with you.
你有几分钟时间吗？我想跟你聊一下。

v.t: n. 专门医师, 专家 / a. 专业的, 专家的
v.s: Legal terminology is usually incomprehensible to non-specialists.
v.sz: 法律术语是大多数普通人无法理解的。
sx: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
专家就好像一台只有一根弦的小提琴一样。
He's a specialist in economics.
他是经济学的专家。

v.t: n. 陌生人, 门外汉
v.s: Son, stop always getting so close to strangers. It's very dangerous!
v.sz: 你这孩子！别老是接触一些陌生人，很危险的！
sx: When Mary was spoken to by a stranger, she was at a loss for words.
当一个陌生人来和玛丽说话时，她不知道该说什么了。
English people rarely talk to strangers in the train.
英国人很少在火车上和陌生人搭讪。

v.t: vt. 使服从, 使受到, 委托, 提交, 认为 / vi. 屈服, 服从
v.s: Don't change sentences that are correct. You can, instead, submit natural-sounding alternative translations.
v.sz: 请勿更改没有错误的句子。请添加一个新的更自然的翻译。
sx: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
提交工作内容之前请仔细检查，这里有疏忽的地方。
Please submit the homework.
请你补交作业。

v.t: a. 令人惊讶的
v.s: As this is a cascade with multiple layers, it shouldn't be surprising that it's slow.
v.sz: 因为这是一个有好几层的瀑布，所以速度慢也不会让人惊讶。
sx: I've something interesting to tell you that you might find surprising.
告诉你个好玩的事，能惊你一下。
It was all more and more surprising.
真是惊人至极。

v.t: n. 轻打, 水龙头 / vt. 轻打, 轻敲, 敲打出, 选择, 装上嘴子, 使流出, 开发, 分接, 向...乞讨 / vi. 轻叩, 轻拍, 啪塔啪塔地走
v.s: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
v.sz: 自来水有可能含有氯、铅等有害物质。
sx: The tap in the kitchen is dripping.
厨房里的水龙头在漏水。

v.t: a. 可接受的, 合意的, 可忍受的
n. 集中, 专心
v.s: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
v.sz: 新竹市区的房价因为科技产业聚集而水涨船高。

v.t: n. 争论 / v. 争论
v.s: We disputed for hours about what to write.
v.sz: 我们为该写些甚么而争论了好几个小时。
sx: International disputes must be settled peacefully.
国际间的纷争一定要用和平的方法来解决。

v.t: a. 时常发生的, 频繁的, 快速的 / vt. 时常来访, 常常聚集, 常与...交往
v.s: The use of trust-region algorithms is becoming more and more frequent.
v.sz: 信赖域的算法越来越常用。
sx: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
这里除了恶劣的天气和频繁的地震之外，几乎就是一个完美的居住地。
Fiona's letters were becoming less and less frequent.
Fiona的信件越来越少。

v.t: n. 页边的空白, 边缘, 界限, 余裕, 差数, 差额, 保证金 / vt. 加边于, 加旁注于
n. 机械, 机构, 结构, 机理, 技巧
vt. 战胜, 克服, 胜过 / vi. 得胜
v.s: I've found a way to overcome my habit of always picking fault with others.
v.sz: 我想办法克服了对别人吹毛求疵的毛病。
sx: I cannot overcome my repugnance to eating snails.
吃蜗牛真恶心, 我可受不了.
He helped me to overcome the difficulties.
他帮助我克服了困难。

v.t: n. 通道, 通过, 移居, 航行, 一段, 走廊 / vi. 通过, 经过, 航行, 横渡, 争吵 / vt. (使)马以斜横步前进, 使传代
v.s: Did you know there was a secret passage hidden behind the bookcase?
v.sz: 你知道书架背后藏著一条秘密通道吗？
sx: This is the passage to the sea.
这是通往大海的通道。
Don't put your things in the passage.
别在通道上放东西。

v.t: a. 心理学的, 精神上的, 心灵的
v.s: Those selected will have to face extensive medical and psychological tests.
v.sz: 被选上的将会面临大量的医学和精神测试。

v.t: a. 震撼的；震惊的
v.s: I was shocked by the dog that sprang out of the darkness.
v.sz: 黑暗中突然有一只狗冒了出来，把我吓了一跳。
sx: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
我爸被我的愚蠢问题彻底吓到了。
What shocked us greatly was his sudden resignation.
让我们非常惊讶的是，他突然辞职了。

v.t: n. 笔划, 打, 中风, 抚, 摩, 冲程 / vt. 划尾桨, 抚, 摩, 划去
v.s: It's a lot of trouble to write my name, because it takes 50 strokes to write both my first and last names.
v.sz: 我的姓、名一共有五十划，写起来麻烦得很。
sx: Tom had a heat stroke.
汤姆中暑了。

v.t: n. 歌曲, 主旋律, 心情, 声调, 和谐, 一致, 语调, 程度 / vt. 为...调音, 调整, 调谐, 使一致 / vi. 协调, 调谐
v.s: Tom went to school to learn how to tune pianos.
v.sz: 汤姆去学校学习调琴手艺。
sx: She played a tune on the piano.
她在钢琴上弹了一首曲子。
What's the name of this tune?
这首曲子叫什么名字？

v.t: adv. 无论哪里
v.s: Just as if it were my tail, wherever I go, it goes too.
v.sz: 它就像我的尾巴一样，我去哪里它就去哪里。
sx: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
汤姆无论到哪里都带着照相机。
Put those flowers wherever we can see them well.
这些花放在哪里也没关系，显眼就行了。

v.t: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告 / vi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
v.s: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
v.sz: 首先，我想宣布几条新制度。
sx: Tom found a new way to announce his news.
汤姆发现了一种宣布他新闻的新方法。
Tom ran as fast as he could to announce the good news to Mary.
汤姆以最快的速度跑着，好向玛丽宣布好消息。

v.t: n. 秋天, 成熟期
v.s: Does the mid-autumn festival fall on Monday this year?
v.sz: 今年中秋节是星期一吗？
sx: On Mid-Autumn Day, families gather, eat moon cake together, and watch the moon.
在中秋节，家人团聚，一起吃月饼、赏月。
Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?
春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？

v.t: vi. 呼吸, 生存, 低语 / vt. 呼吸, 使喘息, 发散, 低声说
v.s: The book tells the story of a dragon that can't breathe fire.
v.sz: 书里讲的是一条不会喷火的龙的故事。
sx: I want to breathe some fresh air.
我想呼吸一下新鲜空气。
A man who asks his wife's permission before taking any action except breathing is a henpecked husband.
一个除了呼吸之外做任何事之前都要经过老婆同意的男人是一个怕老婆的男人。

v.t: a. 古典的, 正统派的, 经典的
v.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
v.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
sx: Tom started playing jazz after studying classical music for many years.
在学习古典音乐多年后，汤姆开始演奏爵士了。
Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
你比较喜欢哪一个，摇滚乐还是古典音乐？

v.t: vt. 说服, 使相信
v.s: Tom was convinced that the food he had just eaten had been poisoned.
v.sz: 汤姆相信有人在他刚刚吃的食物里下了毒。
sx: I am convinced that things will change for the better.
我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。
No matter what you say, I'm convinced that I'm right.
不管你说什么，我就是觉得我是对的。

v.t: n. 相会, 相遇, 遭遇 / vt. 遇见, 邂逅, 会战 / vi. 偶然相遇
v.s: When you encounter difficulties, friends can help you deal with them.
v.sz: 你遇到苦难的时候，朋友们可以帮助你经受住。
sx: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.
与她的相遇丰富了他的精神生活。
We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。

v.t: n. 考试, 测验
v.s: I was really disappointed when I found out that I hadn't passed the exam.
v.sz: 当我发现我没通过测验时我实在是太沮丧了。
sx: I took it for granted that he would pass the exam.
我以为他一定会考试合格。
His son has talent, but cannot pass the college entrance exam.
他的儿子有才能，但是考不上大学。

v.t: n. 考试, 测验, 审查
v.s: After I graduate, I'd like to take the graduate school entrance examination.
v.sz: 大学毕业以后我也想考研究生。
sx: You should go get a physical examination from a doctor.
您应该让医生给您检查身体。
You should have known better than to take an examination without preparing for it.
你应该知道要为考试作准备。

v.t: n. 工具, 手段, 仪器
v.s: Saxophonists often double on flutes, which have similar fingerings to their primary instruments.
v.sz: 萨克斯管吹奏者常常兼演奏长笛，因为长笛的指法和萨克斯管类似。
sx: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
我最喜欢的乐器是电吉他。

v.t: n. 插入, 介入, 调停
n. 爱人, 爱好者
v.s: By switching your lover from 3D to 2D, you may successfully reduce all social-interaction-related costs.
v.sz: 把恋人从3D换成2D可以有效地降低交际所需的费用。
sx: This author doesn't understand at all why a man and a woman who can't become lovers would become friends.
这个作者完全不懂为什么一对不能够成为恋人的男女会成为朋友。
The two lovers swore to love each other for eternity.
两个恋人发誓永远相爱。

v.t: n. 菜单, (功能)选择单
v.s: Bring two breakfasts, please. Number 2 on the menu, and two teas with milk.
v.sz: 请送两份早餐过来。2号餐加两杯奶茶。
sx: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.
我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。
There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
菜单上有各种各样的菜色。

v.t: adv. 不, 不是
v.s: Nope, I'm not buying it.
v.sz: 不，我不买它。

v.t: n. 恐慌, 惊慌 / a. 惊慌的, 没有理由的, 恐慌的 / vt. 使惊慌, 使狂热 / vi. 惊慌
v.s: There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
v.sz: 地震后人们普遍觉得恐慌。
sx: There's no need to panic. There's plenty of time.
别急，时间还多著呢。

v.t: vt. 追赶, 追踪, 追随, 追求, 实行, 继续, 从事 / vi. 追赶, 继续
v.s: She especially likes to pursue questions till the very end.
v.sz: 她呢就是喜欢打破沙锅问到底。
sx: The police are pursuing an escaped prisoner.
警方正在追捕一名逃犯。
Some people pursue only pleasure.
有些人只追求快乐。

v.t: n. 需求, 必要条件, 要求
v.s: Other requirements come from your relationships with other people and your daily activities.
v.sz: 其它的要素来自你跟别人的关系和你平日的活动。
sx: I am not quite sure if we can meet your requirements.
我不太确定我们是否能够满足你的要求。
When using this information, I will of course follow your requirements.
使用这个信息时，我当然会遵循您的要求。

v.t: n. 裂痕, 破绽, 拉裂, 浪子, 巨浪 / vi. 被拉开, 裂开, 猛冲 / vt. 撕, 扯, 劈
n. 范围, 机会, 广度, 眼界, 观察仪器, 导弹射程
v.s: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
v.sz: 这超出了我的想像范围。

v.t: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人
v.s: He was rigid with terror.
v.sz: 他吓得全身僵硬。

v.t: adv. 事实上
n. 排列, 整齐, 安排
v.s: Flower arrangement is a part of Japanese culture.
v.sz: 花道是日本文化的一部分。
sx: Arrangements have already been made.
已经安排好了。

v.t: n. 砖块, 积木 / a. 用砖做的 / vt. 用砖造, 用砖砌
v.s: Put your hard hat on. You might well get a brick fall on your head here.
v.sz: 把安全帽戴上。这里很可能会有砖块砸到你头上。
sx: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。

v.t: a. 相当的, 可观的, 重要的
v.s: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
v.sz: 已经花费了很多的时间和精力。

v.t: a. 传统的, 习惯的, 约定的
v.s: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
v.sz: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

v.t: abbr. 数字化视频光盘（Digital Video Disk）
v.s: This is a DVD.
v.sz: 这是DVD。

v.t: a. 巨大的, 庞大的
v.s: Compiling a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
v.sz: 编字典是一项极花时间的工作。
sx: This will have enormous implications for Algeria.
这将会对阿尔及利亚产生巨大的影响。
The elephant is an enormous creature.
大象是巨大的动物。

v.t: vt. 原谅, 宽恕, 免除
v.s: My job is to forgive you, which I do.
v.sz: 我的工作是原谅你，我做到了。
sx: I can under no circumstances forgive her.
我绝不能原谅她。
To err is human, to forgive divine.
人皆有错，唯圣者能恕。

v.t: n. 车库, 汽车修理厂, 机库 / vt. 把车送入修车场
v.s: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
v.sz: 我把车库改造成工作室使用。
sx: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。
Going to church doesn't make you a Christian any more than standing in a garage makes you a car.
去教堂参加礼拜，不会马上就变成一个基督徒，就好像站在车房里，不会变成一辆车一样。

v.t: n. 质询, 探索, 调查, 询盘
v.s: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
v.sz: 如需媒体联络，请与当地客服中心或行销团队联系。
sx: We made inquiries into his past.
我们对他的过去进行了调查。

v.t: n. 检查员, 巡视员
v.s: The suspect told a lie to the inspector.
v.sz: 那嫌疑犯对侦察官撒了个谎。
sx: Tom is a tax inspector.
汤姆是税务督察。

v.t: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的
v.s: With a good book in your hands you need never feel lonely.
v.sz: 一本好书在手，我们不必孤单。
sx: When I don't have my cell phone, I feel lonely.
我没有我的手机的时候会感到很孤独。
I knew since middle school that only because I was so lonely was I able to expend so much energy on studying.
从中学的时候我就知道，我能够花很多功夫去学习仅仅是因为我过得很寂寞。

v.t: adv. 然而, 虽然如此 / conj. 然而
v.s: It's just five in the morning, but nevertheless it is light out.
v.sz: 只有早上5点，但天已经亮了。
sx: You cannot compare the strength of a man to that of a tiger, but nevertheless, the tiger is still the inferior creature.
虎与人是无法比拼力量的，但是，老虎还是比人类低等。

v.t: n. 管, 导管, 输送管, 管状器官, 声带, 尖细的声音, 烟斗, 笛, 管乐器 / vt. 以管输送, 吹哨子, 吹奏, 尖声唱 / vi. 吹笛, 尖叫, 吹长哨发令
v.s: Rats also have a function. They help to clean the pipes.
v.sz: 鼠类也有用处。它们能帮著清洁管道。
sx: The woodwind section includes both pipes and reeds.
木管乐器组中包含无簧片管乐器与簧片管乐器。
A guy I met in my physics class made a didgeridoo out of PVC pipe.
我在物理课遇到一个家伙用PVC管做了迪吉里杜管。

v.t: n. 诗, 诗般美的事物
v.s: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
v.sz: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。
sx: She expressed her feelings for nature in a poem.
她通过一首诗表达了她对大自然的感受。
She taught me how to write a poem.
她教我如何写诗。

v.t: a. 粗鲁无礼的, 粗陋的, 粗暴的, 原始的, 未开化的, 大略的, 崎岖不平的, 狂暴的
v.s: Don't you think it's rude to give people such a curt reply like that?
v.sz: 你回答得这么简短，不觉得有点没礼貌吗？
sx: Sami was extremely rude and condescending to Layla.
Sami对Layla非常粗鲁和傲慢。
It is rude of him not to give me a call.
他不打电话给我，真没礼貌。

v.t: n. 螺旋, 螺杆, 螺钉, 螺旋桨, 吝啬鬼 / vt. 调节, 扭紧, 旋, 拧, 加强, 压榨, 勒索 / vi. 转动, 旋, 拧
v.s: Now all you have to do is tighten the screw, and Bob's your uncle.
v.sz: 现在你只要拧紧螺丝，就大功告成了。
sx: I screwed up the very first note.
我搞砸了第一个音符。
You are screwed.
你死定了。

v.t: n. 庇护所, 避难所, 庇护, 隐蔽处, 掩蔽 / vt. 庇护, 保护, 隐匿 / vi. 躲避
v.s: A goatherd drove his goats, all white with snow, into a deserted cave for shelter.
v.sz: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。
sx: To escape the storm, we took shelter in a nearby barn.
为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

v.t: n. 签字, 识别标志, 调号
v.s: Recent J-POP doesn't really have many signature songs, you know.
v.sz: 你也知道，最近的 J-POP 实际上并没有很多招牌歌曲。
sx: I attached my signature to the document.
我签署了文件。
The signature had been a forgery.
签名是伪造的。

v.t: vt. 改变, 使多样化 / vi. 变化, 有不同, 违反
v.s: The temperature in different places can vary greatly at the same time of year.
v.sz: 不同的地方可以在同一时节有十分不同的温度。
sx: The amount of time spent asleep can vary from person to person.
睡眠时间的长短可因人而异。
China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。

v.t: a. 人造的, 假的, 非原地产的
v.s: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
v.sz: 明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。
sx: She held a large bouquet of artificial flowers in her hands.
她手里拿著一大束假花。
His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.
他的论文总结了电脑，人造卫星和火箭三个的新成就。

v.t: prep. 在...下方 / adv. 在...下方
v.s: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.
v.sz: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。
sx: She was closely related to the mighty Queen Zurline, and her home was beneath the shade of a widespreading oak.
她与强大的祖琳女王有著密切的血缘关系，她的家在一棵枝繁叶茂的橡树荫下。
The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.
那些钱藏了在地板下面。

v.t: n. 存款, 定金, 堆积物 / vt. 存放, 堆积 / vi. 沉淀
v.s: Sir, I would like to deposit my money. How do I do that?
v.sz: 先生，我要存钱，怎么存？
sx: Some people do not like to deposit their money in banks.
有些人不喜欢把钱存银行。
You have to give three months' rent as a deposit.
你必须付三个月的房租作为押金。

v.t: n. 污垢, 泥土
v.s: Tom is washing the dirt off the plates.
v.sz: Tom洗去盘子上的污垢。
sx: He will make you eat dirt.
他会让你吃灰的。
Clean the dirt off the mirror.
清理镜子上的灰尘。

v.t: n. 输出品, 输出 / vt. 输出, 出口 / vi. 输出物资
v.s: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
v.sz: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。
sx: Imports exceeded exports last year.
去年的进口商品额超过了出口商品额。
Taiwan is an export-oriented economy.
台湾是出口导向的经济体。

v.t: n. 集合, 聚集 / vi. 聚集, 集合, 渐增 / vt. 使聚集, 搜集, 积聚
v.s: Prominent figures in the literary world gathered together last night.
v.sz: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。
sx: The boy gathered a handful of peanuts and put them in a small box.
男孩收集了一把花生，然后把它们放到了一个小箱子里。
On Mid-Autumn Day, families gather, eat moon cake together, and watch the moon.
在中秋节，家人团聚，一起吃月饼、赏月。

v.t: n. 祖父, 始祖
v.s: Some of my classmates from primary school are already grandmothers and grandfathers.
v.sz: 我的一些小学同学都已经当爷爷奶奶了。
sx: My grandfather is five times as old as I am.
祖父的年龄比我大五倍。
He went to see his grandfather off at the station.
他去车站送爷爷了。

v.t: n. 习惯, 嗜好, 习性 / vt. 使穿衣
v.s: I've found a way to overcome my habit of always picking fault with others.
v.sz: 我想办法克服了对别人吹毛求疵的毛病。
sx: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.
十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。
Beth has a strong habit of interrupting people while they are talking.
贝丝很喜欢在别人说话的时候插嘴。

v.t: a. 懒惰的, 怠惰的, 缓慢的 / vi. 懒散
v.s: Not that he couldn't, but he's too lazy a man to do it.
v.sz: 却不是不能作而是他这个男人太懒了。
sx: I am not sure if all the robots are so lazy.
我不知道是不是所有机器人都这么懒。
The quick brown fox did not jump over the lazy dog.
身手矫健的棕狐狸没有跃过懒洋洋的狗。

v.t: vt. 讲, 叙述, 使互相关联 / vi. 有关, 符合, 相处得好
v.s: Fundamentally, the formation of the twelve zodiac signs is related to animal worship.
v.sz: 从根本上说，十二生肖的形成，与动物崇拜有关。
sx: On a fundamental level, the 12 forms of the Chinese zodiac are related to animal worship.
从根本上说，十二生肖的形成，与动物崇拜有关。
The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。

v.t: n. 鞋, 靴, 外胎 / vt. 给...穿鞋, 为马钉蹄铁
v.s: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
v.sz: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。
sx: In Asian culture it's customary to take one's shoes off before entering a house or temple.
在亚洲文化里，习惯在进一个房子或一座寺庙前先脱鞋子。
I make it a point to shine my shoes before I go to bed.
我习惯在睡觉前把鞋擦亮。

v.t: n. 隧道, 地下道 / vi. 挖隧道 / vt. 掘隧道于
v.s: The new tunnel is twice as long as the old one.
v.sz: 新建的隧道比以前的那一条长两倍。
sx: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
走进了漆黑的隧道后，我们甚么也看不见。
This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
这条隧道是那条的两倍长。

v.t: n. 创伤, 伤口, 伤疤, 伤害, 痛苦 / vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受伤 / vi. 打伤, 伤害 / wind的过去式和过去分词
v.s: When the wound got infected, he experienced a bout of unbearable pain.
v.sz: 伤口发炎后，他感到难忍无比的剧痛。
sx: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。
A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
一条受伤的鲸鱼在海滩边搁浅了。

v.t: n. 刷子, 毛笔, 争吵 / vt. 刷 / vi. 擦过, 掠过
v.s: I have to brush up my French before I go to Paris to study.
v.sz: 我去巴黎读书之前要先练好我的法文。
sx: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.
多数人每天至少刷两次牙。
Last night, I went to bed without brushing my teeth.
昨天晚上，我没刷牙就去睡觉了。

v.t: v. 抱怨, 抗议, 控诉
v.s: If you do silly things, you must accept the consequences without complaining.
v.sz: 如果你做了愚蠢的事，你就必须无怨尤接受痛苦惩罚。
sx: I don't want to hear any more of your complaining.
我不想再听你抱怨了。
Actions speak louder than words. Stop complaining and do it.
行动比语言更有说服力。别发牢骚多做事。

v.t: n. 训练, 纪律 / vt. 训练, 惩罚
v.s: Translation is a scholarly discipline.
v.sz: 翻译是一门学问。

v.t: a. 令人厌恶的
v.s: My roommate is so disgusting.
v.sz: 我的室友真恶心。

v.t: a. 占优势的, 支配的
n. 随笔, 短文, 评论, 企图 / vt. 试图
v.s: She will only go to bed after she finishes reading this short essay.
v.sz: 她看完这篇短文后才会去睡觉。
sx: There was always too much superfluous writing in his essays.
在他的文章中总是有太多肤浅的桥段。
The difference between a standalone sentence and a sentence in the middle of an essay is that the latter has context.
独立的句子和文章中的句子的区别在于后者具备上下文。

v.t: n. 费用, 代价, 开支, 损失
v.s: The students receive a 15,000 euro scholarship for their return trip and daily expenses.
v.sz: 学生们每人有一万五千欧罗的奖学金，用来支付回程机票和其他日常的费用。
sx: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.
计划的总开支为一亿円。
One thousand dollars will cover all the expenses for the party.
1000美元将负担聚会的全部费用。

v.t: n. 相片, 照片, 逼真的描绘 / v. 照相, 摄影
v.s: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.
v.sz: 这张照片让我想起童年的快乐时光。
sx: Look at these two photographs - which one is better?
你看这两张照片哪张好？
I need your passport and three photographs.
我需要你的护照和三张照片。

v.t: n. 波兰人, 极点, 磁极, 电极, 杆, 竿, 相反的极端 / vt. 用竿支撑 / vi. 撑篙
v.s: The temperature at the North Pole is different from at the South Pole.
v.sz: 北极与南极的温度不一样。
sx: They made huge, grotesque, yet beautiful poles of red cedar.
他们用红雪松制作了巨大、怪诞却又美丽的木杆。
Scott was the first man to reach the pole.
斯科特是第一个到达极点的人。

v.t: n. 酒馆, 客栈
v.s: I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
v.sz: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。
sx: We're going down the pub. Do you fancy coming?
我们要去酒吧。你有兴趣来吗？
There's a pub just around the corner.
在转角有一家酒吧。

v.t: n. 接待, 接受, 招待会
v.s: The reception in the cellar is really bad.
v.sz: 地下室里的信号很差。
sx: My mobile doesn't have any reception.
我手机没信号。

v.t: n. 食谱, 处方, 秘诀
v.s: The frog and I took turns guessing what the secret recipe was.
v.sz: 青蛙和我轮流猜了秘方是什么。
sx: This recipe requires acorn squash.
这个菜谱需要一些青南瓜。
This recipe is my grandmother's.
这是我奶奶的食谱。

v.t: n. 橡皮, 橡胶, 做摩擦动作的人, 按摩师, 决胜盘 / vt. 用橡胶制造, 涂橡胶于
v.s: Sorry, I won't do it without a rubber.
v.sz: 对不起，但是如果不用避孕套的话我不做。
sx: This isn't rubber.
这不是橡皮。

v.t: n. 车棚, 小屋, 脱落之物, 分水岭 / vt. 使流出, 放射, 脱落, 散发, 摆脱 / vi. 流出, 散布, 脱落
v.s: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.
v.sz: 她目睹爱犬在意外中离世，不禁泪如泉涌。
sx: You see the words that I typed on the screen, but you don't see the tears that I shed over the keyboard.
你看得见我打在萤幕上的字，却看不到我掉在键盘上的泪。
You need to shed some pounds.
你需要甩掉几磅。

v.t: a. 严厉的, 绝对的, 详尽的, 严格的, 精确的
v.s: Tom used to be a strict vegetarian.
v.sz: 汤姆已然成为了一名严格的素食主义者。
sx: We have to be strict.
我们要严厉。
He is strict yet kind.
他严厉却善良。

v.t: adv. 后来, 随后
n. 物质, 实质, 主旨, 资产, 本质, 牢固
v.s: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
v.sz: 这种物质很轻，可以浮在水面上。
sx: I would like to know how these substances are absorbed by the body.
我想知道这些物质是怎么被人体吸收的。
There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
自来水有可能含有氯、铅等有害物质。

v.t: n. 提议, 意见
v.s: We are open to all suggestions regarding the new design of the website.
v.sz: 关于网站的新设计，我们乐于接受任何建议。
sx: He thought she spoke reasonably, so he accepted her suggestion.
他觉得她说得很有道理，于是接受了她的建议。
Mike said a few words by way of suggestion.
麦克以建议的口气说了些话。

v.t: n. (贮存谷物等的)容器, 箱子
v.s: Hey, Tom, can we get two bins of lettuce?
v.sz: 嘿，汤姆，我们可以买两箱生菜吗？
sx: Toss it into the rubbish bin.
给丢到垃圾桶里去。
Throw it in the bin.
给丢到垃圾桶里去。

v.t: adv. 简短地, 扼要地, 简明地, 简单地
v.s: To put it briefly, I do not agree.
v.sz: 简而言之，我不同意。
sx: She glanced briefly at the newspaper.
她很快地瞟了一眼报纸。
We spoke briefly.
我们简短地谈了谈。

v.t: v. 攀登, 上升, 爬 / n. 攀登, 爬升
v.s: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
v.sz: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。
sx: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
我认为在有风暴的时候里登山很危险。
Even in rain and snow I enjoy mountain-climbing.
即使在雨中和在雪中，我喜欢登山。

v.t: n. 离开, 出发, 违背, 偏离
v.s: Departure is a partial death but death in essence is not only departure.
v.sz: 离开是部分的死亡，而死亡不仅仅是离开。
sx: In China, you have to go to the departure station and buy train tickets there.
在中国，人人必须去出发的火车站买车票。
With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
由于天气变差，出发延迟了。

v.t: vt. 挖, 翻土, 发掘 / vi. 挖掘 / n. 挖掘
v.s: I'm so embarrassed I could dig a hole and crawl into it.
v.sz: 我窘得想找个洞钻进去。
sx: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.
1848年人们来加利福尼亚淘金。
You can dig dirt from the ground.
你可以在地上挖土。

v.t: n. 雇主, 老板
v.s: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.
v.sz: 德国将禁止雇主在脸书上偷窥。

v.t: n. 爆发, 激增, 爆炸(声)
v.s: A series of explosions turned the laboratory into ruins.
v.sz: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。
sx: What was the cause of the explosion?
爆炸的原因是什么？
Three people were killed in the explosion.
这场爆炸中有三人丧生。

v.t: n. 人们, 家人, 亲属, 民族 / a. 民间的
v.s: We have to sing at an old folks home today.
v.sz: 我们今天得去养老院唱歌。
sx: Those folks are insane!
那些人疯了！

v.t: vt. 产生, 发生, 导致
v.s: By 2025, Indonesia is expected to generate 150 thousand tons of trash per day.
v.sz: 到 2025 年，印尼预计每天将产生 15 万公吨垃圾。
sx: The machine generated large amounts of electricity.
机器发了很多电。
An electric current can generate magnetism.
电流可以产生磁性。

v.t: n. 想像, 听觉, 想像力
v.s: No man has the imagination required to grasp female reason, which is why it is called unreasonable.
v.sz: 没有男人有能把控住女性理性的想象力，这就是为什么它被说无理。
sx: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
这超出了我的想像范围。
Imagination is the root of all civilization.
想像力是一切文明的根源。

v.t: n. 解释, 演出, 翻译
v.s: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
v.sz: 你的理解有点望文生义了。
sx: Your interpretation is a bit too literal.
你的理解有点望文生义了。
It is subject to interpretation.
这件事靠个人的立场来解释。

v.t: n. 叶, 树叶, 花瓣, 页 / vi. 生叶, 翻书页 / vt. 在...上长叶, 翻...的页
v.s: I'll turn over a new leaf and study English very hard.
v.sz: 我会重新开始，努力学习英语。
sx: Meg found a four leaf clover.
梅格发现了四片叶子的三叶草。
A dead leaf fell to the ground.
一片枯叶落到了地上。

v.t: a. 污秽的, 下流的, 险恶的
v.s: She gives me a nasty look every time she sees me.
v.sz: 她每次看见我都给露出厌恶的眼神。
sx: Regardless how many times I try to solve this nasty problem, I always end up failing.
对于这个棘手的问题，无论我尝试多少次，结果都会以失败告终。

v.t: n. 养老金, 退休金, 津贴, 年金, 抚恤金, 膳宿学校, 膳宿费 / vt. 发给退休金, 用津贴拉拢
v.s: People over 65 can receive a pension from the government.
v.sz: 过65岁的人就可以从政府那里领退休金了。

v.t: n. 许可证, 许可, 执照, 通行证 / vt. 允许, 容许, 可能, 使放手做 / vi. 容许, 给以机会, 提供可能
v.s: Do you think Tom will permit Mary to do that?
v.sz: 你认为汤姆会允许玛丽这么做吗？
sx: Will you permit me to go there?
您允许我去吗？
Permit me to do that for you.
请允许我为你做。

v.t: a. 愉快的, 可爱的, 活泼的, 亲切的
v.s: It was a pleasant day, but there were few people in the park.
v.sz: 那天天气很好，但公园里人并不多。
sx: It is very pleasant to cross the ocean by ship.
乘船过海非常舒服。
It is pleasant to shave off my beard.
刮完胡子感觉很舒服。

v.t: n. 轻蔑, 怠慢 / a. 轻微的, 纤细的, 脆弱的, 苗条的 / vt. 轻视, 忽略, 怠慢
v.s: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
v.sz: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
sx: I had a slight headache, so I went to bed early.
因为我有点头疼，所以我早早上床睡觉。
Slight inattention can cause a great disaster.
失之毫厘，谬之千里。

v.t: n. 紧张, 不安, 拉紧, 张力, 压力, 电压 / vt. 拉紧, 使紧张
v.s: Every transfer window is a test of judgment and patience, and every match brings its own surprises and tension.
v.sz: 每一次转会谈判都是对眼光与耐性的考验，每一个比赛日都充满未知的挑战与压力。

v.t: n. 一扭, 扭曲, 曲折, 歪曲, 螺旋状, 新手法 / vt. 拧, 扭, 捻, 编织, 使扭转, 缠绕, 盘绕, 歪曲, 使转动, 使苦恼, 使混乱, 使旋转 / vi. 转向, 弯曲, 缠绕, 扭动, 呈螺旋形
v.s: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
v.sz: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。
sx: Don't twist my words around.
不要扭曲我说的话。

v.t: n. 失业, 失业人数
v.s: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
v.sz: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。
sx: In the discussion the accent was on unemployment.
讨论的重点是失业问题。
The focus of the discussion was unemployment.
讨论的重点是失业问题。

v.t: n. 一致, 联合, 单一(性), 个体
v.s: Unity, justice and freedom are the pledge of fortune.
v.sz: 团结、公正和自由是幸福的保证。

v.t: a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的 / adv. 刺骨 / v. (使)变苦
v.s: His bitter words still rankle in my mind.
v.sz: 他尖刻的话语仍然在我心中挥之不去。
sx: They said they weren't bitter.
他们表示不感到遗憾。
This beer tastes bitter.
这种啤酒有苦味。

v.t: a. 聪明的, 精明的
v.s: No matter who it was that wrote this book, he's very clever.
v.sz: 我不知道这本书的作者是谁，但他肯定是个天才。
sx: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。
Although he may be clever, he is not wise.
他只不过是有点小聪明。

v.t: a. 连续的, 继续的, 连续不断的
v.s: But your function isn't Lipschitz continuous!
v.sz: 可是你的函数不符合利普希茨条件！

v.t: n. 盘子, 碟, 菜肴
v.s: The dishes were not so delicious, but otherwise the party was a success.
v.sz: 虽然食物不怎么好吃，但是派对在其它方面办得很出色。
sx: Let’s order the lobster! I’ve heard that’s the specialty dish here.
让我们点龙虾！听说是这里的招牌菜。
Soon the same waiter came back to pick up the dishes.
不久，同样的服务员回来拿起菜。

v.t: n. 鸭子 / vi. 没入水中, 闪避 / vt. 猛按...入水, 躲避
v.s: I tried to hit Tom, but he ducked.
v.sz: 我要去打汤姆，但是他避开了。
sx: It looks like a duck.
它看起来像一只鸭子。
He walks like a duck.
他走路走得像只鸭子似的。

v.t: n. 围墙, 栅栏, 买卖赃物的人, 剑术 / vt. 用篱笆围住, 练习剑术, 防护 / vi. 击剑, 搪塞
v.s: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
v.sz: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。
sx: Two children are sitting on top of the fence.
两个孩子在栅栏上坐着。
She was too short to see over the fence.
她太矮了，看不到围墙外面。

v.t: adv. 逐渐地
v.s: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
v.sz: 由硬体到软体的转变是缓慢的。
sx: To be honest, I've gradually come to dislike the life here.
老实说, 我已经渐渐地不喜欢这里的生活。
The sky has gradually clouded over.
乌云逐渐布满了整个天空。

v.t: n. 加亮区, 精彩场面 / vt. 加亮, 使显著, 以强光照射, 突出
n. 持有人, 所有人, 支持物
n. 制造业者, 厂商
n. 钉子, 指甲 / vt. 用钉钉牢, 使固定, 截住, 揭露
v.s: The poor sales during that Holiday season served as the final nail in the coffin for Boar Corporation.
v.sz: 那个假期销售业绩不佳，为博尔公司敲下了最后一根棺材钉。
sx: Ya-wen nailed her proposal yesterday. The boss kept nodding.
雅雯昨天提案超稳，主管一直点头。
Have you noticed any changes in your hair or nails?
您有注意到您的头髪或者指甲有什么变化吗？

v.t: n. 无意义的事, 荒谬言行, 荒唐
v.s: Do not talk nonsense, My job is very boring!
v.sz: 不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！
sx: Don't listen to him, he's talking nonsense.
别听他的, 他在说废话。
Don't talk nonsense, you know that's impossible.
别说废话了，你知道那是不可能的。

v.t: n. 诗人
v.s: Mathematicians are poets, except that they have to prove what their fantasy creates.
v.sz: 数学家是诗人，不过他们必须也能证明他们想像力的果实。
sx: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。
She's famous as a singer but not as a poet.
她是一个有名的歌手，但却没有多少人知道她也有写诗。

v.t: n. 科学家
v.s: I hope that some scientist will soon discover a cure for AIDS.
v.sz: 真希望科学家们能早点找到艾滋病的治疗方法。
sx: Scientists are working hard to put an end to AIDS.
科学家们正努力终结艾滋病。
A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
真正的科学家不会这样去思考。

v.t: n. 藏垢的场所, 沟渠, 污水槽 / vi. 下沉, 沉没, 下陷, 减弱, 衰退, 消沉, 堕落, 渗透 / vt. 使低落, 使下沉, 陷于, 投入(资金等), 挖掘
v.s: Keiko deftly piles up the dishes and takes them to the sink.
v.sz: 惠子巧妙地把碗碟迭起再拿到水槽。
sx: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.
我父亲的状况时好时坏。
Tom seems to have packed everything but the kitchen sink.
Tom把除了厨房水槽之外的所有东西都打包了。

v.t: vt. 使突然中断, 猛咬, 争夺, 拉断, 使有啪啪声, 厉声说, 突然射击, 用快照拍摄 / vi. 咬, 扑, 抓, 折断, 劈啪地响, 厉声说, 砰然关上 / n. 猛咬, 猛扑, 劈啪声, 申斥, 快照, 活力, 一般时期的寒冷天气, 揿钮 / a. 突然的, 装搭扣的 / adv. 猛地
v.s: Sorry, I didn't mean to snap at you.
v.sz: 对不起，我并不想对你发火。
sx: A cold snap spread across Europe.
一股寒流侵袭了欧洲。

v.t: n. 游泳, 漂浮, 潮流, 眩晕 / vi. 游泳, 游, 漂浮, 浸, 覆盖, 充溢, 大量拥有, 旋转, 眩晕 / vt. 游过, 使浮起
v.s: The child knows how to swim, so she won't drown in the water.
v.sz: 这个孩子知道如何游泳，所以她不会在水里溺死。
sx: In Hawaii, one can swim in the ocean all year round.
在夏威夷，一个人可以一年到头享受海水浴的乐趣。
He can't swim at all, but when it comes to skiing, he is the best.
他完全不会游泳，但却是一个滑雪高手。

v.t: n. 交易, 办理, 学报, 和解协议
a. 易受伤害的, 有弱点的, 易受影响的, 脆弱的, 成局的
v.s: Because of a flaw in the original design, our website is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks.
v.sz: 由于最初设计中的一个缺陷，我们的网站易受到SQL注入攻击。
sx: We're still vulnerable.
我们还是脆弱不堪。

v.t: vt. 吸引, 诱惑 / vi. 有吸引力
v.s: The Hsinchu Science Park has attracted many talents from other regions to work here.
v.sz: 新竹科学园区吸引了许多外地人才前来工作。
sx: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
第一个吸引我注意的科目是哲学。
I've been attracted to rabbits ever since.
从那时起，我就爱上兔子了。

v.t: a. 无聊的；烦人的；无趣的
v.s: Today we went to the shopping mall. I was very bored.
v.sz: 今天我们去了商城。我很无聊。
sx: At the beginning, I was bored with radio gymnastics, but now I do not dislike it.
我起初觉得广播体操很无聊，但是现在却喜欢上了。
She looked bored while we were making love.
当我们在做爱的时候，她看起来很厌烦。

v.t: n. 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人 / vt. 装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒 / vi. 捉虫, 暴突
v.s: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
v.sz: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
sx: The wicked witch cast a spell on the man and turned him into a bug.
恶毒的巫婆在男人身上施了咒语，把他变成了一只虫子。
A tent with a floor and a zipper is bug tight.
有垫布与拉链的帐篷可以做到防虫密闭。

v.t: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染 / vi. 通讯
v.s: Those two communicate a lot with each other at work, often rubbing shoulders.
v.sz: 他们俩工作上联系多，经常打交道。
sx: If you want to learn Chinese well, you should communicate with Chinese people more often.
要想学好中文，就应该多跟中国人交流。
My mother's French is better than my father's English, so they usually communicate in French.
我母亲的法语比我父亲的英语要好，所以他们通常用法语交流。

v.t: vt. 示范, 证明 / vi. 示威
v.s: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.
v.sz: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
sx: Can you demonstrate it?
您可以示范一下吗?

v.t: vi. 靠, 视...而定, 信赖
v.s: Now that she has quit her job, we can't depend on her.
v.sz: 现在她没了工作，我们再不能依靠她了。
sx: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
Some foreign words and names are not declined in Russian, usually depending on the ending and gender.
有些外来语和人名在俄语中没有变格，通常取决于词尾和性别。

v.t: n. 肉, 肉体, 肉欲, 人性, 亲属, 人类, 众生, 人体 / vt. 以肉喂, 激起...的杀戳情绪, 使肥, 赋以血肉 / vi. 长胖
v.s: I can only describe the terrible smell as vomit mixed with rotting flesh.
v.sz: 我只能描述这可怕的味道像呕吐物混合着烂肉。
sx: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.
我在电视上看到过他，不过没有看到过他本人。
The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
心有余而力不足。

v.t: a. 慷慨的, 有雅量的, 大量的, 丰富的
v.s: However, I've never been a guest in an English household that wasn't generous.
v.sz: 不过，我从来没有在一个小气的英国家庭做过客。
sx: Tom is a very generous man.
汤姆是个大方的人。
He is generous to his opponents.
他对自己的对手门很大度。

v.t: n. 工具, 器具, 手段 / vt. 实现, 使生效, 执行
v.s: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
v.sz: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。
sx: Our company will implement new price standards regarding this product.
关于这个产品，我公司将执行新的价格标准。
Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
很多公司实行8小时工作制。

v.t: n. 职业, 占有, 占有期, 占领, 占领军
v.s: I like to do oil painting, but I don't intend to make that my lifelong occupation.
v.sz: 我喜欢画油画，但是我不想拿它做我的终身职业。
sx: What is your occupation?
你做什么工作？
What's your occupation?
您的职业是什么？

v.t: n. 对手, 敌手, 反对者 / a. 敌对的, 反对的, 对面的
v.s: The home team always have an advantage over their opponents.
v.sz: 主场队总是比对手有优势。
sx: He knocked his opponent out.
他把对手击倒了。
Our team defeated our opponent 5-4.
我们这队5-4击败对手。

v.t: n. 耐性, 忍耐
v.s: The source of many of our mistakes is a lack of patience.
v.sz: 许多错误源自于我们缺乏耐心。
sx: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。
Every transfer window is a test of judgment and patience, and every match brings its own surprises and tension.
每一次转会谈判都是对眼光与耐性的考验，每一个比赛日都充满未知的挑战与压力。

v.t: n. 污染, 玷污
v.s: Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.
v.sz: 如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。
sx: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
环境污染可以对一个区域的生态造成极大的影响。
With the increase of cars, the air pollution has gotten worse.
随著汽车的增加，空气也跟著变糟。

v.t: adv. 精确地, 明确地, 刻板地, 拘泥地, 正好, 恰恰, 对, 正是如此, 确实如此, 不错
v.s: I arrive precisely when I mean to.
v.sz: 我想准时到，就会准时到。

v.t: n. 囚犯, 犯人, 战俘
v.s: Nobody can deny that the prisoner is guilty.
v.sz: 人们不能否认犯人是有罪的。
sx: The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.
国王下令把囚犯释放。
The prisoners fought one another like so many mad people.
囚犯们像疯子一样互相殴斗。

v.t: n. 特权, 特别恩典, 基本权利, 特免 / vt. 给与...特权, 特免
v.s: It is a great privilege to be with you in Tatoeba.
v.sz: 在Tatoeba与你相会是我的幸运。
sx: He had the privilege of a private education.
他享有私人教学的特权。
It is a privilege to meet you.
幸会。

v.t: v. 抵抗, 耐得住, 抵制, 反抗 / n. 防染材料
v.s: It's hard to resist the wish to make the sentence rhyme.
v.sz: 难以抵抗给句子押韵的愿望。
sx: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。
No man can resist the lure of a woman.
没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。

v.t: n. 观光客, 旅行者 / a. 旅游的
v.s: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
v.sz: 爱丁堡已经供应一个繁忙而传统的城市，有许多历史性的建筑物和名胜。
sx: St Mark's Square in Venice is always swarming with tourists in the summer.
威尼斯的圣马可广场在夏季总是挤满了游客。
Many foreign tourists consider Ximending one of the must-visit spots in Taipei.
许多外国观光客都把西门町列为台北必访景点之一。

v.t: n. 外套, 围巾, 包裹物, 限制, 约束, 秘密, 换行 / vt. 包装, 卷, 缠绕, 包, 裹, 覆盖, 遮蔽, 隐藏, 掩护 / vi. 缠绕, 穿外衣, 包起来
v.s: Are you going to eat here or do you want us to wrap it?
v.sz: 您是在这儿用餐，还是给您打包带走？
sx: Can you wrap it up for me? It's a gift.
可以帮我包起来吗？我拿来送人的。
Please wrap it like a Christmas present.
请把它包装得像一个圣诞礼物。

v.t: vt. 采用, 正式通过, 收养, 接受
v.s: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
v.sz: 政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。
sx: My wife wants to adopt a child.
我妻子想收养一个孩子。
Adopt his concepts.
采用他的理念。

v.t: prep. 在旁边
v.s: Any student of this school must learn one more foreign language besides English.
v.sz: 除了英语，这个学校的所有学生必须多学一门外语。
sx: We know very well where our developments will take us. Besides, in the team, everyone does as he pleases.
我们都清楚地知道我们的发展走向，另外，团队中每个人都有点随心所欲。
There was no one in the room besides Tom and Mary.
除了汤姆和玛丽，房间里没有人。

v.t: n. 叶片, 刀锋, 刀口, 剑
v.s: The knife has a keen blade.
v.sz: 这把刀的刀锋很利。

v.t: n. 长靴, 踢, 解雇, 效用 / vt. 使穿靴, 踢, 解雇, 有用
v.s: Do you need as many licenses as you have operating systems installed in a multi-boot PC?
v.sz: 在多重引导电脑上安装多少作业系统，就需要多少授权吗？
sx: When the ball was dead, Luis ran up to the ball and booted it.
在死球期间，路易斯跑向球，一脚踢上去。
I would like to purchase some boots.
我想买些靴子。

v.t: n. 硬币, 金钱, 货币 / vt. 铸币, 创造, 杜撰
v.s: I found a pot in which there were several old coins.
v.sz: 我找到一个装有几枚古钱币的锅子。
sx: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
One side of the coin is called 'heads', and the other is called 'tails'.
硬币的一面叫做"公"，另一面叫做"字"。

v.t: n. 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序
v.s: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.
v.sz: 每一个函数都应该有描述其目的的注释以避免误解。
sx: The accident caused traffic confusion.
那场意外使交通大乱。

v.t: n. 玉蜀黍, 谷类, 谷粒, 鸡眼 / vt. 使成颗粒, 腌
v.s: What country has the absolute advantage in the production of corn?
v.sz: 哪一个国家拥有生产玉米的绝对优势？
sx: Our breakfast has oats and corn in it.
我们早餐有燕麦和玉米。
I bought a bag of frozen corn.
我买了一包冰冻玉米。

v.t: n. 经销商, 商人
v.s: My decision was based on a dealer recommendation.
v.sz: 我是听从经销商的建议做的决定。

v.t: a. 远的, 疏远的
v.s: Today we can go to distant countries easily by plane.
v.sz: 现在我们很容易就能乘飞机去遥远的国度。
sx: Tom is a distant relative of mine.
汤姆是我的远亲。
We saw the gleam of a distant lighthouse.
我们看到了远方灯塔的微光。

v.t: n. 情绪, 激动, 强烈的情感
v.s: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
v.sz: 攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。
sx: Smiling is the best remedy for negative emotions.
笑容是坏心情的最佳药方。
Gender norms should not dictate how individuals cope with and process their emotions.
性别规范不应该规定个人如何面对或处理自己的情绪。

v.t: n. 强调, 加强, 重点, 强语气
v.s: Modern healthy eating experts put emphasis on eating wholemeal bread and eating more vegetables.
v.sz: 现代的健康饮食专家强调要吃全麦面包，多吃蔬菜。
sx: I would like to place particular emphasis on this point.
我想特别强调这一点。
He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
他强调了教育的重要性。

v.t: n. 刺激, 兴奋
v.s: Hearing that a transfer student was coming, the class buzzed with excitement.
v.sz: 听说要来一个转校生之后，全班都乱哄哄地活跃起来。
sx: There was a lot of excitement in the stands as the fans cheered for their teams.
球迷们在为自己喜欢的球队欢呼，看台上总是一片热闹的景象。
She turned over the page with excitement.
她兴奋地翻了翻书页。

v.t: n. 精神, 勇气, 叶脉, 神经 / vt. 鼓起勇气
v.s: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
v.sz: 这完全一团乱，让我心烦意乱。
sx: She had the nerve to speak out.
她竟敢说出来。
That music gets on his nerves.
那音乐烦死他了。

v.t: n. 馅饼, 财富, 总额, 贪污受贿, 杂乱, 喜鹊
v.s: I watched as my grandmother pulled a golden butter pie from the oven.
v.sz: 我看著奶奶从烤箱里拿出一个金黄色的奶油派。
sx: Can I have a piece of this apple pie?
我可以吃一块苹果派吗？
My mother often bakes apple pies for us.
母亲经常为我们做苹果派。

v.t: n. 海报, 招贴, 驿马
v.s: He paused to look at the poster.
v.sz: 他停下脚步看起海报。
sx: Where are those posters now?
那些海报现在都到哪里去了？

v.t: adv. 几乎, 差不多, 事实上
v.s: Although this sentence has no grammatical mistakes, I think it would practically never be used.
v.sz: 这句话虽然语法没错，但我认为现实中几乎没人会这么说。
sx: The famous hotel was practically destroyed by a large fire.
著名的酒店几乎被大火烧毁了。
Tom would do practically anything to keep Mary happy.
为了哄玛莉开心，汤姆几乎会做任何事。

v.t: vt. 保护, 保持, 保存, 维持, 腌, 禁猎 / vi. 加工食品, 禁猎 / n. 加工成的食品, 禁猎地, 保护区, 防护物
v.s: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
v.sz: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。
sx: While you drone on about preserving the standard of living for the middle class, our parents are dying of hypothermia.
当您滔滔不绝地谈论著维护中产阶级的生活水准时，我们的父母正死于体温过低。
They have preserved the building.
他们保存了这建筑。

v.t: vi. 取得资格, 有资格 / vt. 使有资格, 使合格, 限定, 限制, 准予
v.s: Do you think that you are qualified for that aspect of the work?
v.sz: 你认为可以胜任那些方面的工作？
sx: Many people get a job in customer services before they are qualified for other positions.
许多人在获得其他职位的资格之前就从事客服工作。
Do you think I'm qualified for that job?
你觉得我能胜任那个工作吗？

v.t: n. 羊, 胆小者
v.s: What do you call a man who takes care of sheep in the field?
v.sz: 在草原上照顾羊群的人叫甚么？
sx: Do you want to trade our two sheep, one for another?
你想把我们的两只羊一换一吗？
Cheese is a solid food made from the milk of cows, goats, sheep, and other mammals.
奶酪是由母牛、山羊、绵羊或其它哺乳动物的奶加工制成的固体食物。

v.t: n. 出租车 / vi. 乘出租车 / vt. 用出租车送
v.s: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
v.sz: 你觉得绕路的司机占所有的出租车司机的百分之多少？
sx: I found a taxi, but there was no driver inside.
我找到了一辆出租车，但里面却没有司机。
Not long after I joined the queue, a man approached and asked if I wanted a taxi.
我排上队不久后，一个男人过来问我要不要出租车。

v.t: n. 虚弱, 薄弱, 弱点
v.s: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
v.sz: 战士知道自己的力量和弱点。
sx: The ability to show weakness is a strength.
示弱是一种力量。
What are the company's strengths and weaknesses?
公司的长处和短处是什么？

v.t: a. 充分伸展的, 广布的, 普及的, 流传广的
v.s: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
v.sz: 陪审团作出的犯罪判决激起了很大的争论。
sx: She was closely related to the mighty Queen Zurline, and her home was beneath the shade of a widespreading oak.
她与强大的祖琳女王有著密切的血缘关系，她的家在一棵枝繁叶茂的橡树荫下。
There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
地震后人们普遍觉得恐慌。

v.t: vt. 承认, 告知收悉, 答谢, 报偿
v.s: She acknowledged that my statement was true.
v.sz: 她承认我的声明是真实的。
sx: I have acknowledged my mistake.
我承认了我的错误。
She acknowledged she was upset.
她承认她很苦恼。

v.t: n. 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述
v.s: It's necessary that we all work together to complete this assignment.
v.sz: 我们必须一起完成这个任务。
sx: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。
Now that I have finished this assignment I want to go to sleep, but I have to go to school.
我做完功课，想去睡觉，可是又要上学⋯⋯

v.t: n. 取消, 撤消, 盖销(邮票) / vt. 取消, 删去, 抵销, 盖销 / vi. 相互抵销
v.s: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.
v.sz: 说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。
sx: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.
我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
The track and field meet was canceled due to rain.
田径运动会因天雨关系取消了。

v.t: n. 地毯, 地毯状物 / vt. 铺以地毯, 铺盖
v.s: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
v.sz: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
sx: White carpets are very hard to keep clean.
白色的地毡很难保持干净。
I spilled my coffee on the carpet.
我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。

v.t: n. 天花板
v.s: You might as well read a novel instead of staring at the ceiling.
v.sz: 望着天花板发呆,还不如读一读小说。
sx: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
装置被牢牢地固定在天花板上。
The attic was a long, low-ceilinged room, dark and fragrant with the odor of the cedar.
阁楼是一个狭长的低矮房间，光线昏暗，弥漫著雪松的香气。

v.t: n. 樱桃, 樱桃树, 樱桃色
v.s: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.
v.sz: 学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。
sx: Right now is the time of year to see the cherry blossoms.
现在是看樱桃树的期间。
This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.
本周公园樱花盛开。

v.t: n. 线索, 暗示 / vt. 暗示, 提供线索
v.s: The authorities have no clue, but everyone else knows.
v.sz: 旁观者清，当局者迷。
sx: I haven't got a clue as to why he quit so suddenly.
我完全不明白他为甚么会突然辞职。
The police didn't find any clues.
警方没有发现任何线索。

v.t: n. 崩溃, 倒塌, 虚脱 / vi. 倒塌, 崩溃, 瓦解 / vt. 使倒塌, 折叠
v.s: Two persons were killed when an elevated bike path collapsed in Rio.
v.sz: 当里约热内卢的一条高架自行车道倒塌时，有2人被砸死了。
sx: The woman has suffered from a collapse, because she ate meat from a water buffalo.
女人食用水牛肉导致晕厥。
If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!
若有大地震，房屋会倒塌呀！

v.t: a. 有意识的, 知觉的, 觉察的
v.s: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
v.sz: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
sx: Tom is environmentally conscious.
汤姆有环保意识。

v.t: v. 检查, 调查, 考试
v.s: It's hard for people to examine and correct their own flaws.
v.sz: 人们难以审视和纠正自身的问题。
sx: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
他拿了面镜子细看自己的舌头。
The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.
医生用X光检查我的胃。

v.t: n. 垃圾, 废物
v.s: He had gone there to help garbage workers strike peacefully for better pay and working conditions.
v.sz: 他去了那里帮助清洁工人和平地争取更高的薪金和更好的工作环境。
sx: Oh, I almost forgot! Today is garbage disposal day!
啊！差点忘了。今天是扔垃圾的日子！
Throwing garbage on the street is not a good habit, remember?
在街上乱丢垃圾不是好习惯，记得吗？

v.t: n. 加热, 供热, 暖气设备, 供暖系统, 暖气装置 / a. 加热的, 供暖的
v.s: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
v.sz: 我很高兴他们修复了暖气系统，但现在太热了。
sx: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
把水加热不改变它的化学成分。
This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.
这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。

v.t: n. 混合, 混淆, 混合物
v.s: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
v.sz: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。
sx: The London to Amsterdam flight was partially powered with a mixture of coconut and babassu nut oil.
伦敦飞往阿姆斯特丹的航班部分动力来自椰子油和巴巴苏坚果油的混合物。
The mixture of these substances is dangerous.
把这些物质混合起来是很危险的。

v.t: n. 知觉, 感觉, 领悟力, 获取
v.s: Perception is reality.
v.sz: 感知即现实。

v.t: vi. 继续进行, 进行, 开始, 发出, 起诉
v.s: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.
v.sz: 我们会把一部分筹得的款项用来帮助残疾儿童。
sx: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
让我们继续进行议程上的项目。
Follow my instructions and proceed carefully.
按照我的指示小心谨慎地前进。

v.t: vt. 回复, 恢复, 归还, 修补, 修复 / vt. 还原 / vi. 还原
v.s: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
v.sz: 一座历史地标已经修复并将重新开放。

v.t: n. 对手, 竞争者 / a. 竞争的
v.s: The washing-up machine at home was regarded as a rival to the worker at the kitchen sink.
v.sz: 家里的洗碗机算是厨房水槽旁洗碗工的对手。
sx: He was hired away by a rival company.
他被竞争公司挖去了。
He surpasses his rivals in all ways.
他在各方面都超出他的对手。

v.t: n. 重要性, 意义, 意味
v.s: I don't understand its significance.
v.sz: 我没有领会这个意义。

v.t: n. 肥皂, 阿谀 / vt. 以肥皂洗, 阿谀
v.s: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
v.sz: 我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。
sx: From what I understand, those who watch Korean soap operas basically are women with nothing to do.
我了解的情况是看韩剧者基本上是一些无所事事的女人。
This soap is infused with natural fragrances.
这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。

v.t: n. 水沫, 浪花, 水花, 喷雾, 喷雾器, 小树枝 / vt. 喷雾, 扫射, 喷射 / vi. 喷, 溅开
v.s: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
v.sz: 玛丽的包里有辣椒喷雾。

v.t: vt. 祝福, 祈佑, 使神圣化
v.s: Thank you. God bless you. And may God bless the United States of America.
v.sz: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国
sx: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
施比受更有福。
I am blessed with good health.
上帝赐予我健康的身体。

v.t: n. 抚弄, 赶走, 抛掷, 咯咯声, 颈肉, 卡盘 / vt. 轻拍, 抛掷, 驱逐, 丢弃, 用卡盘夹住 / vi. 咯咯叫
v.s: She decided to chuck her job in.
v.sz: 她决定要丢下她的工作。
sx: Chuck it in the bin.
给丢到垃圾桶里去。
It's chucking it down.
雨下得很大。

v.t: n. 电影院, 电影
v.s: It turns out that they went to the cinema the day before yesterday.
v.sz: 原来他们前天去电影院啦。
sx: Do you want to go to the cinema or the theater?
您想去电影院还是去剧院吗？
Where are we going now? To the theatre or the cinema?
我们现在去哪里？去剧场还是电影院？

v.t: a. 温和的, 文雅的
v.s: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.
v.sz: 微风在湖面上掀起了一丝丝涟漪。
sx: Wish big, aim high, be gentle, be careful.
愿要大、志要坚、气要柔、心要细。
On the country path, a gentle breeze blows, and the scent of night-blooming jasmine reminds one of childhood nights.
乡间小路上，微风拂过，夜来香的香味让人想起童年的夜晚。

v.t: n. 语法学, 入门书
v.s: According to my experience, it takes one year to master French grammar.
v.sz: 根据我的经验，掌握法语语法需要一年的时间。
sx: One learns grammar from language, not language from grammar.
人是从语言里学会语法，而非从语法里学会语言的。
Shihai is carrying a Chinese grammar book to go to Teacher Wang's place and ask questions.
世海拿着一本中文语法书去王老师那儿问问题。

v.t: n. 果酱, 拥塞之物, 堵塞, 困境 / vt. 挤进, 使塞满, 混杂, 压碎, 使堵塞 / vi. 堵塞, 轧住, 拥挤
v.s: If you leave now, I'm sure you'll be caught in a traffic jam.
v.sz: 你现在出门的话，肯定会堵车的。
sx: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。
The handyman was supposed to arrive at twelve noon, but got stuck in a traffic jam for a few hours.
这个工人本来应该在中午十二点到达, 但他被交通堵塞困住了几个小时。

v.t: n. 概念, 观念, 想法, 打算, 别致的小东西
n. 反映, 沉思, 映像, 想法, 责难
v.s: A little reflection will show you that you are wrong.
v.sz: 只要你细心想一想，就会明白自己的错处了。
sx: Tom looked at his reflection in the mirror.
汤姆看他在镜中的映像。
I saw my reflection in the window.
我在窗户上看见了我的映像。

v.t: vi. 决定, 分解, 决心 / vt. 使分解, 解析, 解决, 消除, 决心 / n. 决定之事, 决心, 坚决
v.s: If you don't resolve to become a good man, then you just won't get a good woman.
v.sz: 如果你没决心做好男人,那你就得不到好女人。
sx: This case might not get resolved for a while.
这个案件可能不会在短时间内就解决。
Only when the Party Committee Secretary came in person to resolve it was this point of view dispelled entirely.
直到党委书记出面加以解释，才算打消了这种想法。

v.t: n. 光泽, 阳光 / vt. 使发光 / vi. 照耀, 发光, 发亮
v.s: Whether rain or shine, I go to the park every day to run.
v.sz: 不管下不下雨，我都每天去公园跑步。
sx: The sun shines through the tri-color clouds, shooting towards the earth.
阳光穿过三色云，射向大地。
Not everyone who shines in the morning shines in the afternoon.
早上发光的人，下午不一定发光。

v.t: a. 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正当的
v.s: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
v.sz: 我们这样待他，好像不是太好。
sx: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。
That was really unfair.
那真不公平。

v.t: vi. 道歉, 辩解
v.s: I apologize for the methods used to get you here.
v.sz: 我很抱歉用这种方式把你请来。
sx: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
你应该为你没有及时回家吃晚餐向你父亲道歉。
I'm not going to apologize. What are you going to do about it?
我就是不道歉，你奈我何？

v.t: n. 阿姨, 姨妈, 舅妈, 姑妈, 伯母
v.s: I ran into my aunt by chance in Europe.
v.sz: 我在欧洲偶遇了姑母。
sx: My aunt sent me a birthday present.
我阿姨送了我一个生日礼物。
My aunt grows tomatoes in her garden.
我阿姨在她的花园种蕃茄。

v.t: n. 人, 动物, 创造物, 生物
v.s: How can there exist a creature as adorable as a cat?
v.sz: 怎么会有猫咪这么可爱的生物？
sx: The octopus is an extremely intelligent sea creature.
章鱼是一种非常聪明的海洋生物。
You cannot compare the strength of a man to that of a tiger, but nevertheless, the tiger is still the inferior creature.
虎与人是无法比拼力量的，但是，老虎还是比人类低等。

v.t: n. 决心, 果断
v.s: The soul is made up of reason, determination, and passion.
v.sz: 灵魂是由理性、意志和情欲构成的。
sx: If confidence, determination and courage are together in one place, there is nothing that cannot be done.
信心、毅力、勇气三者具备，则天下没有做不成的事。
He made a determination to be a doctor.
他下定了决心要做医生。

v.t: n. 绅士, 先生
v.s: He must be a gentleman to act that way.
v.sz: 这样的举止只可能是个绅士。
sx: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。
He is definitely not a gentleman.
他绝对不是绅士。

v.t: adv. 而且, 此外
v.s: It's a cat, and moreover an orange one.
v.sz: 这是一只猫，而且是一只橘色的猫。
sx: Moreover, I can fly.
此外，我能飞。

v.t: pron. 我们的
v.s: Many companies have attempted to manufacture this complex component at scale, but so far only ours has succeeded.
v.sz: 许多公司都尝试过大规模生产这种复杂的零件，但目前只有我们成功了。
sx: The things in this village are cheaper than those in ours.
这条村的东西比我们村的便宜多了。
Your team is stronger than ours.
你们的队伍比我们的强。

v.t: n. 政客, 政治家, 从事党派政治的人
v.s: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.
v.sz: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。
sx: He promised to bring new industries to the region, but politicians rarely keep their word.
他承诺给这个地区带来新的工业，但是政治家很少完成他们的承诺。
The politician didn't appear in public after the incident.
发生了那件事以后，那位政治家一直没有公开露面。

v.t: vi. 起反应, 起作用, 反攻
v.s: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
v.sz: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。
sx: Tom was the first to react.
汤姆是最先作出反应的。
Tom was too surprised to react.
汤姆惊讶得没有反应。

v.t: a. 现实的, 逼真的, 现实主义的, 实在论的
v.s: Let's be realistic.
v.sz: 现实点吧。

v.t: vt. 保持, 保有, 留住, 记得, 付定金聘请
n. 满足, 满意, 快事, 赔偿, 赎罪, 报仇的机会
v.s: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
v.sz: 无论读书的目的是什么，书总会带给我们乐趣和满足。
sx: I won't give them the satisfaction.
我不会让他们得逞的。

v.t: n. 抓痕, 搔, 抓, 擦伤, 刮擦声, 乱写, 零分, 起跑线 / vt. 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 乱涂, 勾抹掉 / vi. 搔, 抓, 发刮擦声, 勉强糊口 / a. 碰巧的, 凑合的, 打草稿用的
v.s: Have I got to do it from scratch?
v.sz: 我得从头开始做吗？
sx: The boy scratched his ear.
那男孩搔了搔耳朵。
Your cat scratched me.
你的猫抓伤我了。

v.t: n. 准许进入, 入场费, 录用, 承认
v.s: There is no admission fee for children under five.
v.sz: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。
sx: The admission is ten dollars a person.
入场费一个人10美元。
Admission to the museum is thirty dollars.
博物馆入场费是三十美元。

v.t: n. 熏猪肉
v.s: BLT stands for bacon, lettuce and tomato.
v.sz: BLT 代表培根、生菜和番茄。

v.t: n. 障碍, 栅栏
v.s: Some birds can break the sound barrier.
v.sz: 有的鸟可以穿越音障。

v.t: n. 破裂, 突发, 爆发 / v. 爆裂, 突发, 充满
v.s: No sooner had the child seen his mother than he burst into tears.
v.sz: 孩子一见到母亲就哭了起来。
sx: Xiaoming could not handle his mother's scolding anymore, bursting into tears.
小明忍耐不了妈妈的责骂，便嚎啕大哭。
Hardly had he entered the room, when she burst into tears.
他刚进房间，她就泣不成声了。

v.t: n. 教室
v.s: Having their classroom time extended is a very common occurrence for students.
v.sz: 拖堂情况对于学生们而言十分常见。
sx: Some of the students are in the library, but the others are in the classroom.
有些学生去了图书馆，但其他的都在课室里。
He organized a classroom debate on current events.
他组织了一场关于时事的课堂辩论。

v.t: a. 方便的, 合宜的
v.s: Is it convenient to transfer between the subway and the light rail here?
v.sz: 这儿要换地铁和轻轨方便吗？
sx: What is the most convenient route to your place?
去您那儿怎么走最方便？
The transportation in this city is very convenient.
这个城市的交通方便得很。

v.t: n. 农作物, 产量, 平头 / vt. 收割, 修剪, 种植 / vi. 收获
v.s: The farmer warned the children not to stomp on the freshly planted crops.
v.sz: 农夫警告孩子们不要践踏新栽种的作物。
sx: Without bee pollination, California's almond crop, for example, would be non-existent.
例如，如果没有蜜蜂授粉，加州的杏仁作物就不会存在。
Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.
通过遗传修饰，我们可以改良农作物。

v.t: a. 过了中年的, 稍老的
v.s: It can make some people, especially the elderly and infants, very ill.
v.sz: 它可以使一些人，尤其是老人和婴幼儿，病得很重。
sx: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
我们移走了行李腾出空间让老太太可以坐下。
She gave her seat to an elderly person.
她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

v.t: n. 农夫, 农场主
v.s: The farmer warned the children not to stomp on the freshly planted crops.
v.sz: 农夫警告孩子们不要践踏新栽种的作物。
sx: During droughts, farmers are barely able to eke out a living.
发生旱灾的时候，农民很难维持生计。
When the full moon falls down on the roof at night, all the farmers are woken up.
当夜晚满月掉落在屋顶上时, 所有的农夫都被吵醒了。

v.t: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满 / vi. 提供资料, 告发
v.s: We are informed by newspapers of the major events that take place every day.
v.sz: 我们从报纸中获知每天发生的重大事件。
sx: Ziri and Rima didn’t even call the school to inform them.
齐里和里玛甚至没有打电话通知学校。
I am well-informed about this topic.
我对这件事知情。

v.t: adv. 安静地, 沉着地, 秘密地
v.s: I shut the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
v.sz: 为了不吵醒宝宝，我静静地关上了门。
sx: Tom quietly opened the door and tiptoed into the room.
汤姆悄悄地打开了门，蹑手蹑脚地走进了房间。
He read a book quietly, as though nothing had happened.
他安静地读著书，仿佛什么事都没发生过。

v.t: n. 色拉
v.s: My mom forgot to add salt to the salad.
v.sz: 我妈妈忘了往沙拉里加盐了。
sx: I bought a bottle of salad oil.
我买了一瓶沙拉油。
Put the tomato salad in the refrigerator.
把蕃茄沙拉放进冰箱里。

v.t: n. 汤, 马力 / vt. 加速, 增加马力
v.s: Even though my friend was a vegetarian, I didn't tell him that the soup had some meat in it.
v.sz: 我的朋友是吃素的，可是我没有告诉他汤里有肉。
sx: In this soup there are carrots, onions, parsley, celery and potatoes.
这个汤里有胡萝卜、洋葱、欧芹、芹菜和土豆。
Eat your soup while it is hot.
趁热喝你的汤。

v.t: n. 桩, 炮烙刑, 木柱, 赌注, 奖金 / vt. 打桩, 用桩撑, 下赌注, 资助 / vi. 打赌
v.s: I felt that my honor was at stake.
v.sz: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。
sx: I'll stake my reputation on it.
我赌上我的名声。

v.t: n. 紧张, 拉紧, 张力, 过劳, 扭伤, 血缘, 种, 族, 气质, 曲调, 旋律, 口吻 / vt. 使劳累, 拉紧, 过分使用, 扭伤, 滥用, 曲解, 滤 / vi. 尽力, 努力, 紧拉, 弯曲, 被滤出
v.s: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
v.sz: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。
sx: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
汤姆最近压力特别大。
The rope broke under the strain.
绳子被拉断了。

v.t: n. 工具, 复滑车, 滑车, 装备, 扭倒 / vt. 固定, 处理, 抓住 / vi. 扭倒
v.s: To begin with, we must tackle the problem.
v.sz: 首先我们必须处理这个问题。
sx: When Mike tried to tackle the other player, he pushed him and he was given a yellow card and a warning.
当迈克试图铲球的时候，他用手推了对方球员一把，结果得到了黄牌警告。

v.t: a. 紧急的, 急迫的, 催逼的
v.s: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
v.sz: 急需医疗用品。
sx: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
This matter is very urgent.
这件事非常紧急。

v.t: n. 工场, 车间, 研讨会
v.s: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
v.sz: 有人发现一个老工人在车间修机器。

v.t: a. 醒着的 / vt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到 / vi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
v.s: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
v.sz: 咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。
sx: Take care not to awake the sleeping baby.
小心不要弄醒了正在睡觉的婴儿。
My brother often stays awake the whole night.
我弟弟会经常彻夜不睡。

v.t: n. 空格, 空白 / a. 空白的, 空虚的, 完全的, 无色的 / vi. 消失, 成为空白 / vt. 使无效, 取消, 封锁
v.s: I'm in the habit of taking handwritten notes, yet I still often draw a blank when picking up a pen.
v.sz: 我有手写笔记的习惯，但依然经常提笔忘字。
sx: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
请在空格上填上适当的字词。
I asked him point-blank.
我直接地问了他。

v.t: n. 定罪, 信服, 坚信
v.s: One must have conviction in law, or its existence will be superficial only.
v.sz: 法律必须被信仰，否则形同虚设。
sx: Betty has a previous conviction for theft.
贝蒂有盗窃前科。

v.t: n. 母牛, 母兽 / vt. 威胁
v.s: He could be found at 6 o'clock every morning in the barn, milking the cows.
v.sz: 他每天早上六点都会在牲口棚给母牛挤牛奶。
sx: She can wait till the cows come home but he'll never come back.
她可以无止尽的等待, 但是他将永远不会回来。
I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.
我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人。

v.t: n. 曲线, 弯曲, 曲线球 / vt. 弯, 使弯曲 / vi. 成曲形
a. 鼓励的, 促进的
v.s: I wrote a post to my blog encouraging men to report experiences with domestic abuse.
