v.sz: 我在部落格上发表了一篇文章，鼓励男性举报自己遭受家庭虐待的经历。
sx: Tom is encouraging his students.
汤姆正在鼓励他的学生。
I am encouraging my brother.
我正在鼓励我的哥哥。

v.t: n. 祖母, 女祖先
v.s: Some of my classmates from primary school are already grandmothers and grandfathers.
v.sz: 我的一些小学同学都已经当爷爷奶奶了。
sx: It's been a long time since I visited my grandmother.
我已经很久没有探望过祖母了。
Grandmother died, leaving the whole family stunned.
奶奶死了，全家大惊。

v.t: n. 匆忙, 急忙, 急促 / vt. 急派, 催促 / vi. 匆忙, 赶快
v.s: Don't you think it odd that she was in such a hurry?
v.sz: 她那么匆匆忙忙的，你不觉得很奇怪吗？
sx: While walking, I used to feel somewhat in a hurry.
以前，我散步的时候感觉有点匆忙。
How about a cup of tea or something, if you aren't in a hurry?
如果你不赶时间的话，为不么不喝杯茶甚么的呢？

v.t: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀
v.s: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.
v.sz: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
sx: Interest rates and inflation were high.
利率和通货膨胀很高。

v.t: n. 检验, 检查, 视察
v.s: Korea allowed an inspection by the IAEA.
v.sz: 韩国允许了国际原子能总署的视察。

v.t: vt. 安装, 安置, 使就职
v.s: Do you need as many licenses as you have operating systems installed in a multi-boot PC?
v.sz: 在多重引导电脑上安装多少作业系统，就需要多少授权吗？
sx: The cellphone came with several applications already pre-installed.
这部手机和一些预装的应用一起出售。
The man tried to install his own antenna.
这男人试着安装他自己的天线。

v.t: n. 指令, 教导, 命令
v.s: The manager and coach stood on the touchline shouting out instructions to their team.
v.sz: 足球教练站在边线上对自己的队伍喊出指令。
sx: From reading good books we can derive pleasure, friendship, experience and instruction.
读书，可以获得乐趣、友谊、经验和指导。
Can you please leave us a list of instructions for how to take care of your pets while you're gone?
你离开的这段时间，关于怎么照顾你的宠物，可以麻烦你留一份说明给我们吗？

v.t: vt. 替...辩护, 证明 / vi. 证明合法
v.s: The end does not always justify the means.
v.sz: 为了正当目的并非总是可以不择手段.
sx: The end justifies the means.
为了正当目的可以不择手段。

v.t: n. 瘦肉, 倾斜, 倾斜度 / a. 瘦的, 贫乏的, 歉收的 / vi. 倚靠, 倾斜, 依赖 / vt. 使倾斜
v.s: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.
v.sz: 把你的肩膀借给我让我依靠。
sx: The tower leaned slightly to the west.
塔有点向西边倾斜。
He was leaning against the wall.
他靠著墙。

v.t: n. 演讲, 谴责, 讲稿 / vt. 演讲, 训诫, 说教 / vi. 讲演
v.s: The lecture was very long, but I enjoyed it none the less.
v.sz: 那场演讲很长，但我却听得津津有味。
sx: In his lectures, Professor Hunter prefers to study the blackboard rather than look at his students.
亨特教授在讲课时更喜欢盯著黑板看，而不是看学生。
It is not necessary for us to attend this lecture.
我们没有必要出席这个讲座。

v.t: a. 合乎逻辑的, 合理的
v.s: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
v.sz: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。
sx: What you're saying isn't logical.
你说的话在逻辑上有问题。
This seems logical to me.
我觉得很有逻辑。

v.t: n. 风琴, 器官, 元件, 机构, 机关
v.s: Instead, they detect sounds through their tongues and feel vibrations through sense organs in the skull.
v.sz: 相反，他们通过舌头来侦测声音，并通过头骨内的感觉器官来感受震动。
sx: The tongue and the palate are the taste organs.
舌头和上颚都是味觉器官。
Do you know how to play the organ?
你能演奏管风琴吗？

v.t: n. 胡椒粉, 胡椒, 辣椒
v.s: I don't want red bell peppers, I want green ones.
v.sz: 我不要红色的柿子椒, 而是要绿色的。
sx: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
我在鱼上洒盐和胡椒作调味。
Pass me the salt and pepper, please.
请把盐和胡椒粉拿给我。

v.t: n. 猪, 猪肉, 贪婪的人, 猪一样的人 / v. 生小猪, 象猪般地生活
v.s: The wool comes off the pig, and the dog pays the bill.
v.sz: 羊毛出在猪身上，狗来买单。
sx: In her home, kitchen garbage was fed to the pigs.
在她家，泔水被喂给猪吃。
Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
猪与人类的一些特性相同。

v.t: n. 堆, 大堆, 大厦, 建筑群, 电池, 大量, 桥桩, 软毛, 痔疮 / vi. 堆起, 堆积, 积累, 挤, 猛烈攻击 / vt. 堆于, 累积, 堆叠, 打桩于, 用桩支撑
v.s: He donated a large pile of items to the museum.
v.sz: 他将一大堆东西捐赠给博物馆。
sx: There was a neat pile of books in the corner of the room.
房间的角落里整整齐齐地放著一叠书。
Keiko deftly piles up the dishes and takes them to the sink.
惠子巧妙地把碗碟迭起再拿到水槽。

v.t: n. 塞子, 栓, 插头 / vt. 插入, 塞住, 接插头 / vi. 被塞住
v.s: Did you know that if you plug a pickle into an electrical outlet, it glows and makes buzzing noises?
v.sz: 你知道如果你把泡菜插入电源插座，它会发光并且发出嗡嗡的声音吗？
sx: Did you pull the plug out?
插头是你拔的吗？
Have you pulled the plug out?
你拔插头了吗？

v.t: n. (政府提供的)钱和设备, 准备, 供应品, 规定, 条款 / vt. 供给...食物及必需品
n. 尖叫声 / vi. 尖叫, 大笑, 尖啸, 令人震惊 / vt. 尖叫着说, 大叫大嚷着要求
v.s: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
v.sz: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。
sx: This time, it was James who screamed.
这次换詹姆斯尖叫了。
The wind sounds scary, like screaming ghosts.
风声有点恐怖，听起来好像鬼叫一般。

v.t: vt. 获得, 学到
v.s: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
v.sz: 刚开始的时候你可能不会喜欢这个啤酒。这是需要多次品尝去习惯它的口味。
sx: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
你要学的是实实在在的技能，而不单是表面的知识。
One can acquire this book in one store only.
只有一家商店卖这本书。

v.t: n. 激进主义分子
v.s: Tom is an activist in his community.
v.sz: 汤姆是社群中的积极分子。
sx: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
网络积极分子想跟最高领袖见面。
Tom is an environmental activist.
汤姆是激进的环保主义者。

v.t: vi. 变弯曲, 屈服 / vt. 使弯曲, 使屈服 / n. 弯曲
v.s: Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.
v.sz: 爱因斯坦预测太阳的引力会弯曲光线。
sx: Tom was driving too fast on the bend and ended up in the ditch.
汤姆拐弯儿拐得太快了，把车开到了水沟里。
Tom took the bend too fast and landed in the ditch.
汤姆拐弯儿拐得太快了，把车开到了水沟里。

v.t: n. 壁橱, 小室 / a. 秘密的, 空谈的 / vt. 把...关入小室
v.s: For many gay men, coming out of the closet is a difficult experience.
v.sz: 对许多男同性恋者来说，出柜是一个困难的经历。
sx: Coming out of the closet requires tremendous courage.
出柜需要莫大的勇气。
The burglar shut the child in the closet.
强盗把小孩关在了衣柜里。

v.t: v. (使)联合, (使)结合 / n. (企业的)联合, 联合收割机
v.s: Their combined weight was too much and caused the truck to break down.
v.sz: 总重量过大，导致卡车抛锚。
sx: I know a lot of French words, but it's difficult for me to combine them into sentences.
我知道很多法语词汇但我很难将它们组成句子
We may combine your personal information with other information.
我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。

v.t: n. 意识, 知觉, 自觉
v.s: The demon lord finally lost consciousness and fell to the floor with a thud.
v.sz: 大魔王终于失去知觉，砰的一声倒在了地上。
sx: It was I who found her. She'd lost consciousness, so I carried her to the infirmary.
是我发现她的。她当时已经失去了意识，所以我把她送到了疗养院。
I just had an unexpected stream of consciousness.
我刚刚脑中突然迸发一股意识流。

v.t: n. 圆盘, 唱片 / vt. 灌唱片
v.s: Compact discs have entirely taken the place of phonograph records.
v.sz: CD已经完全取代了胶木唱片。
sx: She gave me this compact disc.
她给了我这个光碟。
I have many discs.
我有许多唱片。

v.t: a. 迷人的, 吸引人的, 使人神魂颠倒的
n. 仁慈, 善良
n. 家庭作业, 家里做的工作
v.s: Your homework is one important part of the learning experience.
v.sz: 家庭作业是学习中很重要的一部分。
sx: Once you’ve done your homework for an hour, you can watch TV.
你写作业一个小时就可以看电视。
I think you need to spend a little more time on your homework.
我觉得你应该多花点时间在作业上。

v.t: a. 锋利的, 敏锐的, 强烈的, 敏捷的, 热心的, 渴望的 / n. 挽歌, 痛哭 / v. 唱挽歌, 痛哭
v.s: That young man is very keen on cycling.
v.sz: 那年轻人很喜欢骑自行车。
sx: The knife has a keen blade.
这把刀的刀锋很利。

v.t: n. 唇, 口缘, 唇状构造 / vt. 以嘴唇碰, 轻轻说出 / a. 口头上的
v.s: In a horrifying chain of events, Christopher Columbus once bit his own lip.
v.sz: 在一连串可怕的事件中, 哥伦布曾经咬紧牙关撑过去。
sx: Gorillas cannot use their lips and tongues to speak, but they can communicate with people in other ways.
虽然猩猩不懂得开口说话，但牠们能用其他方式和人类沟通。
Lips that touch liquor shall not touch mine.
碰过酒的嘴唇就别想碰我的唇。

v.t: n. 小湖, 池塘 / a. 仅仅的, 只不过的
v.s: I'm not a real fish, I'm just a mere plushy.
v.sz: 我不是一条真的鱼，我只是一个长毛绒玩具。
sx: You are no longer a mere child.
你不再只是一个孩子了。
Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
我们当前的危机绝非单纯的经济危机。

v.t: n. 泥, 诽谤 / vt. 弄脏
v.s: People who play with mud will get their hands dirty.
v.sz: 玩泥的人会弄脏自己的双手。
sx: The car got stuck in the mud.
这辆车陷在泥里了。
He scraped the mud off his boots.
他刮下靴子上的泥巴。

v.t: n. 观察, 注意, 观测, 观察力
v.s: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
v.sz: 她因为敏锐的观察力，很适合当一名摄影师。

v.t: vt. 亏欠, 负...债, 归功于, 怀有, 应给予, 感恩 / vi. 欠钱
v.s: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
v.sz: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。
sx: I regret that I will be unable to meet you on February 27 owing to an unexpected matter.
因为临时有事，我很抱歉在2月27日那天不能跟您碰面了。
He owes his success both to working hard and to good luck.
他的成功要归结于他的辛勤工作和好运气。

v.t: a. 精确的, 严谨的, 明确的
v.s: Our teacher is someone who likes precision, and always demands precise answers of her students.
v.sz: 老师性喜精准——她总是要求精确的答案。
sx: The more precise the calculations, the stronger the friendship.
算帐愈是精确, 友谊愈是坚定。
The precise time of their arrival is not known.
他们到达的确切时间还不明。

v.t: n. 职业, 表白, 声明
v.s: Teaching is a profession of my own choosing.
v.sz: 教书是我自己选择的职业。
sx: He is a doctor by profession.
他的职业是医生。
Teaching English is his profession.
教英语是他的职业。

v.t: n. 景色, 展望 / vt. 勘探, 勘察 / vi. 勘探, 有前途
n. 出版者, 发行人
v.s: This publisher specializes in children's literature.
v.sz: 这家出版社专门出版儿童文学。

v.t: n. 三明治, 夹心面包, 夹层板 / vt. 插入, 夹入, 把...制成三明治
v.s: Tom said that he saw Mary eating a sandwich in the park.
v.sz: 汤姆说他看到玛丽在公园吃三文治。
sx: I like to eat honey and peanut butter sandwiches.
我喜欢吃蜂蜜花生酱三明治。
In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
我的三明治里有肉，奶酪和番茄。

v.t: n. 洗涤, 浸, 洗涤物
v.s: After washing, the cat's fur is soft and fluffy, and has a faint scent.
v.sz: 洗过澡后，猫咪的毛柔软又蓬松，还有淡淡的香味。
sx: Did you take the clothes out of the washing machine?
你把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？
I can hear Tom in the kitchen washing dishes.
我听到汤姆在厨房洗碗的声音。

v.t: a. 残酷的, 令人极痛苦的
v.s: I never thought he was capable of doing something so cruel.
v.sz: 我从来没想到他能做到那么残忍的事。
sx: When it comes to animals, this can't be considered as being something cruel.
对动物来说这不是什么残酷的事情。
How can you be so cruel?
你怎么能如此狠毒？

v.t: vi. 分开, 分配, 分裂 / vt. 分, 分开, 分裂, 除 / n. 分配, 分水岭
v.s: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
v.sz: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。
sx: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.
海洋不是将世界分隔开来，而是将世界连接起来
This is because you approach everything as a total person, with no loose ends hanging out to signify divided intentions.
这是因为你总是全身心处理每一件事情，没有让鸡毛蒜皮的问题分散了你的目标。

v.t: a. 偶然的, 临时的
v.s: Tomorrow's weather should be sunny with occasional rain.
v.sz: 明天天气晴转阵雨。
sx: Even superheroes need an occasional break.
连超级英雄们也该偶尔休息一下。
Even now there are occasional aftershocks.
即使现在，偶尔还是会有余震。

v.t: a. 不幸的, 不合适的, 不吉利的
v.s: Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.
v.sz: 由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭在增长中。
sx: It's really unfortunate. You don't understand at all its essence.
太可惜了，你一点也不懂它的精髓。
Yesterday there was an unfortunate accident.
昨天发生了一个不幸的事故。

v.t: a. 使人烦恼的, 忧虑重重的
v.s: Worrying doesn't take away tomorrow's concerns, but it does take away today's power.
v.sz: 烦恼带不走明天的忧虑, 但却拿走了今天的力量。
sx: Her parents can't help worrying about her injuries.
她的父母不能不担心她的伤势。
Why are you worrying about something that doesn't matter so much?
你为甚么要为这种无关重要的事情忧心呢？

v.t: n. 吸引, 吸引人的事物, 吸引力
v.s: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
v.sz: 爱丁堡已经供应一个繁忙而传统的城市，有许多历史性的建筑物和名胜。
sx: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。
The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
这个景点只能网上购票。

v.t: n. 皈依者, 改变宗教信仰者 / vt. 使改变信仰, 转换, 兑换, 倒置 / vi. 皈依
v.s: With this add-on, your computer has been converted into a gaming PC.
v.sz: 有了这个附加元件，您的电脑就变成了游戏电脑。
sx: I was born into the Hebrew persuasion, but when I got older I converted to narcissism.
我天生是犹太人，但当我年纪大了的时候，我把它转换成了自恋。
He is a recent convert to Catholicism.
他新近皈依的天主教徒。

v.t: vi. 冻结, 冷冻, 僵硬, 楞住 / vt. 使结冰, 使冻住, 使呆住 / n. 结冰, 凝固
v.s: Inside, it's very hot, but outside its freezing.
v.sz: 里面很热，但外面很冷。
sx: How come this fucking apartment has no double-glazing? I'm freezing.
为什么这个他妈的房子没有双层玻璃，我快要冷死了。
If you want to keep meat for long, freeze it.
如果你想把肉类保存久一点，就要把它们放进冰箱里冷藏。

v.t: n. 奶奶, 外婆
v.s: Chia-ling said her grandma knows how to use LINE now. She sends stickers every day.
v.sz: 佳玲说她阿嬷会用 LINE 了，还每天传贴图。
sx: Sometimes, Grandma is more dangerous than the KGB.
有时候外婆比克格勃还危险。
My grandma just drank a bit of soup.
我姥姥只喝了点儿汤。

v.t: n. 键盘
v.s: I'm just a raccoon with a PC and a MIDI keyboard.
v.sz: 我只是一只拥有电脑和 MIDI 键盘的浣熊。
sx: He creates melodies on his keyboard.
他用键盘作曲。
The fingers move fast on the keyboard.
手指在键盘上快速的移动。

v.t: n. 现在, 现时, 当今 / adv. 时下, 现今
v.s: Nowadays, equal pay is not enough. Household responsibilities must also be distributed evenly.
v.sz: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。
sx: The term 'greenhouse effect' is often used when people talk about global changes of climate nowadays.
人们谈到全球气候变化的时候，常常用到“温室效应”这个词。
Without an air conditioner, people nowadays cannot live.
现今人们没有空调无法生活。

v.t: n. 马铃薯
v.s: The potato was so hot that it burned my mouth.
v.sz: 土豆太热，以至于烫到了我的嘴。
sx: Did you really order sweet potato fries to go with your veggie burger?
您真的点了地瓜片来搭配素食汉堡吗？
On the plate was a piece of chicken, a potato and some green peas.
盘子上盛着一块鸡肉、一块马铃薯和一些青豆。

v.t: n. 偏爱, 优先, 喜爱物
n. 比例, 比率, 均衡, 部分, 面积 / vt. 使成比例, 使均衡
v.s: Men's wants become greater in proportion to the increase in their income.
v.sz: 人收入愈高，欲望就愈大。

v.t: n. 印, 邮票, 打印器, 戳子, 图章, 印花税票, 标志, 特征, 类型, 跺脚 / vt. 盖章于, 顿足, 贴上邮票, 铭刻, 捣碎, 扑灭 / vi. 捣碎, 跺脚
v.s: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
v.sz: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。
sx: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
我想看看您的邮票收藏。

v.t: n. 冲动, 推动力, 迫切的要求 / vt. 驱策, 力劝, 竭力主张, 推动 / vi. 强烈要求
v.s: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
v.sz: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。
sx: I urge you to tell him the truth.
我劝你告诉他实话。
Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。

v.t: n. 区别
v.s: He makes no distinction between right and wrong.
v.sz: 他是非不分。

v.t: n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性 / vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要 / vi. 有关系
v.s: The suits in this row are all made of imported European fabric.
v.sz: 这里一排都是进口面料欧版的西装。
sx: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.
进口车占了不到百分之八。
The imports from Asian countries have expanded recently.
最近，来自亚洲各国的进口额不断扩大。

v.t: n. 姿势, 姿态, 装模作样, 伪装 / vi. 摆姿势, 装模作样, 假装 / vt. 使摆好姿势, 提出, 造成
v.s: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
v.sz: 当你提出一个问题，你期望得到答案。
sx: In family photos, Ciham appears carefree. She poses casually for the camera, her hair pulled into a braided ponytail.
在家庭照片中，西哈姆看起来无忧无虑。她对著镜头摆出一副随兴的姿势，头发绑成马尾。
Strike a pose.
摆一个 Pose。

v.t: n. 流出, 倾泻, 骤雨 / vt. 倒, 灌, 注, 倾泻, 诉说, 倾吐 / vi. 倾泻, 蜂涌而来, 下大雨
v.s: Tom went into the kitchen and poured himself a cup of coffee.
v.sz: 汤姆进了厨房，给自己倒了杯咖啡。
sx: Tom poured cold water over himself to wake himself up.
汤姆给自己浇凉水以清醒过来。
He poured her a drink and handed it to her.
他给她倒了一杯饮料，然后递给她。

v.t: vt. 出版, 发行, 公开, 发表, 宣传, 公布 / vi. 出版, 发行
v.s: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.
v.sz: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。
sx: His book was published just one month ago, and it has already sold thousands of copies.
他的书仅仅一月前出版了，且已经卖了一千册。
Too late! The wall magazine is ready to be published!
晚了！墙上杂志就要发布了！

v.t: adv. 纯粹地, 清白地, 贞洁地
v.s: To claim sex is binary requires ignoring intersex people, which is unscientific and purely ideological.
v.sz: 若要声称性别是二元的，就需要忽视阴阳人，这是不科学的，且纯粹属于意识形态问题。

v.t: a. 令人震惊的, 极坏的, 不正当的
vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议 / vi. 提意见, 商量
v.s: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
v.sz: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。
sx: Tom was advised by Mary not to go there by himself.
玛丽建议汤姆不要独自去。
This plan has discretion advised.
此计划建议谨慎行事。

v.t: a. 忧虑的, 发愁的, 渴望的
v.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
v.sz: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
sx: He was very anxious on the eve of the exam.
考试前夕，他特别焦虑。
I am anxious to visit Britain once again.
我好想快点再去英国。

v.t: n. 亲爱的, 可爱的人, 可爱的物 / a. 可爱的, 亲爱的
v.s: I'm sorry darling, you are merely a single tree in a forest, I just can't drop everything for you.
v.sz: 不好意思美女，我不会为了你这一颗树，放弃一片森林。
sx: What are you doing, darling?
你在做什么呢，亲爱的？
Let's dance, my darling.
亲爱的，我们跳舞吧。

v.t: n. 日记
v.s: I have made a resolution to keep a diary this year.
v.sz: 这一年我下了决心写日记。
sx: By the way, how many of you keep diaries?
对了，你们当中写日记的有几位？
Writing in a diary is a good habit.
写日记是一个好习惯。

v.t: vi. 不一致, 不适宜
v.s: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
v.sz: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。
sx: To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
要你在多大程度上同意或不同意这种说法？
I have no difficulty finding people who disagree with you.
我找跟您意见相左的人毫无困难。

v.t: vi. 消失, 不见
v.s: It was not until three days after that I knew she had disappeared.
v.sz: 过了三天我才知道原来她失踪了。
sx: The fugitive surfaced in a small town fifty miles from here but then disappeared again.
那个逃犯在离这里五十英里的小镇上现身过后又消失了。
The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.
我们必须阐明这个观点，在运动项目上，业余选手和专业选手的界限开始消失了。

v.t: vt. 计划, 打算, 意思是
v.s: Tom and Mary say they intend to play golf with us this afternoon.
v.sz: 汤姆和玛丽说他们今天下午打算和我们一起来打高尔夫。
sx: This book is intended for students who do not speak Japanese as a native language.
这本书是打算给不以日语为母语的学生所使用的。
I've woken up and I intend to prepare my breakfast.
我醒来，打算准备早饭。

v.t: n. 推荐, 介绍, 推荐信, 劝告
v.s: Tom got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
v.sz: 多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。
sx: Thanks to your recommendation, Tom got that job.
多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。
My decision was based on a dealer recommendation.
我是听从经销商的建议做的决定。

v.t: n. 仆人, 有用物, 公务员, 雇员
v.s: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
v.sz: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。
sx: The mind should be a good servant, but the heart should be the master.
心灵应该当一个好仆人，但心应该是主人。
Tom made his servants eat in the dark.
汤姆让他的仆人们在黑暗下进餐。

v.t: adv. 使人惊奇, 出人意外, 惊人, 令人惊讶
a. 可疑的, 多疑的, 怀疑的
v.s: I am suspicious that this is an illegal taxi.
v.sz: 我怀疑这是辆黑车。
sx: Tom didn't seem to be as suspicious as Mary seemed to be.
汤姆没有玛丽那么可疑。
This statement is actually kind of suspicious.
这种说法其实有点可疑。

v.t: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据 / vi. 赞许
v.s: I cannot approve of your going out with him.
v.sz: 我不能让你和他出去。
sx: Father will never approve of my marriage.
父亲绝不会赞成我结婚。
I can't approve the proposal by myself.
我觉得我无法赞成这个建议。

v.t: n. 建筑师, 设计者, 缔造者
v.s: That building's facade is bizarre. No idea what the architect was thinking.
v.sz: 这座大楼的外观很奇怪，不知道设计师是怎么想的。
sx: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
尽管有逆境，建筑师还是获得了享誉全球的荣誉。
A famous architect built this house.
一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。

v.t: n. 卡通画, 漫画 / v. 画漫画
v.s: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.
v.sz: 有人说电视上的卡通本身是有教育意义的。
sx: Do you know this cartoon?
你知道这部漫画吗？

v.t: n. 垃圾场 / vt. 倾倒, 倾销 / vi. 倒垃圾, 倾销商品
v.s: We all wondered why she had dumped such a nice man.
v.sz: 我们都想知道她为什么甩了这么好的一个男人。
sx: Thanks God, Apple is dumping that Flash crap!
谢天谢地，苹果抛弃了 Flash 这个垃圾！
Is Tom going to dump Mary?
汤姆要甩了玛丽吗？

v.t: n. 折层, 折, 羊栏, 折痕, 信徒 / vt. 折叠, 包, 合拢, 交迭 / vi. 折叠起来, 彻底失败
v.s: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
v.sz: 若没有将衣服折起来或是挂在衣架上，会起皱纹。
sx: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
在传给玛丽之前，汤姆把纸条折了起来。
She folded her baby in her arms.
她把她的宝宝抱在怀里。

v.t: adv. 温和地, 温柔地, 轻轻地, 逐渐地
v.s: The leaves on the trees rustle gently in the wind.
v.sz: 树叶在风中簌簌作响。
sx: Gently layer gold eyeshadow on the eyelids.
在眼皮上轻轻叠加金色眼影。
Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.
山谷中，薄雾如白色羽毛般缓缓升腾，化作一团白云，遮蔽了一切。

v.t: a. 不可避免的, 必然的
v.s: It is inevitable that I go to France someday, I just don't know when.
v.sz: 有一天我去法国是无可避免的，我只是不知道何时。
sx: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
外交部长称战争在所难免。
Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
生命中你无法选择接踵而至的挑战，但是你可以选择不成为一个失败者。

v.t: n. 栅栏, 界线, 范围 / a. 苍白的, 暗淡的, 无力的 / vi. 变苍白, 变暗, 失色 / vt. 使变苍白, 使失色, 用栅栏围
v.s: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.
v.sz: 你的脸色这么差，还是赶快去睡觉吧。
sx: He told me that I looked pale and asked me what the matter was.
他跟我说我很苍白，并问我怎么了。
A gleam of real pride quickened most ingenuously in the Older Man's pale blue eyes.
老人淡蓝色的眼睛闪过一丝真诚的骄傲。

v.t: v. 预知, 预言, 预报
v.s: It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
v.sz: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
sx: Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.
爱因斯坦预测太阳的引力会弯曲光线。
Tom was late, just like Mary predicted.
正如玛莉所预料的一样，汤姆迟到了。

v.t: n. 牙齿, 齿状物, 爱好 / vt. 装以齿, 将...切成齿状 / vi. 啮合
v.s: It was during the ice age that the saber-toothed tiger became extinct.
v.sz: 剑齿虎是在冰河时期绝种的。
sx: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
以眼还眼，以牙还牙。
If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
如果你的牙齿疼，你就应该去看牙医。

v.t: n. 训练员, 驯马师
v.s: Tom works as an elephant trainer in a circus.
v.sz: 汤姆在一个马戏团当训象师。
sx: Suddenly the lion came at his trainer.
狮子突然向训练员扑了过去。
Tom is a dolphin trainer.
汤姆是海豚训练员。

v.t: a. 难以置信的
adv. 在下面 / prep. 在...的下面
v.s: Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.
v.sz: 下面写上我们班同学的名字。
sx: I found the key underneath the mat.
我在擦鞋垫下面发现了这把钥匙。

v.t: n. 变更, 变化, 变种, 变奏
vt. 调整, 使适应于, 校准 / vi. 适应于, 被调节, 相互熟悉而适应
v.s: The system will be adjusted to what it is that you are allowed to see.
v.sz: 系统会调整成允许你看到的内容。
sx: I need a week to adjust to the time difference.
我需要一个星期来倒时差。
I am slowly adjusting to the harsh climate here.
我在慢慢习惯这苛刻的气候。

v.t: adv. 完全地, 总而言之
v.s: The Latin language is not entirely unknown to me, but I altogether lack the ability to speak it.
v.sz: 拉丁语对我来说不是完全陌生的，但我不懂说这门语言。
sx: He doesn't altogether trust me.
他并不完全信任我。
That is not altogether false.
那不全是错的。

v.t: vt. 估定, 对...征税, 评定
v.s: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
v.sz: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。
sx: She can assess investments very accurately.
她能很准确地评估投资。

v.t: n. 假定, 自负, 担任, 假装
v.s: What is the basis of your assumptions?
v.sz: 您的假设是根据什么?
sx: That's a pretty big assumption.
假设得很大。
That's an assumption.
这是个假设。

v.t: n. 篮, 篮子 / vt. 装入篮
v.s: Tom put the large picnic basket on the passenger seat next to him.
v.sz: 汤姆把那个大野餐篮子放在他旁边的乘客座位上。
sx: She weaves her baskets in the same style as her ancestors who lived in the desert and harvested fruit and vegetables.
她编织的篮子的样式，与她生活在沙漠中收获水果和蔬​​菜的祖先相同。
How many times do I have to ask you to put your laundry in the basket?
就您把您的脏衣服放到篮子里我还需要说几次呀？

v.t: n. 胡须 / vt. 抓住胡须, 公开反对
v.s: He grew a beard to look more mature.
v.sz: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。
sx: Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
妈妈，为什么我没有长胡子的舅舅呢？
This is the first time I've ever grown a beard.
这是我第一次长胡子。

v.t: n. 桶
v.s: No matter how much you hurry your effort is just a drop in the bucket.
v.sz: 就算你多焦急，也不能帮上甚么忙。
sx: Well, I can cross that off my bucket list.
太好了，死前心愿又完成了一样。
This bucket has a hole in it.
这个桶有个洞。

v.t: n. 浓缩, 精选 / v. 集中, 专心
v.s: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
v.sz: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。
sx: The average man fails not because he lacks ability, but because he lacks ability to concentrate.
通常人们失败并非能力不足，而是不够专注。
As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。

v.t: n. 结果, 重要性
v.s: If you do silly things, you must accept the consequences without complaining.
v.sz: 如果你做了愚蠢的事，你就必须无怨尤接受痛苦惩罚。
sx: He wanted to do it, whatever the consequences.
不管结果如何，他想要做。
In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
由于两个竞争对手的一项新协议，我们需要重新调整战略。

v.t: n. 饼干, 小甜点
v.s: Cookies may contain nuts or peanuts, even if not included in the ingredient list.
v.sz: 虽然配料表中未列出坚果和花生，但饼干中仍可能含有这些成分。。
sx: Tom admitted that he was the one who ate all the cookies.
汤姆承认是他把所有的饼干都吃光了。
Tom thought Cookie would be a good name for his dog.
汤姆认为“小饼干”这个名字很适合他的狗。

v.t: adv. 漂亮地, 谨慎地, 恰好地
v.s: Hopefully things will pan out nicely.
v.sz: 希望事情能顺利解决。

v.t: n. 义务, 责任, 约束, 契约, 恩惠, 债务
v.s: Every player is under obligation to keep the rules.
v.sz: 每一位选手都有义务遵守规则。
sx: It is our obligation to help.
帮助是我们的义务。

v.t: n. 便士, 一分, 小钱, 点滴
v.s: His ideas never earned him a single penny.
v.sz: 他的看法真是一文不值。
sx: Don't be a penny-pincher.
别当守财奴！
Penny wise, pound foolish.
小事聪明，大事糊涂。

v.t: n. 量, 数量, 总量
v.s: A large quantity of air-conditioners has been sold since the temperature is high.
v.sz: 因为气温很高，有大量空调售出。
sx: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。
We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。

v.t: n. 支持者, 后盾, 迫随者, 护身织物
v.s: Rev. King and his supporters were threatened.
v.sz: 金牧师和他的支持者们受到威胁。
sx: We are looking for supporters.
我们寻找支持者。
We search supporters.
我们寻找支持者。

v.t: n. 足趾, 趾部, 脚趾 / vt. 以趾踏触, 用脚尖走 / vi. 动脚尖
v.s: She stood on tip-toe and whispered something in his ear, and then went away.
v.sz: 她踮起脚向他耳语，然后走了
sx: He was soaking wet from head to toe.
他从头到脚都湿透了。
I can easily touch my toes.
我可以轻而易举地碰到我的脚趾。

v.t: a. 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的
v.s: Coming out of the closet requires tremendous courage.
v.sz: 出柜需要莫大的勇气。
sx: The pressure was tremendous.
压力很巨大。

v.t: n. 膳宿, 预订铺位, 适应性调节, 调和, 贷款
v.s: Do you offer accommodation?
v.sz: 您提供住宿吗？
sx: This hotel has accommodations for 1,000 guests.
这家酒店可以容纳一千人。

v.t: n. 救护车
v.s: Tom bought an old ambulance and converted it into a camper.
v.sz: 汤姆买了一辆旧救护车，并把它改装成露营车。
sx: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。
Please get here with the ambulance quickly. Hurry up!
请你们快点来一辆救护车，快！

v.t: a. 惭愧的, 羞耻的
v.s: He is very much ashamed of having behaved so badly.
v.sz: 他为自己的行为感到非常羞耻。
sx: You should be ashamed of your ignorance.
你应该为你的无知感到羞耻。
This is the first time I've ever lied to my father and I am ashamed of myself.
我很惭愧，这是我第一次对我爸说谎。

v.t: vt. 保证, 使确信, 弄清楚, 担保
v.s: I can assure success.
v.sz: 我可以确保成功。

v.t: n. 欺骗, 作弊, 骗子 / v. 欺骗, 逃脱, 骗取
v.s: The man cheated the old woman out of her money.
v.sz: 他骗了老婆婆的钱。
sx: I ask you, he's been cheating me!
什么意思，他竟然一直在欺骗我！
He was caught cheating in the exam.
他在考试中作弊时被抓到了。

v.t: n. 香烟, 纸烟
v.s: Rather than cutting down on cigarettes, why don't you just give them up?
v.sz: 比起少抽烟，你何不直接把烟戒了？
sx: Someone told me that every cigarette you smoke takes seven minutes away from your life.
有人告诉过我，我们每抽一根烟，寿命就会缩短七分钟。
Don't throw cigarette butts on the ground. Cockroaches might get cancer.
别把烟头往地上扔，要不然蟑螂会得癌症的。

v.t: n. 示范, 实证
v.s: Several dozen young people participated in the demonstration.
v.sz: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。
sx: I'm going to join a demonstration.
我要参加一个示威游行。

v.t: n. 食品杂货店, 食品杂货业
v.s: Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
v.sz: 每周六鲍勃在杂货店做店员。
sx: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
请告诉我们哪儿有食品杂货店。
Please buy some blood oranges at the grocery store.
请在杂货店买一些血橙。

v.t: a. 中途的, 不彻底的, 部分的 / adv. 半路地, 在中途, 在半途
v.s: I am halfway through this detective story.
v.sz: 这本侦探小说我才看到一半。
sx: We still have more than halfway to go to get to the top of the mountain. Are you really already exhausted?
我们要走到山上，还没走到一半的路，你真的已经那么累了吗？
I'm halfway through my sandwich.
我吃了一半三明治了。

v.t: n. 指示, 象征, 暗示
v.s: His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.
v.sz: 他现在这个年纪，就已经在国际比赛中取胜，前途实在无可限量。

v.t: vt. 觉察到, 遵守, 注意到, 庆祝 / vi. 注意, 评论
v.s: He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.
v.sz: 他指出了遵守法律的重要性。
sx: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
医生继续观察病人的一举一动。
But the butcher is observing the holiday today, there's nothing we can do about it.
可是肉店今天公休没办法。

v.t: adv. 推测上, 大概
n. 执行, 经营, 起诉
n. 绳, 索, 粗绳, 绞索, 决窍 / vt. 捆, 缚, 绑, 圈起, 以绳将...系住 / vi. 拧成绳状
v.s: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
v.sz: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。
sx: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。
Once bitten by a snake, one is afraid of a well rope for ten years.
一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳。

v.t: n. 呼喊, 喊声 / vi. 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷 / vt. 高喊
v.s: The manager and coach stood on the touchline shouting out instructions to their team.
v.sz: 足球教练站在边线上对自己的队伍喊出指令。
sx: The manager shouted out to his players to mark the opposition.
教练对自己的球员大喊，让他盯守对方球员。
When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
他大喊的时候，脖子上青筋暴起。

v.t: a. 不快乐的, 不幸的, 不适当的
v.s: Hot weather doesn’t just mean that people feel a little unhappy.
v.sz: 热天气不仅仅意味着人们觉得有点不高兴。
sx: All happy families resemble each other, each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
幸福家庭的幸福原因全都大同小异，但悲惨的家庭却往往各自有各自的惨法。
What are you unhappy about? Let it out and let everyone cheer you up a bit.
你有什么不开心的事? 说出来让大家开心一下。

v.t: a. 适当的, 足够的
v.s: We need not only adequate water but clean water.
v.sz: 我们不仅需要充足的水，还需要干净的水。
sx: This meal is adequate for three.
这饭足够三个人吃。

v.t: v. 改变
v.s: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.
v.sz: 他提出改革研究方法的意见。
sx: Meanwhile, conditions have drastically altered.
在这期间，情况发生了巨大变化。
The image was digitally altered.
这张图片经过数位修改。

v.t: n. 道歉, 辩护
v.s: Can it be that you don't have a bit of creativity, to the point of always inventing the same apology?
v.sz: 你是没创意到连每次道歉的说词都一成不变吗？
sx: My apologies, I can't go at that time.
很抱歉，我那时候不能来。
You owe me an apology for that.
关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。

v.t: v. 宣布, 声明, 申报, 断言
v.s: Tom is suspicious of Mary even though he declares otherwise.
v.sz: 汤姆虽然说了一套，但依然怀疑玛丽。
sx: Do you have anything to declare?
你有任何要申报的东西吗？
She declared that she was not guilty.
她声称自己没罪。

v.t: vt. 发现, 察觉, 探测
v.s: Instead, they detect sounds through their tongues and feel vibrations through sense organs in the skull.
v.sz: 相反，他们通过舌头来侦测声音，并通过头骨内的感觉器官来感受震动。
sx: He was detected in the very act of stealing.
他在行窃的时后被发现。

v.t: n. 点, 圆点, 小数点, 小东西, 嫁妆 / vt. 作小点记号, 加小点于 / vi. 打上点
v.s: The general meeting began at 9 am on the dot.
v.sz: 总会在九点整开始了。
sx: All those dots are viral focuses.
这些点都是病毒集中的地方。
She bought two pairs of polka dot stockings.
她买了两双波点丝袜。

v.t: a. 尴尬的；窘迫的
v.s: I'm extremely embarrassed that it has taken so long to reply.
v.sz: 我过了这么久才回信，真的十分不好意思。
sx: He was too embarrassed to utter a word in front of the crowd.
他太难为情，在大众人前一句话也说不出来。
The incident made everyone feel more embarrassed.
这件事弄得大家都比较尴尬。

v.t: adv. 坦白地
v.s: Frankly speaking, I actually wanted to stay at home, instead of going out.
v.sz: 老实说，我其实想留在家中，不想出外的。
sx: Frankly speaking, I don't agree with you.
实话说，我不赞成你。
Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.
坦白地说，我不喜欢你的发型。

v.t: n. 曲线图, 图表, 图形
n. 灯 / vt. 照亮
v.s: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
v.sz: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。
sx: I think this lamp has a short because the light comes on only if I jiggle the cord.
我觉得这盏灯短路了，因为只有我摇线的时候灯才会亮。
I'm going to sit on the bench over there next to the street lamp.
我会在那盏街灯旁边的长凳上坐下来。

v.t: n. 尺寸, 度量, 度量单位
a. 中古的, 中世纪的
v.s: I'm playing a medieval-themed PC game.
v.sz: 我正在玩一款中世纪主题的电脑游戏。

v.t: n. 烤箱, 灶, 子宫
v.s: I watched as my grandmother pulled a golden butter pie from the oven.
v.sz: 我看著奶奶从烤箱里拿出一个金黄色的奶油派。
sx: Clean up spills inside the oven as soon as they happen to avoid stubborn stains.
烤箱内如有液体洒出，应立即清理，以免留下顽固污渍。
Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
玛丽把围裙系在她的腰上，然后把火鸡从烤箱里拿出来了。

v.t: n. 隐居 / vi. 引退, 退役, 退休, 退去, 撤退, 退却 / vt. 使...撤退, 辞退
v.s: He's already retired but is often asked by them to consult.
v.sz: 已经退休了，但还常常被他们请去做顾问。
sx: He doesn't have a job. He's retired.
他没有工作，他退休了。
He wasn't earning a large salary when he retired.
他退休时的薪金并不高。

v.t: n. 旋律, 节奏, 韵律, 匀称, 张弛节律
v.s: It's a slow Oriental rhythm.
v.sz: 这是舒缓的东方节奏。

v.t: a. 瘦的, 苗条的, 微小的, 稀少的, 微薄的 / vi. 变苗条 / vt. 使苗条
v.s: His body type is born balanced! Wide shoulders, slim waist, belly not popping outwards.
v.sz: 他的体形生得很匀称！肩膀宽，腰身窄，肚子又没凸出来。
sx: When my grandmother was young, her body was very slim. Now in her old age she's grown plump.
我奶奶年轻的时候身材很苗条，现在年纪大了就发福了。
She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
她有著一头金发，瘦高的身材。

v.t: n. 平板, 门牌, 笔记簿, 碑, 匾, 药片
v.s: If I don't drink a swig of water, I can't swallow these tablets.
v.sz: 不喝水我咽不下这些药片。
sx: Take after meals, twice per day, two tablets each time.
饭后服用，一日两次，一次两粒。
The tablets took away my pain.
药片止住了我的疼痛。

v.t: n. 帐篷, 帷幕, 住处, 塞条, 塞子 / vi. 住帐蓬, 宿营, 暂时居住 / vt. 用帐篷遮盖, 使住帐篷, 用塞条嵌入
v.s: They were looking for a place at which they could pitch the tent.
v.sz: 他们在找一个可以搭帐篷的地方。
sx: It took us half an hour to set up the tent.
搭帐篷花了我们半小时。
A tent with a floor and a zipper is bug tight.
有垫布与拉链的帐篷可以做到防虫密闭。

v.t: vt. 撤回, 取回, 撤消, 使撤退, 拉开, 移开 / vi. 撤退, 离开
v.s: You may as well withdraw from the club right away.
v.sz: 你还不如立刻退出这个俱乐部。
sx: I'm going to the bank to withdraw money.
我去银行取钱。
The Soviet troops started to withdraw from Afghanistan.
苏联军队开始从阿富汗撤军了。

v.t: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司
v.s: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
v.sz: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？
sx: How is this airline?
这个航空公司的飞机怎么样？

v.t: adv. 向后
v.s: Life can only be understood backwards, but it must be lived forwards.
v.sz: 只有向后看才能理解生活，但要生活得好，则必须向前看。
sx: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
他们往前走而我一直都在往后退。
You've put your hat on backwards.
你把帽子戴反了。

v.t: a. (头发)亚麻色的, 淡色的, 白肤金发碧眼的, 白里透红的, 白皙的, 淡黄色的 / n. 肤色白皙的金发女人
v.s: She is a beautiful girl with blonde hair and blue eyes.
v.sz: 她是个美丽的女孩，有著金色头发和蓝色眼睛。
sx: I want to find a blonde, blue-eyed European woman.
他想找一位金发碧眼的欧洲女人。
Mary prefers to dye her hair blonde.
玛丽更想把头发染成金色。

v.t: n. 衣领, 颈圈 / vt. 控制, 扭住衣领, 给...装上领子
v.s: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
v.sz: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

v.t: vi. 竞争, 应付 / n. 长袍
v.s: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
v.sz: 汤姆失业后，为了排遣郁闷的心情而开始了赌博。
sx: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。
The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.
问题是我们如何应付目前的困难。

v.t: vt. 提高, 加强, 增加
n. 坚果, 核心, 螺帽
v.s: Cookies may contain nuts or peanuts, even if not included in the ingredient list.
v.sz: 虽然配料表中未列出坚果和花生，但饼干中仍可能含有这些成分。。
sx: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.
最后一个听我说我的主意的人认为我疯了。
He takes the nuts from the fire with the dog's foot.
他用狗爪子从火里取走坚果。

v.t: n. 恶意, 怨恨, 使人烦恼的事物 / vt. 故意刁难, 欺侮
v.s: He never says thanks in spite of all that I've done for him.
v.sz: 我帮了他那么多的忙，他却连一句感谢的话也没有。
sx: In spite of the heavy rain, he decided to go out.
虽然下着大雨，但是他还是决定了要出外。
I cannot help loving her in spite of her many faults.
虽然她有许多缺点，但我却情不自禁地爱著她。

v.t: vt. 加强, 变坚固 / vi. 变强, 股票上涨
v.s: There's a fear that the snow will strengthen amid the strong winter pressure pattern.
v.sz: 人们担心在强劲的冬季气压模式下，降雪量会增加。
sx: Cultural exchange programs can strengthen friendly relations between neighboring countries.
文化交流计划可以加强邻国之间的友好关系。
It will also help to strengthen the city's economy.
它也会促进城市的经济发展。

v.t: vt. 使转换, 改变, 改造, 使...变形 / vi. 改变, 转化, 变换
v.s: Comrades! Let's transform Moscow into a model communist city.
v.sz: 同志们，让我们转换莫斯科为理想的共产主义城市。
sx: The creation of most schools was not to transform society, but to reconstruct society.
大部分学校的创建不是用来转变社会，而是用来重建社会的。
People eagerly sought a more modernised style of dress and transformed the old qipao to suit their tastes.
人们热切地寻求更有现代风格的衣服，所以把以前的旗袍改成了适合他们品位的东西。

v.t: n. 分析者, 精神分析学家
v.s: Some analysts consider Somalia as the failed state par excellence.
v.sz: 一些分析家认为索马里是非常失败的国家。
sx: Tom is a financial analyst.
汤姆是一名金融分析师。

v.t: n. 买主, 买方
v.s: I will sell it as soon as I find a buyer.
v.sz: 我一找到买家就会把它卖掉。

v.t: n. 停止 / v. 停止, 终了
v.s: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
v.sz: 不是因为某人不理事实它们就会不复存在了。
sx: It has ceased raining.
雨停了。
His memory never ceases to astonish me.
他的记忆力总让我吃惊。

v.t: n. 布料, 织品, 布
v.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
v.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
sx: Hanfu is the traditional clothing used by the ethnic Han of China, before the Qing dynasty.
汉服是中国汉族于清以前的传统服饰。
Old stuff that doesn't fit any more can be used as cloths.
不合适的旧衣物可以当抹布用。

v.t: vi. 不一致, 不同
v.s: Human beings differ from animals in that they can think and speak.
v.sz: 人类有思考和说话的能力，动物却没有。这就是人和动物的分别。
sx: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
It is on this point that our opinions differ.
是在这点上我们的意见有分歧。

v.t: n. 当选人, 被选的人 / a. 被选的, 选出的 / vt. 选举, 选择 / vi. 作选择
v.s: Zelensky is a democratically elected president of a sovereign country.
v.sz: 泽伦斯基是一位主权国家的民选总统。
sx: Clint Eastwood was elected mayor of Carmel.
克林伊斯威特当选为卡梅尔市市长。
We elected her captain of our team.
我们选她为我们队的队长。

v.t: n. 叉子, 叉状物, 分岔 / vi. 分支, 分歧 / vt. 做成叉形, 叉起
v.s: The Three Forks is a bar serving beer, and its target audience are travellers.
v.sz: 三把叉子是一家供应啤酒的酒吧，其目标客户是旅行者。
sx: This boy is very good at using the knife and fork.
这个男孩刀叉用得很好。
When we reached the fork, we hesitated between continuing towards the town or continuing towards the mountains.
我们到达岔路口时，犹豫是继续往城镇走去，还是继续往山上走去。

v.t: v. 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调
v.s: Mother insists that we should be home by seven in the evening.
v.sz: 母亲一定要我们在晚上七时前回到家中。
sx: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.
医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。
Jimmy insisted on my taking him to the zoo.
吉米坚持要我带他去动物园。

v.t: n. 梯, 梯状物, 发迹的途径 / vi. 袜子抽丝, 成名
v.s: He placed the ladder against the fence.
v.sz: 他把梯子倚著栅栏放。
sx: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.
他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。

v.t: n. 矿物, 无机物, 苏打水 / a. 矿物的, 似矿物的
v.s: This food contains all the minerals without which our bodies would not function.
v.sz: 这食物中含有所有的矿物质, 若没有这些矿物质我们的身体将无法正常运作。
sx: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
水、森林和矿物都是重要的天然资源。
A mine is where you find precious minerals.
矿里能找到宝贵的矿物质。

v.t: n. 药丸, 弹丸, 屈辱, 胡说 / v. 做成药丸, 形成丸状, 服药丸, 挫败, 抢劫
v.s: If symptoms do not ease after taking Suxiao Jiuxin Pills, take nitroglycerin immediately.
v.sz: 如果服用速效救心丸后症状并未缓解，请立即服用硝酸甘油。
sx: These pills act on the heart.
这种药片对心脏有疗效。
Why does Tom take those pills?
为啥汤姆要吃这些药片？

v.t: adv. 适度地, 相当地
v.s: He thought she spoke reasonably, so he accepted her suggestion.
v.sz: 他觉得她说得很有道理，于是接受了她的建议。

v.t: n. 被拒之人, 被弃之物, 不合格品, 次品 / vt. 拒绝, 抵制, 否决, 驳回, 丢弃, 呕出
v.s: Many people rejected the invitation to the welcome party.
v.sz: 许多人拒绝了欢迎会的邀请。
sx: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。
Mary bluntly rejected Tom's request.
玛丽直截了当地拒绝了汤姆的请求。

v.t: n. 锡, 马口铁, 罐头 / vt. 在...镀锡于 / a. 锡制的
v.s: Can you distinguish silver from tin?
v.sz: 你能分辨银和锡吗?

v.t: vt. 放弃, 抛弃, 遗弃, 使屈从, 沉溺, 放纵 / n. 放任, 无拘束, 狂热
v.s: I walked without hope, already resigned to the certain fate of being abandoned forever.
v.sz: 我毫无希望地走着，已经屈服在永远被抛弃的命运之下。
sx: A shepherd drove his snow-covered goat into an abandoned cave to take shelter from the blizzard.
一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。
Next to China, Switzerland is an abandoned village.
在中国的旁边，瑞士像一个荒废的乡村似的。

v.t: n. 跳, 跳跃, 弹力, 撞击 / vi. 反跳, 弹跳 / vt. 使跳回, 撞击
v.s: The billiard ball bounced off of three different sides of the table before landing in a side pocket.
v.sz: 那颗撞球在桌面的三个边框上各回弹了一下，最后落入一个边袋。
sx: I'm surprised Tom hasn't bounced back by now.
我很惊讶汤姆到现在还没有恢复过来。
Tom's check bounced.
汤姆的支票被退票了。

v.t: a. 令人困惑的；混淆的；混乱的
v.s: This is an example of confusing two things that have a common cause with one thing that causes another.
v.sz: 这显然是将属并列关系的两件事误解成为因果关系了。
sx: This is extremely confusing.
这事费解得很。
You're confusing me with someone else.
你认错人了。

v.t: adv. 故意地
v.s: He deliberately exposed her to danger.
v.sz: 他故意令她陷入险境。

v.t: n. 尺寸, 次元, 面积, 维数 / vt. 标出尺寸
n. 巨大的热情, 热心
v.s: Tom doesn't share Mary's enthusiasm.
v.sz: 汤姆没有感受到玛丽的热情。
sx: Enthusiasm is contagious.
热情具有传染性。

v.t: n. 电冰箱
v.s: The chocolate is going to melt if you keep it out of the fridge.
v.sz: 巧克力不放在冰箱里的话会融化的。
sx: The ice-cream will melt, so I put it in the fridge.
冰淇淋会融化所以我把它放在冰箱里。
Sami found his soda in Layla's fridge.
萨米在莱拉的冰箱里找到了他的汽水。

v.t: n. 小羊, 羔羊 / v. 产羊羔
v.s: Lambs are usually killed before they are one year old and eaten by humans.
v.sz: 羊羔通常在一岁前被宰杀吃掉。
sx: I like to eat lamb kebabs.
我喜欢吃烤羊肉串。
I like beef more than lamb.
比起羊肉我更喜欢牛肉。

v.t: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构
v.s: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
v.sz: 有人发现一个老工人在车间修机器。
sx: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.
于是出现了一个问题，哪里能找我们需要的机器。
Something must be wrong with the machinery.
这个机器一定有什么地方不对劲。

v.t: vt. 持有, 占有, 拥有, 克制, 支配, 迷住
v.s: I believe you already possess all the qualities needed to go undercover.
v.sz: 我认为，你已经完全具备了潜伏的资质。
sx: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
得不到的东西就最想得到。
He's unaware of who possesses them.
他不知道这些东西的归属。

v.t: n. 辞职, 辞呈, 听从
v.s: What shocked us greatly was his sudden resignation.
v.sz: 让我们非常惊讶的是，他突然辞职了。

v.t: n. 架子, 搁板
v.s: Tom reached for a dictionary that was on the very top of the shelf.
v.sz: 汤姆把手伸向了书架上最高的一本词典。
sx: He put the books on the shelf out of order.
他胡乱把书本放在架上。
She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
她把她的CD在书架上排成一排。

v.t: vt. 警告, 提醒, 通知 / vi. 发出警告
v.s: The farmer warned the children not to stomp on the freshly planted crops.
v.sz: 农夫警告孩子们不要践踏新栽种的作物。
sx: I warned him, but he ignored the warning.
我警告过他，但他不理会警告。
She warned him not to go out at night alone.
她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。

v.t: n. 元, 雄鹿, 纨绔子弟, 鞍马, 培克(赌博时的庄家标志), 碱水, 自夸, 谈话 / vi. 马背突然拱起, 反对, 吹牛, 闲聊 / vt. 马背突然拱起将骑手摔下, 反对, 用碱水洗 / a. 雄的
v.s: Where is your twenty? I'll give you five bucks for it.
v.sz: 你的二十块在哪里? 我给你五块钱找到它。
sx: He borrowed one hundred bucks from me.
他跟我借一百块。
You owe me thirty bucks.
你欠我三十美元。

v.t: n. 圆盘, 磁盘
v.s: My son followed Xiao Wang to buy disks.
v.sz: 我儿子跟着小王买碟片去了。

v.t: adv. 正式地, 形式上
v.s: French is the only foreign language I've ever formally studied.
v.sz: 我只系统地学习过法语。

v.t: adv. 显著地, 著名地, 尤其, 特别
n. 填补, 衬垫, 印色盒, 路 / vt. 填补, 走, 夸大 / vi. 步行
v.s: I'm almost out of maxi pads. Can you buy me two packs this afternoon?
v.sz: 我的卫生巾快用完了，下午能帮我买两包吗？
sx: Is this maxi pad for overnight use?
这是夜用的卫生巾吗？
May I use your ink pad?
可以借你的印台一用吗？

v.t: n. 帆, 篷, 帆船, 航程, 帆状物 / vi. 航行, 启航, 张帆而行 / vt. 航行于, 驾船
v.s: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
v.sz: 汤姆正在教我怎么开帆船。
sx: Several yachts were sailing side by side far out at sea.
数艘游艇在远方的海洋并列航行。
Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

v.t: n. 同情, 赞同, 怜悯, 慰问, 吊唁
v.s: When real life friends desert us, books are always ready to offer friendship, sympathy and motivation.
v.sz: 生活中的朋友弃我们不顾之时，书随时给我们送来友谊、同情和鼓励。
sx: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
每个人都对囚犯表示同情。
I feel no sympathy for Tom.
我不同情汤姆。

v.t: a. 理论的, 理论上的, 假设的, 推理的
v.s: The Greeks invented a theoretical model of geometry.
v.sz: 希腊人建立了几何学的理论模型。

v.t: n. 参观者, 游客, 访客
v.s: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
v.sz: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
sx: At the entrance of a Japanese house, visitors are generally asked to take off their shoes.
访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
There weren't many visitors spending their vacations on the island in April.
在四月，来岛上度假的游客不多。

v.t: a. 自动的, 自愿的, 故意的, 志愿的, 自发的 / n. 自愿行动, 志愿者, 自由调
v.s: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.
v.sz: 她星期天也只能去公司做义务劳动了。

v.t: n. 擦拭, 用力打, 凸轮 / vt. 擦, 揩, 消灭, 涂上, 拭去 / vi. 擦, 打
v.s: They are struggling with the goal of wiping out smallpox.
v.sz: 他们奋斗的目标是消灭天花。
sx: When did you last wipe someone's tears away?
你最后一次替别人擦眼泪是什么时候？
Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel.
用纸巾把那口锅擦干。

v.t: v. 安排, 排列, 达成协议
v.s: Rocks are beautifully arranged in the Japanese-style garden.
v.sz: 石头被美丽得放置在日式庭园里。
sx: We have not yet arranged the time to leave for Nanjing.
我们还没安排去南京的时间。
A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
旅行社会为你安排去安达卢西亚的旅行。

v.t: vi. 举止端正, 行为规矩 / vt. 检点(自己的)行为, 使表现好
v.s: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
v.sz: 当她的孩子在公共场合行为表现不好的时候，她觉得很尴尬。
sx: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。
Can you put up with the way he behaves?
你能容忍他做事的方式么？

v.t: vt. 借, 借入, 借用 / vi. 借
v.s: Father ran short of money and had to borrow some.
v.sz: 父亲缺钱，所以他必须去借点钱。
sx: He borrowed money from the bank in order to buy a car.
他为了买车向银行借款。
I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。

v.t: n. 办事员, 职员, 文书 / vi. 当店员
v.s: Among the audience, there were students, teachers, clerks, and so on.
v.sz: 听众中有学生、老师还有职员，等等。
sx: I am a serious clerk, and at home, I am a good wife and mother.
我是一个认真的文员，在家里，我是一个好妻子兼好母亲。
Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

v.t: adv. 非常地, 很, 颇
n. 小屋, 茅舍
v.s: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
v.sz: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
sx: The old cottage had only one bed, so we all took turns sleeping in it.
那间旧屋里只有一张床，所以我们便轮流睡觉。
I saw a cottage in the distance.
我看见远处有一间小屋。

v.t: n. 暂停, 中止, 停顿, 间歇, 踌躇, 休止符 / vi. 暂停, 中止, 停顿, 踌躇
v.s: He spoke for ten minutes without a pause.
v.sz: 他不停顿地说了十分钟。
sx: He paused to have a cigarette.
他停下来抽根烟。

v.t: n. 名声, 宣传, 公开场合
v.s: You don't have to worry about publicity.
v.sz: 你不用担心宣传的事。

v.t: n. 薄的切片, 一部分, 菜刀 / vt. 切成薄片, 切下 / vi. 切
v.s: He put three slices of garlic in the vegetables.
v.sz: 他在菜里放了三瓣大蒜。
sx: On the weekend, our whole family went to eat Sichuan food and ordered mapo tofu and husband-and-wife lung slices.
周末我们全家去吃四川菜，点了麻婆豆腐和夫妻肺片。
Will you have another slice of pie?
你要再来一块馅饼吗？

v.t: n. 拼, 拼字, 拼法
v.s: Many words are pronounced according to the spelling, but some are not.
v.sz: 许多词是根据拼写来发音的，不过有些不是。
sx: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。
Your composition was good except for the spelling.
你的文章写得很好，但却有很多字拼错了。

v.t: a. 聋的
v.s: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
v.sz: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。
sx: Deaf-mute people talk using sign language.
聋哑的人用手语说话。
He turned a deaf ear to their request.
他对他们的请求置若罔闻。

v.t: n. 期待, 指望, 展望
v.s: The degree to which it had been modernised far exceeded my expectations.
v.sz: 它现代化的程度远远超乎我的预料。
sx: For one reason or another their holiday in France didn't come up to expectations.
由于种种原因，他们在法国的假期没让他们感到满意。
Its level of modernisation far exceeded my expectations.
它现代化的程度远远超乎我的预料。

v.t: n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者 / a. 婴儿的, 幼稚的
v.s: It can make some people, especially the elderly and infants, very ill.
v.sz: 它可以使一些人，尤其是老人和婴幼儿，病得很重。
sx: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
那个年轻女人手抱著婴儿。
You should really take an infant CPR class.
你应该去上婴儿心肺复苏课程。

v.t: a. 整洁的, 巧妙的, 匀称的, 简洁的 / n. 牛
v.s: There was a neat pile of books in the corner of the room.
v.sz: 房间的角落里整整齐齐地放著一叠书。
sx: Tom isn't as neat as he used to be.
汤姆没有以前那么条理。
He took a drink of whiskey neat.
他喝了一杯纯威士忌酒。

v.t: vi. 商议, 谈判, 交涉 / vt. 谈妥, 转让, 处理
vt. 计划, 打算, 建议, 提议, 求(婚) / vi. 打算, 求婚
v.s: She had been proposed to five times by the time she was twenty.
v.sz: 她二十岁的时候，就已经有五个人向她求过婚了。
sx: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.
他提出改革研究方法的意见。
He proposed a reform in the educational system.
他提议对教育系统进行改革。

v.t: a. 悲伤的, 痛的, 引起痛苦的 / n. 痛处, 溃疡, 疮
v.s: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
v.sz: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。
sx: I had sore legs the next day.
第二天我的腿很酸。
I was sore for three weeks.
我难受三周了。

v.t: n. 浸渍, 悬崖 / a. 险峻的, 陡峭的, 急剧升降的, 夸大的 / v. 浸, 泡
v.s: My cousin is so steeped in schoolwork that his friends call him bookworm.
v.sz: 我的表兄弟太过沉浸于学业，以致于他的朋友们唤他作书虫。
sx: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

v.t: n. 稻草, 麦管, 吸管, 一文不值的东西, 草帽 / a. 稻草的, 稻草色的, 琐碎的, 无价值的
vt. 称...重量, 衡量, 把...压弯, 考虑, 权衡, 起锚 / vi. 称分量, 有意义, 重压, 起锚 / n. 过秤, 称分量
v.s: Let us weigh one catty of cuttlefish.
v.sz: 我们称一斤花枝吧。
sx: Can you weigh this, please?
请你称一下这个的重量好吗？
Please, weigh these peaches.
请称一下这些桃子。

v.t: pron. 无论什么
v.s: It makes no sense whatsoever.
v.sz: 无论如何说不通。

v.t: a. 坏的, 邪恶的, 缺德的, 刻毒的, 恶劣的, 淘气的
v.s: The wicked witch cast a spell on the man and turned him into a bug.
v.sz: 恶毒的巫婆在男人身上施了咒语，把他变成了一只虫子。
sx: It is wicked of you to do such things.
你竟然做出那样的事来，你还是人吗？

v.t: vt. 使适应, 改编 / vi. 适应
v.s: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
v.sz: 我把车库改造成工作室使用。
sx: But CNN has learned that, due to her husband's guidance, Kate feels she has already adapted to her new life.
但是CNN获悉，由于她丈夫的指导，凯萨琳感觉已经适应了新的生活。
I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
我适应新环境很慢。

v.t: n. 豆子
v.s: Some legumes, like chickpeas and green beans, cause flatulence but are excellent foods.
v.sz: 鹰嘴豆和青豆等豆类虽然会引起胀气，但却是极佳的美食。
sx: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
巴西向世界各地供应优质咖啡豆。
What's your favorite way to cook beans?
你最喜欢用什么方法煮豆子？

v.t: n. 自行车
v.s: It is illegal for bicycles to ride on the right side of cars.
v.sz: 自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。
sx: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？
Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.
自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。

v.t: n. 撞击, 肿块 / vt. 碰撞 / vi. 撞, 颠簸而行
v.s: I bumped my head against the door and got a lump.
v.sz: 我头撞到了门，肿了一块。
sx: As Ziri ran out of the classroom, he bumped into someone and fell to the floor.
齐里跑出教室时撞到了人，摔倒在地。
I bumped into an old friend on the bus.
我偶然在巴士上碰见了一位旧朋友。

v.t: n. 同事, 同僚
v.s: He and a colleague who went to China later translated The New Testament into Chinese.
v.sz: 他跟一个去中国的同事后来把圣经中的新约翻译成中文。
sx: Lucy and I are not colleagues, we are classmates.
我和露西不是同事，是同学。
My colleague arranged the work files for me.
同事为我准备好了工作文件。

v.t: vt. 构造, 建造, 对...进行构思, 作图 / n. 构成物
v.s: Take my hand. The two of us are going to construct a utopia.
v.sz: 握著我的手。我们两个将要建立一个乌托邦。
sx: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
读完他的书后，我觉得我可以构建一栋房子。
The purpose of criticism is to construct, not to destroy.
批评的目的是建设而不是破坏。

v.t: vt. 使暴露, 使曝光, 揭穿, 陈列
v.s: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.
v.sz: 我们闲时应该出外晒晒太阳。
sx: Tom was exposed to a wide variety of music as a child through his mother's vast record collection.
由于母亲收藏了一整屋的唱片，汤姆小时候便有机会接触各种类型的音乐。
He deliberately exposed her to danger.
他故意令她陷入险境。

v.t: vt. 组织, 有机化, 给予生机 / vi. 组织起来
v.s: If someone is indispensable to a company, then that company is not well-organized.
v.sz: 若是有人对公司来说是不可或缺的，那么这家公司组织得不好。
sx: He organized a classroom debate on current events.
他组织了一场关于时事的课堂辩论。
William is so organized. He's always on top of things.
威廉做事很有条理，他总是能把一切都打点好。

v.t: n. 遗憾, 同情, 怜悯, 憾事, 可惜 / vt. 同情, 怜悯 / vi. 觉得可怜, 有同情心
v.s: It's a pity that you can't buy miracles like you would buy potatoes.
v.sz: 可惜我们不能像买土豆一样买奇迹。
sx: It is a pity that you cannot come to the party.
你不能来参加派对，真是可惜。
It is a pity that he has no sense of humor.
可惜他是一个完全没有幽默感的人。

v.t: n. 池塘 / v. 筑成池塘
v.s: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
v.sz: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。
sx: Have you ever wondered how fish survive in cold winter weather, or where they go when lakes and ponds freeze over?
你有没有想过，鱼类是如何在寒冷的冬季生存的，或者当湖泊和池塘结冰时牠们会去哪里？
It is dangerous for children to play near this pond.
小孩在这个水池旁边玩会很容易发生意外的。

v.t: vt. 使满意, 满足, 符合, 使确信, 赔偿 / vi. 令人满意, 替人赎罪
v.s: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
v.sz: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。
sx: They are satisfied with the contract.
他们对合同很满意。
I am not satisfied with my performance today.
我对我今天的表演不满意。

v.t: a. 有感觉的, 敏感的, 明智的
v.s: Opera in English is, in the main, just about as sensible as baseball in Italian.
v.sz: 以英语唱的歌剧，大致上和以意大利语玩的棒球般过得去。
sx: A sensible man wouldn't say such a thing in public.
稍有头脑的人都不会在公众场合里说出这种话来。
It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
你听从她的忠告是明智的。

v.t: vt. 赞美, 钦佩, 爱慕 / vi. 称赞, 惊奇
v.s: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.
v.sz: 学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。
sx: The sea is admired by those who don't go to sea.
不出海的人，也对大海心生敬仰。
Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
汤姆和玛丽手牵着手，一起欣赏风景。

v.t: n. 特性, 特征, 特色 / a. 特性的, 特有的, 有特色的
v.s: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
v.sz: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？
sx: Do transgender people need to continuously use hormones to maintain their sexual characteristics?
变性者需要不断服用激素来维持性别特征吗？
The weather here has its own unique characteristics.
这里的天气有独一无二的特点。

v.t: a. 幸运的, 幸福的
v.s: I realized how fortunate I was and how many second chances life has given me.
v.sz: 我意识到我是多么的幸运，命运给了我这么多重来的机会。
sx: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
你们很幸运有这样的朋友们。
I am fortunate compared with him.
与他比起来我还是很幸福的。

v.t: a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的
v.s: I'll keep this information handy for future reference.
v.sz: 我会将这则资讯记下来，以便未来参考。
sx: She is handy with a needle.
她擅长针线活。
It really comes in handy.
这真的能派上用场。

v.t: pron. 她的
v.s: I am hers and she is mine.
v.sz: 我是她的，而她是我的。
sx: Nancy ran across an old friend of hers yesterday.
Nancy昨天巧遇了她的一个老朋友。
Is there any difference between your idea and hers?
你的想法和她的想法有甚么不同吗？

v.t: n. 执照, 许可证, 特许 / vt. 许可, 特许, 认可
v.s: He didn't get a driving licence until he was twenty-eight.
v.sz: 他二十八岁才拿到驾照。
sx: Tom was arrested for driving without a licence.
汤姆因无证驾驶而被逮捕。
This car once had a foreign licence.
这辆车曾有一个外国牌照。

v.t: vt. 辞职, 放弃, 使顺从 / vi. 辞职, 屈从
v.s: He resigned from the job to take the responsibility for the loss.
v.sz: 为了这次的损失，他扛起责任，辞职了。
sx: I walked without hope, already resigned to the certain fate of being abandoned forever.
我毫无希望地走着，已经屈服在永远被抛弃的命运之下。
She decided to resign from her job.
她决定辞去她的工作。

v.t: n. 摩擦, 困难, 障碍, 磨损处 / vt. 擦, 搓, 摩擦, 惹怒 / vi. 摩擦, 擦破
v.s: Never rub your eyes when your hands are dirty.
v.sz: 手脏的时候千万不要揉眼睛。
sx: Rub out these words with your eraser.
用你的橡皮把这些字擦掉。
Rub salt in the wound.
按住痛处。

v.t: n. 牛排, 鱼排, 肉排
v.s: He finished the steak, then ordered another portion.
v.sz: 他吃完排骨又点了一份。
sx: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.
我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。
How would you like your steak?
您的牛排要几分熟？

v.t: n. 怀疑, 觉察, 嫌疑
v.s: He was under suspicion of being a spy.
v.sz: 人们怀疑他是间谍。
sx: Suspicion is destructive of friendship.
怀疑会毁掉友情。
The news confirmed my suspicions.
这一消息证实了我的怀疑。

v.t: n. 扫除, 打扫, 肃清, 视野, 范围, 全胜 / vt. 扫除, 掸去, 猛拉, 扫荡, 肃清, 冲走, 刮起, 环视, 掠过, 扫射 / vi. 扫, 打扫, 袭击, 席卷, 扫视, 掠过
v.s: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.
v.sz: 北方的春天送来狂风扫路。
sx: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.
记住把厨房打扫干净。
My father is sweeping the garage.
我父亲正在清扫车库。

v.t: n. 颊, 厚颜, 脸蛋
v.s: After slapping Tom's right cheek, Mary stomped on his left foot.
v.sz: 玛丽给了汤姆的右脸一巴掌，然后踩了他的左脚。
sx: He gave her a peck on the cheek.
他在她的脸上轻轻的亲了一下。
Tom gave Mary a kiss on both cheeks.
汤姆亲吻了玛丽的两颊。

v.t: n. 雇用 / vt. 雇用, 使用, 使从事于
v.s: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
v.sz: 她雇了一个私人侦探看守她的丈夫。
sx: A number of imaging techniques are employed in radiology, such as X-ray, MRI, and ultrasound.
放射学中采用了数种影像技术，比如 X 光、MRI 和超音波。
The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.
在这儿使用的语法形式是现在进行时。

v.t: n. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 罪过, 过错, 攻击
v.s: She took offence at my word.
v.sz: 她被我的话给激怒了。

v.t: n. 裙子, 下摆, 边缘, 郊区 / vt. 位于...边缘, 绕过, 回避 / vi. 位于边缘
v.s: The short skirt is out of fashion.
v.sz: 短裙不时髦了。
sx: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
这条裙子挺漂亮的，可以试穿吗？
I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
我想试一下那条蓝色条纹裙。

v.t: n. 骚动, 轰动, 搅动, 监狱 / vt. 移动, 摇动, 激起, 惹起, 搅拌 / vi. 走动, 传播, 搅拌
v.s: Two women wielding giant spatulas continuously stir a brimming wok of shredded beef simmering in curry sauce.
v.sz: 两名女子挥舞著巨大的锅铲，不停地翻炒著盛满咖哩酱汁的牛肉丝。
sx: I don't want to stir up old memories.
我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。
Stir the soup.
搅一下汤。

v.t: n. 趋向, 倾向
v.s: There is a tendency for people to think that hang gliding is dangerous.
v.sz: 人们普遍认为悬挂式滑翔运动是危险的。
sx: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。

v.t: pron. 他们的
v.s: Your team is very good, but theirs is the best.
v.sz: 你们是个非常好的团队，但他们的是最好的。
sx: The speed at which native speakers of other languages are adding sentences doesn't even compare to theirs.
其它母语的使用者添加句子的速度也比不过他们的。
My opinion is the same as theirs.
我和他们意见一致。

v.t: n. 吐司, 烤面包, 干杯 / vt. 敬酒, 烤, 使暖和 / vi. 烤, 烘
v.s: When he runs out of knives, Lyle butters his toast with a spoon.
v.sz: 没有刀子的时候，莱尔在面包上涂上奶油就用汤匙。
sx: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.
汤姆往他的面包片上放了许多蜂蜜。
In honor of all the hard work we raised a toast to our first day in our new home!
感谢大家的辛苦付出，我们为第一天入住新家举杯同庆！

v.t: a. 狡猾的, 机敏的
v.s: This is an East Asian concept -- it's a little tricky to explain in Spanish.
v.sz: 这是一个东方的概念，用西班牙语不太好解释。
sx: I've heard Italian is a tricky language.
听说意大利语是一门很难的语言 。

v.t: n. 批评家, 鉴定家
v.s: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
v.sz: 这位著名的登山家批评大众旅游。

v.t: n. 电梯, 升降机
v.s: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.
v.sz: 这部电梯一次能运送10个人。
sx: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。
After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
我到柜台拿了钥匙，然后就乘电梯去了我房间的楼层。

v.t: n. 铅笔, 色笔, 眉笔, 画笔, 光线束 / vt. 用铅笔写或涂, 草拟
v.s: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
v.sz: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
sx: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.
你的铅笔差点戳到我的眼睛了。
I need a pencil. Can I use one of yours?
我需要一支铅笔，我能用你的其中一支吗？

v.t: n. 钱包, 小钱袋, 金钱, 募捐款, 囊状物 / v. 缩拢, 皱起
v.s: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.
v.sz: 我突然想起钱包好像放在家中，忘了带了。
sx: She found her purse under the desk.
她在桌子底下找到了她的钱包。
Tom found Mary's purse under the sofa.
汤姆在沙发底下找到了玛丽的包。

v.t: n. 顾问, 劝告者, 指导教师
vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致
v.s: Liberty consists of being able to make everything as harmless as possible.
v.sz: 自由旨在能够做所有不伤害其他人的事。
sx: The Milky Way consists of about a hundred billion stars.
银河系大约由一千亿颗恒星组成。
The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.
蝙蝠的食物主要包括昆虫和水果。

v.t: a. 钝的, 无趣的, 呆滞的, 阴暗的 / vt. 使迟钝, 使阴暗, 缓和 / vi. 变迟钝, 减少
v.s: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
v.sz: 咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。
sx: I have a dull pain in my temples and my mind feels like its covered with a thin layer of fog.
太阳穴钝钝地痛，意识似乎被笼罩上了一层薄薄的雾霭。
The point of the pencil has become dull.
铅笔头钝了。

v.t: vt. 找出, 设于, 位于 / vi. 定居
v.s: The school is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
v.sz: 学校坐落于距离车站步行五分钟的地方。
sx: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
大使馆就在最高法院旁边。
Switzerland is located between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

v.t: n. 邻接, 周围, 附近一带, 邻近, 邻居关系, 地区, 街道, 街坊, 四邻
vt. 反对, 以...对抗, 抗争 / vi. 反对
v.s: More than half of the residents are opposed to the plan.
v.sz: 有过半数的居民反对这个计划。
sx: Every one opposed it, but Mary and John got married all the same.
随然大家一致反对，但玛丽和约翰还是结了婚。
The city government wants to set up special cycle lanes. However, a lot of drivers oppose the idea.
市政府想建设专门的自行车道。但是，很多司机反对这个主意。

v.t: n. 超时, 加班, 延长时间 / a. 超时的, 加班的 / adv. 加班地 / vt. 使超过时间
v.s: Jia-hao said he's not coming today. He has a last-minute overtime.
v.sz: 家豪说他今天不来了，临时加班。
sx: In order to cut down on costs, the company refuses to allow employees to work overtime.
公司为了削减成本，拒绝让员工自行加班。
I'm afraid you have to work overtime.
恐怕你要加班了。

v.t: n. 紧握, 挤, 榨, 榨取, 佣金 / vt. 紧握, 挤, 榨取 / vi. 压榨, 榨
v.s: Milking soybeans must be a tiring task, all that squeezing.
v.sz: 挤大豆肯定是很累人的工作，需要不停地挤压。
sx: She squeezed the juice from many oranges.
她用了许多柳橙来榨汁。
Tom squeezed Mary's hand.
汤姆捏了玛丽的手。

v.t: n. 以货易货 / v. 交换, 替换, 交易
vt. 恐吓, 威胁, 预示...的凶兆 / vi. 威胁, 恫吓, 可能来临
v.s: The protesters threatened to stomp on the banners left by their opposition.
v.sz: 抗议者威胁要践踏反对者留下的横幅。
sx: The man with the gun threatened to kill Tom's dog.
持枪男子扬言要杀死汤姆的狗。
No point in threatening me. I'll still tell you nothing.
威胁我也没用，我什么都不会说的。

v.t: n. 手巾, 毛巾 / v. 擦干身子
v.s: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
v.sz: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。
sx: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。
She came out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel.
她围著一条浴巾从浴室走了出来。

v.t: n. 蔬菜, 植物, 无精打采之人 / a. 蔬菜的, 植物的
v.s: Modern healthy eating experts put emphasis on eating wholemeal bread and eating more vegetables.
v.sz: 现代的健康饮食专家强调要吃全麦面包，多吃蔬菜。
sx: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
蔬菜的价格每天在变。
In France, potatoes are vegetables, while in the Netherlands, they are not.
土豆在法国是蔬菜，在荷兰则不是。

v.t: n. 德行, 美德, 优点, 功效, 效力
v.s: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
v.sz: 她凭著努力和生意头脑成了富翁。
sx: In this society where everything is disposable, it is a virtue to use something until it wears out.
在这个社会里一切都是用完即丢, 用东西直到它磨损是一种美德。
Patience is the most beautiful virtue.
忍耐是最美的美德。

v.t: vi. 站立, 出现, 起来
v.s: I'm not afraid of facing pressure. When problems arise, I will quickly think of ways to find the solutions.
v.sz: 我不怕面对压力,有问题的时候,我就会很快地想办法去解决
sx: Heroes arise in troubled times.
乱世出英雄。

v.t: n. 目录, 工商名录, 指南
v.s: May I see the telephone directory?
v.sz: 我能看看电话簿吗？

v.t: n. 印象, 特征, 印记 / vt. 使有印象, 印, 铭刻, 传送, 影响, 强征 / vi. 给人印象
v.s: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.
v.sz: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。
sx: Wow, she’s got a lot of pace, I’m impressed!
哇，她真是神速啊，真让我印象深刻！
We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

v.t: vt. 占领, 占(时间、空间等), 住进, 担任, 使从事, 使全神贯注
v.s: The meeting room is occupied at the moment.
v.sz: 会议室正在使用中。
sx: When the sign on the door of a rest room says OCCUPIED, it means someone is using it.
厕所门上的标示显示「使用中」的时候，代表有人正在使用。
The house is not occupied now.
房子现在没被占住。

v.t: n. 印刷工, 打印机
v.s: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
v.sz: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。
sx: The printer of my company broke down again, so I'm going to the convenience store to copy documents.
因为公司的打印机又坏了，我要去便利店打印文件。
The printer stopped in the middle, so I only have part of his CV.
打印机只打了一半儿就停了，我手上只有他简历的一部分。

v.t: adv. 迅速地, 轻易地, 乐意地
v.s: Although Hiroko dislikes cigarette smoke, she readily goes out drinking with friends.
v.sz: 虽然弘子不喜欢香烟的烟雾，她却乐意和朋友出去喝酒。
sx: People will accept your idea much more readily if you tell them Benjamin Franklin said it first.
如果你告诉他们富兰克林是第一个这么说的, 人们会更乐意接受你的想法。
We all know that blue-eyed red-heads are sensitive to sunshine, burning more readily than dark-skinned people.
我们都知道，蓝眼睛红头发的人对阳光敏感，比深色皮肤的人更容易晒伤。

v.t: vt. 承受, 支持, 供养, 继续, 忍受, 蒙受, 证实, 准许
v.s: Tom sustained serious burns and had to go to the hospital.
v.sz: 汤姆严重烧伤，不得不去医院治疗。
sx: I sustain my family.
我赚钱养家。
We sustained significant losses.
我们遭受了重大损失。

v.t: vt. 翻译, 解释, 转化, 转变为, 调动 / vi. 翻译, 被译
v.s: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.
v.sz: 我可以做中英双向翻译，参加跟外国人交际谈判。
sx: The author translated the fairy tale into our mother tongue.
作者将童话翻译成了我们的母语。
I'll need at least three days to translate that thesis.
要翻译那篇论文，我最少需要三天时间。

v.t: n. 乡下地方, 乡下居民
v.s: My parents live a carefree life in the countryside.
v.sz: 我父母在乡村过着无忧无虑的生活。
sx: The countryside has many trees.
乡间有很多树。

v.t: n. 大蒜
v.s: I like garlic but, because of the smell, I rarely eat it.
v.sz: 虽然我喜欢大蒜，但因为很臭，所以很少吃。
sx: He put three slices of garlic in the vegetables.
他在菜里放了三瓣大蒜。
This dish has a bit of garlic flavor.
这道菜里有点大蒜的味道。

v.t: vt. 征(税), 把...强加于, 以...欺骗 / vi. 利用, 欺骗, 施加影响
v.s: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
v.sz: 我们应该尽量避免把我们自己的信念强加在别人身上。
sx: He always imposes his opinion on me.
他总是把他的看法强加给我。

v.t: n. 空闲, 闲暇, 悠闲 / a. 空闲的, 有闲的
v.s: For one thing, I've no money, and for another, I've no leisure.
v.sz: 我一没钱，二没时间。
sx: I often spend my leisure time listening to the radio.
我常常在我的闲暇时候听广播。
She spends her leisure time making dolls.
她利用空闲时间做布娃娃。

v.t: vt. 借, 贷款给, 增添, 提供, 出租 / vi. 贷款
v.s: Could you lend me some money? I'm short of cash at the moment.
v.sz: 可以借点钱给我吗？我现在有点缺钱。
sx: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？
If you want this pen, I will lend it to you.
你想用这支笔，我就借给你吧。

v.t: n. 闲逛, 休闲室, 长沙发 / vi. 闲混, (懒洋洋地)躺 / vt. 闲混
adv. 幸运地, 幸亏, 侥幸
v.s: I got to the bank and luckily didn't have to get in line.
v.sz: 我到银行去，很幸运地不必排队。
sx: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
幸运的是他有足够的钱来付账。
Luckily, we found an escape route.
幸运的是，我们找到了逃生通道。

v.t: a. 有礼貌的, 文雅的, 客气的, 有教养的
v.s: When you go abroad, it is useful to learn at least some polite phrases in the local language.
v.sz: 你出国的时候学一些当地的礼貌用语还是很有用的。
sx: There's no need to be polite with this kind of person.
对这种人，用不着客气。
In Japan, it is polite to bow when one meets someone.
在日本，遇到人鞠躬是有礼貌的表现。

v.t: n. 收据, 收入, 收到 / vt. 开...的收据
v.s: I lost my receipt and had to call customer service at both IKEA and the bank.
v.sz: 我遗失了收据，不得不给 IKEA 和银行的客服部门打电话。
sx: I'd like a receipt, please.
麻烦我要一张收据。
Have you a receipt?
你有没有收据？

v.t: n. 野心, 志向
v.s: It reveals local executives' ambitions of bringing the region back to the top.
v.sz: 这表明了地方领导恢复地区卓越水平的雄心。
sx: His ambition was blasted by these repeated failures.
无数次的失败摧毁了他的雄心壮志。
Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。

v.t: vt. 烘焙, 烤 / vi. 烤面包 / n. 烘焙, 烤
v.s: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.
v.sz: 将它们放在烤盘上并且涂抹蛋白。
sx: The best cakes that I have ever eaten are those that my mother baked.
母亲做了的蛋糕是我吃了的最好的。
Open the window. It's baking hot in here.
请开一下窗。这里像烤炉一样热。

v.t: n. 目录, 大学情况一览 / vt. 编入目录
v.s: Brahe catalogued over 1000 stars.
v.sz: 布拉赫为一千多颗恒星做了编目。

v.t: a. 可从中得到乐趣的, 令人愉快的
v.s: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.
v.sz: 这张照片让我想起童年的快乐时光。
sx: A little knowledge of Spanish will go a long way toward making your trip to Mexico enjoyable.
懂一点西班牙语的话，你去墨西哥一定会玩得更愉快。
I had an enjoyable two weeks in London.
我在伦敦度过了愉快的两周。

v.t: n. 一瞥, 闪光, 掠过, 辉矿类 / vi. 扫视, 闪光, 掠过, 提到, 略说 / vt. 扫视, 反射, 使掠过
v.s: Kate glanced at Chris and then ignored him, making him feel miserable.
v.sz: 凯特看了克里斯一眼，然后不理睬他，使他感到痛苦。
sx: She cast a shy glance on the young man.
她羞怯地看了一眼那个年轻人。
Possibly because he's got a beard, he looks scary at first glance but he's really a kind man.
或许是因为他有胡子而让他乍看之下很可怕，其实他是个非常好的人。

v.t: n. 麻布袋, 洗劫 / vt. 把...装入袋, 洗劫
v.s: Those good-for-nothing layabouts were sacked.
v.sz: 那些一无是处的废物被炒了。
sx: I got the sack but I've a little saved up, so for the time being I won't be troubled by living expenses.
虽然我被公司解雇了，但是我还有点存款，所以目前不用担心生计问题。

v.t: vi. 注视, 凝视, 瞪视, 显眼 / vt. 盯 / n. 凝视
v.s: You might as well read a novel instead of staring at the ceiling.
v.sz: 望着天花板发呆,还不如读一读小说。
sx: It's embarrassing to be seen without make-up so please don't stare.
素颜太害羞了，请不要盯着我看。
My manager stared at me as if he was angry.
经理像是生气了一样盯着我。

v.t: adv. 可怕地, 甚为, 非常
v.s: He was terribly poor when he was young.
v.sz: 他年轻的时候穷困潦倒。
sx: My temples are hurting me terribly.
我太阳穴处疼极了。
It was terribly cold yesterday.
昨天相当的冷啊！

v.t: n. 羊毛, 毛织物, 毛线, 绒线
v.s: The wool comes off the pig, and the dog pays the bill.
v.sz: 羊毛出在猪身上，狗来买单。
sx: These garments are made of 100 percent wool.
这些布是全羊毛的。
Cats love to run after balls of wool.
猫喜欢追着毛线球跑。

v.t: n. 清洁工人, 清洁剂, 干洗商
v.s: The air of Sydney is cleaner than that of Tokyo.
v.sz: 悉尼的空气比东京的要干净。
sx: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
我用吸尘机把地上的灰尘吸掉了。
I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
我免费得到了这个吸尘器。

v.t: vt. 结束, 作结论, 推断 / vi. 结束, 推断
v.s: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
v.sz: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。
sx: After looking at the research, most of us conclude that vaccines are a good thing.
看完研究以后，我们其中大部分人论定疫苗是件好事。
As he has done a lot of bad things, we can conclude that he is a bad person.
因为他做了不少坏事，我们可以断定他不是个好人。

v.t: interj. 唉, 天啊, 天哪
n. 历史学家, 记事者
adv. 不可避免地
v.s: In addition, coincidences inevitably come in threes.
v.sz: 不但如此，巧合的事还会接二连三地发生。

v.t: n. 青年, 家伙, 少年, 情人
v.s: He's a good lad.
v.sz: 他是个好人。

v.t: n. 倾斜, 斜坡, 斜率, 扛枪姿势 / vt. 使倾斜, 弄斜, 扛 / vi. 倾斜, 走, 逃走
v.s: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
v.sz: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。
sx: We climbed a sharp slope.
我们爬上陡坡。

v.t: a. 坚硬的, 严厉的, 呆板的, 生硬的, 刚强的, 强烈的, 粘的, 稠的, 艰难的 / n. 死尸, 醉鬼, 钞票 / vt. 不肯付...小费
v.s: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
v.sz: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。
sx: After standing for 6 hours, Antonio's legs became stiff.
Antonio站了六个小时后，腿变得僵硬。
Stiff upper lip!
坚持到底！

v.t: a. 失业的, 未被利用的
v.s: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.
v.sz: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加

v.t: n. 兽医 / vi. 当兽医 / vt. 诊断, 检审
v.s: Mary took her dog to the vet.
v.sz: 玛莉带狗狗看兽医。

v.t: vt. 埋葬, 埋藏
v.s: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
v.sz: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。
sx: They were buried in a mass grave.
他们被埋在一座大坟墓里。
The pirates buried their treasure in the ground.
海盗把财宝藏进了地底。

v.t: vi. 浮现, 形成, 出现, (事实)显露
v.s: Most of today's books seem to have emerged overnight from yesterday's books.
v.sz: 如今的大多数书似乎是一夜之间从昨日的书籍中冒出来。
sx: As tectonic plates shifted, uniquely adapted species of dinosaur emerged on each continent through vicariance.
随著板块的移动，各大洲因地理隔离而出现了适应不同环境的独特恐龙物种。
China is an emerging market.
中国是一个新兴市场。

v.t: n. 油炸食物, 鱼苗 / v. 油炸, 煎
v.s: On the table, there was a plate with three fried eggs on it.
v.sz: 桌子上放著一个盘子，上面放著三颗煎蛋。
sx: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
我每天至少用一次煎锅。
He fell out of the frying pan into the fire.
他真是刚出狼窝又入虎穴。

v.t: n. 房东, 地主
v.s: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
v.sz: 东家说要提高租金。

v.t: n. 痛苦, 悲惨, 不幸, 穷困
v.s: Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
v.sz: 钞能力不等于幸福，但可以暂时解决很多麻烦。
sx: His illness caused her great misery.
他的病使她非常伤心。

v.t: n. 妈咪
v.s: Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
v.sz: 妈妈，为什么我没有长胡子的舅舅呢？
sx: I gave it to my mommy.
我给我妈了。
You're going to be a mommy.
你要当妈了。

v.t: n. 洋葱 / vt. 因洋葱使掉泪
v.s: In this soup there are carrots, onions, parsley, celery and potatoes.
v.sz: 这个汤里有胡萝卜、洋葱、欧芹、芹菜和土豆。
sx: Cover the pan and cook until tender, then remove the cover and continue the cooking until the onions are a light brown.
盖上锅盖煮至洋葱变软，然后揭开锅盖继续煮至洋葱呈现浅棕色。
I grow tomatoes and onions in my garden.
我在花园种了番茄和洋葱。

v.t: adv. 锐利地, 严厉地, 厉害地
v.s: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
v.sz: 新竹市区的房价因为科技产业聚集而水涨船高。
sx: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
企业第一季度收益大幅增长。
Industrial production rose sharply in July.
7月份工业生产大幅增长。

v.t: n. 蜡烛 / vt. 对着光检查
v.s: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
v.sz: 一口气吹灭生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。
sx: When the lights went out, Tom lit a candle.
灯灭了，汤姆点起了蜡烛。
Electricity made candles of little use in our life.
电使蜡烛在我们的生活中变得没什么用了。

v.t: n. 走廊, 回廊, 人口密集地带
v.s: Every morning, the corridor was swept clean.
v.sz: 走廊每天早上都清扫得干干净净。

v.t: n. 资格, 条件, 限制
n. 匙, 调羹, 匙形工具 / vt. 以匙舀起, 调情, 使成匙状
v.s: When he runs out of knives, Lyle butters his toast with a spoon.
v.sz: 没有刀子的时候，莱尔在面包上涂上奶油就用汤匙。
sx: Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
Donna是含着金钥匙出生的。
Here are the knives, the forks and the spoons.
这里有刀叉和汤匙。

v.t: v. 计算, 预测, 计划, 打算
v.s: I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.
v.sz: 不先与我们的承包商讨论的话我无法计算出最后的费用。
sx: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
这项应用程序能让你快速计算身高体重指数（BMI）。
We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.
我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。

v.t: vi. 商讨, 商量, 协商, 会诊 / vt. 向...请教, 查阅, 考虑
v.s: He's already retired but is often asked by them to consult.
v.sz: 已经退休了，但还常常被他们请去做顾问。
sx: Why didn't you consult me before taking this decision?
你做这个决定之前，为什么不先问过我？
I don't know who to consult with.
我不知道该和谁商量好。

v.t: v. 区别, 辨别
v.s: It is not always easy to distinguish the Japanese from the Chinese.
v.sz: 日本人和中国人有时很难分辨。
sx: Can a child of her age distinguish good from bad?
一个像她那么大的小孩能够分辨是非吗？
I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

v.t: v. 支配, 占优势
v.s: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.
v.sz: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。

v.t: a. 非正式的, 不拘礼的, 通俗的
a. 散乱的, 污秽的, 麻烦的
n. 废物, 垃圾, 胡说
v.s: They looked at the rubbish, then they looked at each other.
v.sz: 他们看了看那堆垃圾，再互相望了一眼。
sx: Toss it into the rubbish bin.
给丢到垃圾桶里去。
Put it in the rubbish.
给丢到垃圾桶里去。

v.t: a. 楼上的 / adv. 在楼上, 向楼上, 处于更高地位 / n. 楼层
v.s: It seems that the burglar broke in through an upstairs window.
v.sz: 强盗似乎是在上层破窗而入的。
sx: Do you mind helping me carry this box upstairs?
你可以帮我把这个箱子搬上楼吗？
Let's take the furniture upstairs.
咱把家具抬上楼吧。

v.t: a. 含糊的, 不清楚的, 茫然的
v.s: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
v.sz: 她隐约地有一种的内疚感。
sx: This paragraph is vague.
这一个段落是模糊不清的。

v.t: n. 帐, 幕, 窗帘 / vt. 装帘子于, 遮蔽
v.s: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
v.sz: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
sx: When I opened the curtains, it was snowing.
当我拉开了窗帘时，在下雪呢。
She hung a curtain over the window.
她把窗帘挂在窗户上。

v.t: n. 牙科医生
v.s: It's best to go to the dentist at regular intervals.
v.sz: 最好定期去看牙医。
sx: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。
You should go to the dentist and have that tooth pulled out.
你应该去看牙医，把牙拔掉。

v.t: n. 信封, 封套, 封袋
v.s: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
v.sz: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。
sx: Tom told me not to open the envelope until my birthday.
汤姆告诉我，到我生日那天我才能打开信封。
Stick another stamp on the envelope.
把另一张邮票贴在信封上。

v.t: a. 活泼的, 鲜明的, 生动的
v.s: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
v.sz: 吃火锅的时候 ,气氛往往是非常热闹的.
sx: This village isn't big, but it's quite lively.
这个小镇不大,可是很热闹.
He's a bit lively.
他有点活泼。

v.t: n. 激励, 提示, 提醒物, 提词, 付款期限 / a. 迅速的, 敏捷的, 立刻的, 提词员的 / vt. 激励, 鼓动, 提示 / adv. 准时地
v.s: He pressed me for a prompt reply.
v.sz: 他要求我尽快回复。

v.t: n. 津贴, 零用钱, 限额, 折扣, 允许 / vt. 定量供应
v.s: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
v.sz: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。

v.t: n. 建立者
vt. 构成, 组成, 任命
v.s: These things constitute a balanced meal.
v.sz: 这些东西构成了一顿营养均衡的饭。

v.t: n. 图表；图解
v.s: Let me explain it with a diagram.
v.sz: 让我用一张图来说明。

v.t: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职 / vi. 解散
v.s: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.
v.sz: 可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性
sx: He was dismissed by the boss of the factory.
他被工厂的老板解雇。
By turning the page, we can dismiss the characters in a book without fear of hurting their feelings.
书页翻动之间，我们可以对书中的人物不予理会而不伤及他们的情感。

v.t: n. 汽油
v.s: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
v.sz: 这辆车每升油能跑十三公里。

v.t: a. 合并的, 组成公司的, 一体化的 / vt. 吸收, 合并, 使组成公司, 体现 / vi. 合并, 混合, 组成公司
v.s: China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.
v.sz: 中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。

v.t: adv. 第二, 其次
v.s: Secondly, is there any project scheduled to be released today?
v.sz: 其次，按照日程今天有将要发布的项目吗？

v.t: n. 番茄, 西红柿
v.s: One kilogram of tomato sauce is equivalent to two kilograms of tomatoes.
v.sz: 一公斤的番茄酱等于两公斤的西红柿。
sx: The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
番茄容易遭受很多病害。
The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
番茄是蔬菜而不是水果。

v.t: n. 广告, 启事, 广告宣传
v.s: He uses a spatula to scrape off advertisements that were stuck on the ground.
v.sz: 他用铲子刮掉黏在地上的广告单。
sx: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
我们已经收到了很多回应我们广告的申请。
If you want to sell your old sofa, why not put an advertisement in the local paper?
你若打算卖掉旧沙发, 何不在本地报纸上登个广告呢?

v.t: a. 狂热的, 热心的, 热烈的
v.s: This book is a result of his enthusiastic research.
v.sz: 这本书是他热心研究的成果。
sx: The portrait of the king was unveiled and received enthusiastic applause.
国王的肖像揭晓，收获了热烈的掌声。

v.t: n. 溢出, 溅出, 摔下, 溢出量, 木片, 小塞子 / vt. 使溢出, 使散落, 洒, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下 / vi. 溢出, 涌流, 摔下
v.s: I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
v.sz: 我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。
sx: Enjambment is when a sentence from one line of poetry spills over into the next line.
跨行是指一句话在诗歌中从一行跨到下一行的情况。
Clean up spills inside the oven as soon as they happen to avoid stubborn stains.
烤箱内如有液体洒出，应立即清理，以免留下顽固污渍。

v.t: n. 煮沸, 沸腾, 疖 / v. 煮沸, 激动
v.s: No need to trouble yourself, Auntie. A glass of boiled water will be plenty.
v.sz: 阿姨，您别客气，喝杯开水就行。
sx: Cook the peeled and chopped potatoes for 20 minutes in boiling water.
把去皮切成小块的土豆放在滚水里煮20分钟。
When the pressure is lower, the boiling point is lower.
压力越低，沸点越低。

v.t: vt. 暗示, 意味
v.s: A good education doesn't imply a good upbringing.
v.sz: 虽说是高学历，也未必就有教养。
sx: What are you trying to imply?
你是什么意思？
I didn't mean to imply that.
我没想暗示那件事。

v.t: a. 顽皮的, 没规矩的, 不适当的, 下流的
v.s: That little naughty one is running around the living room again!
v.sz: 这个小皮蛋，又在客厅乱跑！
sx: I can't stand naughty children.
我受不了淘气的小孩。

v.t: n. 修面, 刮胡子, 幸免, 剃刀 / vt. 修面, 剃, 修剪, 掠过 / vi. 刮脸, 勉强通过
v.s: As is often the case with him, he went to the office without shaving.
v.sz: 他一如往常，没有剃胡子就上班去了。
sx: A barber is a man who shaves and cuts men's hair.
理发师是为男人刮胡子和剪头发的人。
It is pleasant to shave off my beard.
刮完胡子感觉很舒服。

v.t: a. 笔直的, 率直的, 明确的, 简单的, 直接的
v.s: People who can express their thoughts in a clear-cut way are very straightforward.
v.sz: 能够直截了当地表达自己想法的人很直爽。
sx: He's very straightforward.
他说话很直接。

v.t: n. 原谅, 赦免 / vt. 宽恕, 原谅
v.s: Pardon me, but that is my racket.
v.sz: 抱歉，这是我的球拍。
sx: Pardon me for coming late.
对不起，我迟到了。
Pardon all but thyself.
严以律己, 宽以待人。

v.t: vt. 劝, 使相信, 恳求, 敦促, 说服 / vi. 劝服, 被说服
v.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
v.sz: 经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。
sx: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.
说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。
I finally persuaded him to buy it.
我终于说服了他买它。

v.t: n. 前提, 房屋连地基, 上述各项 / vt. 预先提出, 引出, 作为...的前提 / vi. 作出前提
vt. 吸收, 使全神贯注, 同化, 买进, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承担
v.s: I would like to know how these substances are absorbed by the body.
v.sz: 我想知道这些物质是怎么被人体吸收的。
sx: Mangroves absorb more carbon dioxide than any other trees on Earth because they have large underground root structures.
红树林吸取二氧化碳比地球上其他树木都要多，因为它们具有很大的地下根部结构。
It feels like it's going to absorb you into another world.
它的感觉像是它把你吸到了另外一个世界。

v.t: vt. 陪伴, 伴随, 补充, 为...伴奏 / vi. 伴奏, 伴唱
v.s: The President is usually accompanied by his wife when he goes abroad.
v.sz: 总统出国通常有妻子陪伴。
sx: Mountaineering is attractive especially to young people because it is accompanied with hardships and adventures.
攀山是种既紧张刺激，又具挑战性的运动，因此特别受年青人欢迎。
Unfortunately, you will return to China soon, so I will have nobody to accompany me.
可惜你很快又会回中国，没人陪我了呢。

v.t: vt. 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解 / vi. 翻译, 解释
v.s: The same sign may be interpreted differently by different people or different cultures.
v.sz: 同一个符号，不同的人或不同的文化可能会有不同的解读。
sx: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
我认为她的沉默就是表示拒绝。
How do you interpret these words?
这几个字该怎么解释？

v.t: n. 盖子, 限制, 眼睑 / vt. 给...盖盖子
v.s: I just opened the lid, and a foul smell filled my nose.
v.sz: 我刚打开锅盖，一股恶臭就扑鼻而来。
sx: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
生产日期在盖子上。
This jam jar's lid is stuck and won't open.
这个果酱瓶的盖子卡住了，打不开。

v.t: n. 学生, 门生, 未成年人, 瞳孔
v.s: The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.
v.sz: 幼儿园的老师告诉小朋友们要互敬互爱。
sx: Most of the pupils here cycle to school.
这儿的学生大多骑车上学。
There were only a few pupils left in the classroom.
教室里只剩下几个学生了。

v.t: n. 战利品, 赃物, 奖品, 变质, 次品 / vt. 损坏, 破坏, 溺爱 / vi. 腐坏, 掠夺
v.s: When foreign friends see century eggs for the first time, they all think they are spoiled eggs.
v.sz: 外国朋友第一次看到皮蛋，都以为是坏掉的蛋。
sx: I-chun's mom spoils her. She prepares everything for her.
怡君她妈超疼她，什么都帮她准备好。
I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
我不想把结局提前透露给你。

v.t: a. 污秽的, 丑恶的
v.s: This man is like a filthy electronic without a battery.
v.sz: 这个男人简直像一台被扯掉了电源的肮脏电器。
sx: You filthy beast, get out of here!
你这个畜牲，给我滚开！
Your hair is filthy.
你的头发很脏。

v.t: 爷爷, 老太爷, 外公
v.s: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
v.sz: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。
sx: We are worried about grandpa and grandma.
我们担心着外公和外婆。
Grandpa bought it for me!
爷爷买给我的！

v.t: n. 盎司, 少量, 雪豹
v.s: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
v.sz: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。
sx: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
预防胜于治疗。

v.t: vt. 限制, 限定, 约束
v.s: I feel always restricted here.
v.sz: 我在这里总感到约束。
sx: While video platforms do not explicitly ban such content, works of this type will have their traffic restricted.
虽然视频平台没有明确禁止此类内容，但这种类型的作品的流量会被限制。

v.t: n. 香肠, 腊肠
v.s: I often go to Chongqing to eat sausages.
v.sz: 我经常去重庆吃香肠
sx: Would you like bacon or sausage?
你要培根还是要香肠?

v.t: vt. 抓住, 逮捕, 俘获, 没收, 扣押, 掌握 / vi. 突然抓住, 利用
v.s: The boy seized the ladder, and began to climb.
v.sz: 男孩登上了梯子，向上爬了起来。
sx: He seized me by the neck.
他抓住了我的脖子。
Sami's bag was seized by police.
萨米的包被警察扣押了。

v.t: n. 衣橱, 衣室, 全部衣服
vt. 分配, 散布, 分发
v.s: Nowadays, equal pay is not enough. Household responsibilities must also be distributed evenly.
v.sz: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。

v.t: vi. 犹豫, 迟疑, 踌躇, 支吾, 停顿
v.s: When facing this opportunity, you can't hesitate to take advantage of it.
v.sz: 面对这个机会不能犹豫，要赶快行动。
sx: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。
When we reached the fork, we hesitated between continuing towards the town or continuing towards the mountains.
我们到达岔路口时，犹豫是继续往城镇走去，还是继续往山上走去。

v.t: n. 发言人, 代言者
n. 厩, 停车处, 牧师职位, 货摊, 托辞, 拖延 / vt. 关入厩, 停顿, 推托, 支吾, 使陷于泥中 / vi. 被关在厩内, 陷于泥中, 停止, 支吾
v.s: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
v.sz: 他在街市卖鱼卖了许多年了，这些年来每逢星期二都会在街市见到他。

v.t: vt. 包围, 环绕, 围绕 / n. 围绕物
v.s: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
v.sz: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。
sx: Japan is a country surrounded by the sea on all sides.
日本是个四面环海的国家。
The surrounding area was very quiet.
周围的地区非常安静。

v.t: a. 明确的, 一定的
v.s: It is definite that he will go to America.
v.sz: 他肯定要去美国。

v.t: n. 抽屉, 开票人
v.s: There should be a box of matches in the top drawer.
v.sz: 最上面的抽屉里应该有一盒火柴。
sx: I found this in your desk drawer.
我在你的桌子抽屉里找到了这个。
He put his things carelessly in the drawer.
他随意地把东西丢在抽屉里。

v.t: vt. 除外, 排除, 排斥
v.s: He was excluded from the club for infractions of the rules.
v.sz: 他触犯会规，被踢出了俱乐部。
sx: They excluded John from the club.
他们把 John 踢出了俱乐部。

v.t: n. 谈判, 磋商, 交涉
v.s: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.
v.sz: 我可以做中英双向翻译，参加跟外国人交际谈判。
sx: It's just an attempt on his part to maximize profits, as much as possible, in the last moments of negotiations.
这不过是他在谈判最后时刻尽可能最大化利润的尝试。
The negotiation is off.
谈判中止了。

v.t: n. 辫子, 一队人, 队列 / vt. 使排队, 将...梳成辫子 / vi. 排队
